Round 311mi.decision_summary: R311mi: add a composable-framework footprint gate for the full MCU multicast feature profile via a host-runtime-proven SSOT (wz-mcu-multicast-e2e, Layer C1r) + a cross-compiled footprint deploy bin (deploy/mcu-multicast-e2e, Layer Q.5 check-footprint.sh multicast-e2e), closing the R311lu/lv footprint-gate carry; no QEMU boot because multicast self-loopback is a host-only lwIP affordance, so the runtime proof lives on the host.
changes_bullets: crates/wz-mcu-multicast-e2e: new no_std SSOT crate (#![cfg(lwip_real_build)]). run_multicast_e2e<C>(&LwipLink, clock) -> MulticastE2eReport drives the FULL MCU multicast feature profile (session-lwip + transport-multicast + transport-fragmentation + codec-push) end to end via wz_session_lwip::run_multicast_session: a crafted peer JOIN (distinct zid, batch_size=64 matching self so validate_join admits it) admitted into the §3.2 table + an oversize 200-byte Put split into a T_MID_FRAGMENT chain by multicast_tx_emit + reassembled by the R311mf Fragment RX arm into one Push. Mirrors the wz-mcu-session-acceptor lib-owns-the-scenario / bin-stays-thin split; composes via the wz facade (the R311mg composition-surface lesson). The caller supplies &LwipLink so the host test injects a multicast-routed lwip_test_link link and the bin a plain LwipLink::init(). Re-exports ClockSource + LwipLink + MulticastOutcome (single-dep boundary). Registered in crates/Cargo.toml members.

crates/wz-mcu-multicast-e2e/tests/host_multicast_e2e.rs: the RUNTIME PROOF the footprint bin cannot give via QEMU. Uses wz_link_lwip::lwip_test_link (the sanctioned host-only LWIP_LOOPIF_MULTICAST + LWIP_TESTMODE loopback-multicast affordance) to observe the full round trip (asserts join_ok + outcome=IterationLimit + tx_fragmented + peer_admitted + saw_push + !saw_drop). The multicast-loopback runtime proof's correct home is the host: dragging the test-only lwIP flags into a deploy port + the bin would be a test fiction masquerading as a deploy AND contradict the ratified cross/deploy-port policy ("LWIP_LOOPIF_MULTICAST is host-only - real deploys join on their ethernet netif, not loopback").

deploy/mcu-multicast-e2e: new standalone-workspace cortex-m bin (SysTick clock + 256 KB heap + sys_now + verdict map). Cross-compiles the full multicast profile to a final-linked ELF so it is footprint-measurable (Layer G.11 builds only -p wz, a lib that cannot be sized). main calls run_multicast_e2e (a genuine call site, not a black_box footprint-retention trick); join_ok=false on a QEMU loopback env -> SKIP exit (the bin is build + footprint only; it is a real multicast deploy that boots on hardware with a real IGMP netif). mps2-class only: the 32x1536 multicast rx pool (~49 KB, slim-toggle-independent) does not fit nrf51's 16 KB SRAM, so there is no microbit fork.

scripts/check-footprint.sh: extended with a second optional `artifact` arg (qemu-demo default | multicast-e2e) selecting the binary + baseline table via bash namerefs, preserving the original single-arg Q.3 behaviour byte-for-byte. New BASELINE_MC_{TEXT,DATA,BSS} table anchored to THIS entry (not §6.7, which anchors the cortex-m4-default / mcu-qemu-demo artifact): thumbv7m-none-eabi text=50680, thumbv7em-none-eabihf text=50484, data=4, bss=270100 INFO (ROM axes ±256 B hard-gated; bss HEAP_SIZE-dominated INFO per R311bj caveat (c)).

scripts/run-ci.sh: new Layer C1r (isolated host test + clippy of wz-mcu-multicast-e2e, mirrors C1n) + new Layer Q.5 (cross-build the deploy bin on the mps2-class triples + footprint-gate via check-footprint.sh multicast-e2e; NO qemu boot). C1/C2 --exclude wz-mcu-multicast-e2e (no_std-forcing through the facade funnel, like the acceptor). Layer 0 fmt auto-discovers the new standalone deploy workspace.

deploy/mcu-noheap-probe/src/main.rs: repaired a PRE-EXISTING Q.0 build break that R311mi's Layer Q run exposed (opt-in Layer Q had masked it since the query-source-info round). The stage-2 BorrowedQuery initializer was missing the is_local field added to the struct after the probe last named it; set is_local=false (wire dispatch, the probe's is_remote=true query). Mechanical stale-field repair, unrelated to multicast but build-error-priority.
verification_bullets: Full host run-ci + Layer G + Layer Q (WZ_RUN_LAYER_G=1 WZ_RUN_LAYER_Q=1): RUNCI_EXIT=0 (read from the trailing exit-code line, not a pipe/tee-masked tail), "run-ci: all required layers pass", no FAIL lines.

Layer C1r (new isolated host lane): wz-mcu-multicast-e2e host integration test PASS + clippy --all-targets clean. host_multicast_e2e drives the full multicast profile over a routed lwIP loopback and asserts join_ok + outcome=IterationLimit + tx_fragmented + peer_admitted + saw_push + !saw_drop (the transport-multicast peer admit + transport-fragmentation oversize-Put split + reassembly-RX-into-one-Push round trip). C1/C2 --exclude it (no_std-forced like the acceptor).

Layer Q.5 (new footprint lane): mcu-multicast-e2e cross-builds OK on thumbv7m-none-eabi + thumbv7em-none-eabihf via the cross-test lwIP port; check-footprint.sh multicast-e2e gates each at +0 within the +/-256 B ROM band (text=50680/50484, data=4, bss=270100 INFO). Round 311mk.decision_summary: R311mk: structurally decouple the catalog-atomic transport-multicast from transport-unicast at the wz-runtime-tokio + facade level - gate the previously-unconditional session_glue (unicast handshake driver) + the Session handle on transport-unicast, relocate the shared reassembly-pool wiring to crate::reassembly and BoxedLinkDriver to its wz_session_core::link SSOT home (out of the unicast tier), and add codec-close to transport-multicast (the multicast_rx Close/abort SSOT it consumes) - so a multicast-only build composes WITHOUT transport-unicast (closing the R311lv facade carry); the cheap transport-multicast=>transport-unicast implication was rejected as an atom-welding smell that mis-states the protocol (zenoh-pico builds multicast-only); guarded by new Layer C4e, Q.5 multicast footprint +0 unchanged.
changes_bullets: crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/reassembly.rs: NEW transport-agnostic shared module. Relocated TokioReassembly (the AP reassembly Router type alias) + reassembly_config() + the REASSEMBLY_SLOTS / REASSEMBLY_SLOT_SIZE consts out of session_glue.rs (the unicast handshake driver) into a neutral SSOT gated on the `reassembly` feature only. Both the unicast steady-state drive loop and the multicast drive loop (multicast_glue) run their own pool instance over the SAME SCE-sourced AP dims/knobs (one buffer-pool policy SSOT, two transports). Keeping them in session_glue made a transport-multicast-only build (no session_glue) unable to reach the pool config - the root of the facade composability gap.

crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/lib.rs: `pub mod session_glue` + `pub mod session` are now `#[cfg(feature = "transport-unicast")]`. session_glue names the SessionFsmUnicast{Policy,Event} types and drives session_actions / session_timeouts / drive (all session-unicast-gated in wz-session-core); the Session handle owns a session_glue::SessionLinkActions bundle (the unicast action machinery) - so both are the unicast-session API surface. A transport-multicast-only build drives multicast through multicast_glue::drive_multicast_session over the shared ApplicationLayerObserver, not a Session handle. Added `#[cfg(feature = "reassembly")] pub mod reassembly`.

crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/{udp_pipeline,link_pipeline}.rs: import BoxedLinkDriver from its SSOT home wz_session_core::link (the shared link tier) instead of via the crate::session_glue re-export hop. The link pipeline is transport-agnostic (a multicast deploy binds a UDP multicast socket too), so it must not depend on the now-transport-unicast-gated session_glue. This also closed the pre-existing transport-link-udp / transport-link-tcp WITHOUT transport-unicast arbitrary-composition gaps as a bonus (the realistic transport-multicast,transport-link-udp deploy shape now builds).

crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/multicast_glue.rs: the multicast reassembly Router is constructed from crate::reassembly (was crate::session_glue); the tx_sn TX-mint state carries a `#[cfg_attr(not(any(codec-push, codec-response, codec-response-final, liveliness-token)), allow(unused_mut))]` because a JOIN-only multicast build (transport-multicast with no data-plane body codecs, now reachable since the unicast decouple) reads tx_sn for the beacon (encode_join) but never mints (multicast_tx_emit is gated on those codecs).

crates/wz-runtime-tokio/Cargo.toml: transport-multicast += codec-close. The shared multicast RX classify/dispatch SSOT wz_session_core::multicast_rx (consumed by multicast_glue) is gated on codec-close because it decodes T_MID_CLOSE and aborts the leaving peer's reassembly chains via dispatcher.close_by_src (multicast_rx.rs:147,209). A select edge in the same class as the existing codec-join / codec-frame - a multicast transport that cannot process a peer's Close is incomplete, not optional. Previously masked by the default codec set; the facade composability build (no default) exposed the unresolved multicast_rx import.

crates/wz/Cargo.toml: facade transport-multicast does NOT re-list codec-close - the crate forward self-selects it (wz-runtime-tokio/transport-multicast += codec-close; wz-session-lwip/transport-multicast already pulls wz-session-core/codec-close), mirroring how the facade does not re-list codec-join / codec-frame. An explicit facade codec-close forward would be redundant AND would perturb wz-runtime-lwip's feature set for the MCU multicast footprint bin (Q.5) for zero benefit, so it was deliberately omitted; a one-line comment records this.

scripts/run-ci.sh: NEW Layer C4e (transport-axis matrix). The consumer-plane matrices C4b/C4c/C1j/C4d vary the consumer plane on a transport-unicast base and cannot express the orthogonal transport axis; C4e builds the wz facade (the reported-gap shape) + clippy-checks the wz-runtime-tokio crate in isolation (deny-warnings) under 3 multicast-WITHOUT-unicast subsets (multicast-join-only, multicast-data, multicast-udp-deploy) so the decouple cannot silently regress. No cargo-test twin: a multicast-only crate has no unicast-handshake tests and the multicast behaviour is already covered with unicast on by C1p/C1q + the MCU e2e by C1r. The stale "transport-unicast is FOUNDATIONAL / transport-multicast reserved with no consumer" rationale in _wz_runtime_tokio_coherent_subsets was corrected (transport-multicast is now an independently-composable atom).

Decision rationale (why the structural decouple, not an implication edge): the cheap alternative transport-multicast => transport-unicast was rejected as a smell - it would weld two catalog atoms (violating the atomic-features north star), encode a wz implementation artifact as a protocol-level dependency that is FALSE (zenoh-pico builds multicast-only), and leave the real mis-placement (SessionLinkActions / reassembly / BoxedLinkDriver sitting in the unicast tier) unaddressed. The structural decouple is the SSOT-correct fix: each module in its correct tier, the catalog-atomic transport-multicast composes alone.

changes_bullets: crates/wz-session-core/src/session_actions.rs: extracted prepare_declare_token (the build half of send_declare_token - reconstruct_outbound_keyexpr + check_outbound_keyexpr_pico_safe + build_declare_token, returning DeclareOwned); the R300 pico-safety gate is now the SSOT shared by send_declare_token and the seam-routed Session::declare_token. Added a codec-declare-gated NetworkMessage::Declare arm to SessionLinkActions::send_network_message (the seam unicast arm -> dispatch_declare reliable, no express window) and widened its fn gate from any(codec-push, codec-request) to any(codec-push, codec-request, codec-declare) so a liveliness-only build (codec-declare without codec-push/request) still carries the seam. send_declare_token now delegates to prepare_declare_token + dispatch_declare + the new cache_token_declaration shim; send_undeclare_token delegates the cache prune to the new prune_token_declaration shim. cache_token_declaration / prune_token_declaration are signature-stable pub shims (no-op without session-reconnect) mirroring prune_liveliness_get_interest - the session-level reconnect-replay bookkeeping that wraps the seam emit. prepare_declare_token uses the full path to DeclareOwned (the module use is liveliness-token-gated, but the build half is reachable under bare declare-token via the wrapper path).

Routed declare_token (literal) + declare_token_aliased remote-emit legs off self.actions().send_declare_token onto self.actions().prepare_declare_token + send_network_message(NetworkMessage::Declare, reliable=true, express=false) + self.actions().cache_token_declaration. The token-id alloc + the declarer-side registry register stay session-level; the seam's SendWireError folds into the same SendDeclareError -> LivelinessAliasError projection via From (shared through a nested map_decl_err fn) so the error mapping is unchanged.

crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/session/liveliness.rs: routed the LivelinessToken teardown (undeclare/Drop SSOT, R311lo) off self.session.actions().send_undeclare_token onto build_undeclare_token + send_network_message(NetworkMessage::Declare) + self.session.actions().prune_token_declaration, gated all(declare-token, declare-undeclare) - the same gate the prior send_undeclare_token body used; the liveliness module is transport-unicast-gated but not liveliness-token-gated, so a transport-unicast build without declare-undeclare still compiles the teardown, and declare-token => codec-declare keeps the seam's Declare arm present whenever the block is. F2 - no error channel, the emit Result is discarded exactly as the dead link would.

Round 311my.decision_summary: Session-review follow-up (R311mw/mx): add the send-seam gate-skew regression guard to run-ci. R311mw shipped a real compile bug (the seam Declare arm was codec-declare-gated while dispatch_declare is declare-*-union-gated -> absent dispatch in a codec-declare-without-Declare-origination build), and run-ci passed it because every codec-declare lane in the C1h matrix either pins a 6-union origination member (masking the skew) or omits session-unicast (so it never compiles the SessionLinkActions seam). R311mx fixed the bug but added no regression guard. This round adds a clippy -D warnings lane to layer_c1h_arbitrary_subset_matrix: wz-session-core --features alloc,session-unicast,declare-interest,codec-frame - the only lane that compiles the seam (session-unicast) with codec-declare on (via declare-interest) but no Declare-origination feature, so a future seam arm whose gate outruns its dispatch_* helper, or a dropped catch-arm param discard, fails mechanically. Realizes the stale run-ci.sh:846 codec-declare-bare comment intent. No source change.
changes_bullets: scripts/run-ci.sh: added a clippy -D warnings step to layer_c1h_arbitrary_subset_matrix (the wz-session-core arbitrary-subset matrix) - cargo clippy -p wz-session-core --no-default-features --features alloc,session-unicast,declare-interest,codec-frame --all-targets -- -D warnings. This is the send-seam gate-skew guard: session-unicast compiles the SessionLinkActions seam (gated all(alloc, session-unicast)); declare-interest pulls codec-declare + the Interest arm but no 6-union Declare-origination feature, so the seam's Declare arm is cfg'd out. The prior C1h codec-declare lanes (alloc,codec-declare ... NO session-unicast) never compiled the seam at all, and every runtime/facade codec-declare lane (C4b/C4c/C1j/C4d) pins a 6-union member via liveliness-*, so no lane exercised codec-declare-on-without-Declare-origination - which is exactly the R311mw skew (seam Declare arm codec-declare-gated, dispatch_declare union-gated -> absent dispatch -> hard compile error). clippy not build, so the catch arm's reliable discard regression also fails here (the seam lives in lib).

scripts/run-ci.sh: updated the C1h subset-list header comment with a #6b entry documenting the seam-skew guard rationale (which feature combo, why every other lane masked the skew, why clippy not build) and noting the purely-degenerate codec-declare-with-zero-consumers build is not a coherent profile and is intentionally not pinned (its only blemish is an unused NetworkMessage import that the realistic guard's Interest arm exercises away).
verification_bullets: Full host run-ci RUNCI_EXIT=0 with the new C1h seam-skew guard in the chain; bash -n scripts/run-ci.sh clean. The guard's standalone clippy is GUARD_EXIT=0 by direct exit code (not pipe-masked - an earlier pipe-masked check falsely reported pass, the feedback_runci_verdict_exit_code_only trap).

The guard is effective (proven): the identical feature build (alloc,session-unicast,declare-interest,codec-frame) failed pre-R311mx with `cannot find method dispatch_declare` (the seam Declare arm gated codec-declare referencing the union-gated absent helper) and the `dispatch_network_message` chain; on fixed main (Declare arm gated to the same declare-* union as dispatch_declare) it compiles clean. A future regression of the seam-arm gate OR the catch-arm param discard re-fails this exact lane.

Process note: this round adds NO source change - it is the regression guard the R311mx bug fix should have carried. The session review surfaced that run-ci's existing C1h codec-declare-bare subset (run-ci.sh:846 comment) was stale: it omitted session-unicast so it never compiled the SessionLinkActions seam, which is why R311mw's run-ci passed despite the bug. The new guard realizes that comment's documented intent.

The lesson - a seam arm MUST carry its dispatch helper's exact gate, and the no-emit catch arm must discard every dispatch param - is now enforced, not just documented.

Round 311mz.decision_summary: Session-review follow-up: fix the declare_token_aliased liveliness-token registration asymmetry (a confirmed correctness bug, pico-divergent). The literal Session::declare_token registered the held token in the declarer-side LocalTokenRegistry (so an inbound non-final liveliness Interest replays it to peers that subscribe LATER), but Session::declare_token_aliased silently skipped that register - so an aliased-declared token was invisible to late subscribers, diverging from zenoh-pico (_z_declare_liveliness_token always inserts into _local_tokens, net/liveliness.c:77, regardless of literal/alias form). Fixed unrepresentably (not test-guarded) per feedback_unrepresentable_over_test: the LocalTokenRegistry registration moved into LivelinessToken::new_held, the now-SOLE constructor, and the struct fields made private - so neither declare path can build a held token without registering. Behaviour change: aliased tokens now replay to late subscribers (the fix); literal path byte-identical.
changes_bullets: crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/session/liveliness.rs: made the LivelinessToken fields private (was pub(super)) and added LivelinessToken::new_held - the SOLE constructor - which registers the token in the declarer-side LocalTokenRegistry (observer.local_tokens.register, the R283 late-subscriber replay state) then builds the handle. With the fields sealed, a held token cannot be constructed without that registration, so the literal and aliased declare paths register identically by construction (the asymmetry is unrepresentable, not merely tested - feedback_unrepresentable_over_test). Doc cites pico parity (net/liveliness.c:77) + the late-subscriber replay consequence.

crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/session/mod.rs: declare_token (literal) now calls LivelinessToken::new_held(self.clone(), token_id, keyexpr_string, options) instead of an inline observer.local_tokens.register + a direct struct literal - the register moved into the constructor (byte-identical effect). declare_token_aliased now ALSO calls new_held(self.clone(), token_id, resolved, options) - it previously constructed the handle WITHOUT registering, so this ADDS the missing registration of the RESOLVED literal (the bug fix). cache_token_declaration ordering unchanged (cache before register, both paths).
verification_bullets: Full host run-ci RUNCI_EXIT=0, all required layers pass (0 FAIL): the liveliness behaviour + e2e lanes (Layer C/E) green - the literal declare_token path is byte-identical (register moved into new_held), the aliased path now registers. Default + liveliness-subset clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean (no test constructed LivelinessToken directly, so the private-field seal compiles cleanly); cargo fmt --all --check clean.

Bug confirmed by direct read before the fix: literal declare_token registered the held token (old mod.rs:2451-2455), aliased declare_token_aliased did NOT (old :2579-2586 constructed the handle directly with no register); the consumer observer.rs:647 local_tokens.keyexpr_for(token_id) returns None for an unregistered token -> no Declare(DeclToken) reply to an inbound non-final liveliness Interest -> an aliased token was invisible to a peer that subscribed LATER. zenoh-pico _z_declare_liveliness_token (net/liveliness.c:52-77) always inserts into _local_tokens with the resolved keyexpr, regardless of literal/alias form; wz's aliased omission diverged.

Unrepresentable-by-construction (feedback_unrepresentable_over_test): NO discipline test added - the private fields + the single registering constructor make a non-registered held token impossible to build, a stronger guard than a test asserting the register ran. The struct's existing accessors (id/keyexpr/options) + teardown stay in-module, so sealing the fields does not affect the public surface.
carry_forward_bullets: declare_token_aliased registration asymmetry FIXED (R311mz), unrepresentably: LivelinessToken::new_held is the sole constructor and registers in the LocalTokenRegistry; the struct fields are private. Aliased liveliness tokens now replay to late subscribers (pico parity restored, net/liveliness.c:77). The session-review's most material finding - a real correctness bug, not a structural smell - is closed.

Session-review residual #2 REVIEWED + CLOSED AS NON-DEFECT: the LivelinessToken/LivelinessSubscriber teardown `let _ = &self.session` discards are NOT a band-aid to fix. Gating the structs on liveliness-token/liveliness-subscriber (the reviewer's proposed root fix) would break the R311o signature-stability of declare_token / declare_liveliness_subscriber (their return types LivelinessToken<R,T> / LivelinessSubscriber<R,T> would vanish when the feature is off, breaking handshake-only builds); reverting the teardown to the signature-stable send_undeclare_token / send_interest_final wrappers would re-couple the to-be-retired wrappers (blocking session-review Finding 2) and break origination/retraction symmetry. The discard is the deliberate minimal cost of signature-stability + seam-routing. The initial recommendation to "gate the structs" was a too-quick acceptance of the reviewer's diff-only finding; verification against R311o reversed it.

Session-review residual #3 still open (lower value): SendWireError::UnsupportedVariant - the seam catch arm returns FeatureDisabled for reply-plane variants (Response/ResponseFinal/Oam) that structurally cannot originate through the Session-method seam, conflating feature-off with caller-bug; a distinct variant is the honest surface. Bundle candidate, not urgent.

Could mirror the new_held unrepresentable-constructor pattern to LivelinessSubscriber for consistency, but its two declare paths already register symmetrically in liveliness_subscribers (no bug) - YAGNI unless a future divergence appears.

Larger structural carries remain: vestigial send_* wrappers retirement (session-review Finding 2) + the B5b-2b tail (drop not(transport-unicast) on SessionTransport::Multicast + new_multicast + multicast publish, converge the two publish signatures + build_loopback_sample, actions() runtime-dispatch B5b-3, retire drive_multicast_session B5b-4).

Round 311n.decision_summary: R311n measurement automation — scripts/measure-codec-footprint.sh + lib/feature_implies.py compute wz-facade implies-graph from cargo metadata; honest SKIP on compile-fail lanes.
changes_bullets: scripts/lib/feature_implies.py NEW — wz facade → wz-runtime-tokio implies-graph resolver. Reads `cargo metadata --format-version=1 --no-deps` JSON from stdin, computes wz-runtime-tokio transitive closure + wz facade activation map + invert to PULLERS-by-codec, emits shell-sourceable `PULLERS_codec_X="..."` assignments for every `codec-*` rt feature. Standalone module instead of inline heredoc because `cargo metadata | python3 - <<EOF` is ambiguous in bash (heredoc + pipe both target stdin).

scripts/measure-codec-footprint.sh — each minus-<codec> lane excludes the codec + its full transitive puller set (declare-* / query-* / liveliness-* / domain-* / presets). Pre-R311n the exclusion was the codec name only; cargo resolver silently re-enabled the codec via `declare-subscriber = [codec-declare]` etc. and the lane measured a fake near-zero delta. The puller-aware exclusion makes the lane honest.

scripts/measure-codec-footprint.sh — `measure()` gracefully SKIPs lanes whose binary fails to compile under the puller-aware exclusion. Writes `SKIP` to the size cache; the report prints `SKIP` instead of a numeric delta. Honest semantics for `this binary unconditionally references the consumer features and cannot be elided down to handshake-only`.

scripts/measure-codec-footprint.sh — handshake-only lane added. Start from preset-ap-client; exclude every consumer feature; only `Init` / `Open` / `Close` + `KeepAlive` + transport / runtime plumbing remain. Skips for wz-ap-demo today; the lane shape is the contract a future minimal handshake binary would satisfy.

scripts/measure-codec-footprint.sh — threshold-based regression gate (`WZ_FOOTPRINT_THRESHOLD_BYTES` default 1024). Codec lanes below threshold fail the script. wz-codecs-only codecs (scout/hello/join/fragment) soft-skip; compile-fail SKIPs are excluded from the gate. Opt-out via `WZ_FOOTPRINT_NO_THRESHOLD=1`.

scripts/run-ci.sh — Layer F added. Opt-in via `--layer F` or `WZ_RUN_LAYER_F=1`. Runs `measure-codec-footprint.sh` as a catalog-truthfulness regression gate. Stays off the default dispatch path because the bench is expensive (~5-10 min cold; multiple wz-ap-demo release builds).

changes_bullets: crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/session/mod.rs liveliness_get (Session-review Finding 1, the real defect): bind `let actions = self.actions()?` at the TOP of the method, BEFORE the `if !is_established()` gate, and reuse it for alloc_next_interest_id + cache_get_interest. On a multicast session, is_established() reads `false` (the R311nc is_established() -> unwrap_or(false) projection), so the establishment gate front-ran the transport check and returned LivelinessGetError::NotEstablished ("retry after the session re-establishes" - futile on multicast) instead of the honest RequiresUnicast the `actions()?` one line later would have produced. Reordering makes the transport projection win; the unicast path is byte-identical (actions() is always Ok there, then the same is_established gate runs).

crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/session/mod.rs Session::new: read `actions.params.zid.clone()` from the constructor PARAMETER before moving `actions` into SessionTransport::Unicast, dropping the R311nc defensive `if let Ok(actions) = session.actions()` that re-projected a value this ctor builds as Unicast by construction. No behavior change; removes a known-Ok re-ask.

crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/session/mod.rs declare_token_aliased map_decl_err: comment-only - mark the SendDeclareError::RequiresUnicast arm GATE-SHADOWED (the top `let actions = self.actions().map_err(...)?` front-runs the seam, so a multicast session returns RequiresUnicast there and never reaches this arm). Round 311nj.decision_summary: R311nj: R311ni 세션리뷰 보정 — TX-frag e2e의 false-positive 위험 청산(발행 전 negotiated_batch_mtu==64 단언으로 분할을 구조적 보장화).
changes_bullets: crates/wz-runtime-tokio/tests/layer3_reassembly_tx.rs: 발행 전 `assert_eq!(opened_init.actions.negotiated_batch_mtu(), 64)` + acceptor 대칭 단언 추가. 리뷰어(독립+자가)가 확인한 HIGH 결함: 200B payload가 msg_put 256B 코덱 한도 내라, MTU 협상이 조용히 65535로 회귀해도 단일 프레임으로 전달되어 `fired==1` 통과=fragmented/non-fragmented 구분 불가(false-positive). MTU==64 단언으로 200>64→emit_frame_or_fragments 분할 branch 구조적 보장. docstring도 multicast sibling을 동등 proof로 과주장하던 표현 수정(multicast는 batch_size 직접 param=협상 회귀 벡터 없음; unicast는 협상이라 명시 단언 필요).
verification_bullets: 독립 리뷰어(general-purpose)가 #1 HIGH false-positive를 자가의심과 동일하게 확인; R311nh full-qualify는 교과서적(fn-gate 좁히면 signature-stability 위반)이고 C1h 6c/C1l 주석도 정확하다고 독립 검증.
하드닝 후 테스트 통과(EXIT=0) — negotiated_batch_mtu()가 실제 64임을 증명(아니면 assert 실패). 즉 원래도 제대로 분할했고 이제 구조적 보장.

Round 311nk.decision_summary: R311nk: wz<-zenoh-pico unicast TX fragmentation 교차구현 e2e 신규(실 TCP; pico z_put 200B가 batch=64 협상으로 fragment chain 송신 후 wz reassemble, byte-exact). 멀티캐스트 interop은 router(Phase D+) 선결이라 unicast로 scope.
changes_bullets: crates/wz-integration-tests/tests/wz_reassembles_pico_fragment_tx.rs (NEW): in-test wz acceptor(accept_and_open_session, batch_size=64 advertise) + 외부 zenoh-pico `z_put -m client`(200B distinctive payload) spawn. pico가 min(64, pico-default 2048)=64 협상 → 200B Put을 T_MID_FRAGMENT chain으로 송신 → wz `drive_session_until_terminal`이 reassemble → byte-exact subscriber 발화. `negotiated_batch_mtu()==64` 단언으로 fragment를 구조적 보장([[feedback-no-flaky-ever]] 인접 R311nj 교훈: 행동 assert만으론 false-positive). drive를 terminal까지 await 후 fired==1 단언 — pico z_put one-shot(put→close)의 near-instant loopback close와 polling이 만들던 레이스 제거.
crates/wz-integration-tests/Cargo.toml: dev-dep `wz-runtime-tokio`에 features=["transport-fragmentation"](AP reassembly RX 경로) + `tokio` dev-dep(net/rt-multi-thread/macros/time) 추가.
verification_bullets: 신규 test 15/15 no-flaky([[feedback-no-flaky-ever]]); drive-terminal vs poll 레이스 fix 전 8/10(iter 2/3/8/11/12 'acceptor drive loop ended before delivery') → mechanical root-cause(drive await + 사후 fired assert) 후 15/15.

fragment wire 발생 확증: pico가 200B를 sn:1(more:true)+sn:2(more:false) chain으로 송신(RUST_LOG=debug Poll(Fragment)), wz reassembly slot Receiving->Complete. 200B > negotiated MTU 64 이고 wz zbuf=64라 단일프레임 수신이 구조적 불가 — byte-exact 200B 수신 자체가 fragment+reassemble 증명.

full host run-ci EXIT=0 'all required layers pass'(재실행; fmt + clippy doc_lazy_continuation 3건 fix 후). Layer E(`cargo test -p wz-integration-tests -- --ignored --skip wz_e2e_`)가 신규 테스트 자동수집(0.07s 1 passed).
C1(`cargo test --workspace`)에서 wz-integration-tests의 frag dev-dep feature unification 누수가 다른 lane을 깨지 않음 확인.
interop scope 발견: pico가 3000B(>256) 보내면 wz reassemble은 Complete까지 가나 재파싱 `Codec(TooManyElements)` — wz MsgPut payload codec bound=256(msg_put.scxml:111). 작은 MTU + ≤256B payload만 interop-valid.
carry_forward_bullets: proof-gap 닫힘: unicast TX fragmentation 교차구현(zenoh-pico z_put → wz reassemble) e2e 신규. codec 바이트패리티(layer3_fragment) + wz↔wz loopback(layer3_reassembly_tx)에 이어 실 소켓 외부구현 송신을 검증.

멀티캐스트 wz↔pico interop은 scout-reply Hello responder(=router discovery role)가 선결 — ARCHITECTURE.md:92 router mode=Phase D+, docs scouting-fsm.md §8.1 G-SCT-2가 speculative deferral. 당기려면 ARCHITECTURE phase 재배치를 audit-trace하는 별도 결정 필요. pico 멀티캐스트 peer는 scout-then-open이라 Hello 공급자(router) 없이 세션 못 엶(z_sub -m peer 단독 'Unable to open session' 실측).
pico→wz unicast dial-in(Gap 6) 여전히 미검증: pico peer-listener가 Client InitSyn에 무응답, zenoh router 의존.
큰메시지(>256B) interop은 wz MsgPut payload bound 확장이 선결(별건).

Round 311nm.decision_summary: R311nm: wz->pico multicast JOIN+Push interop e2e 신규 — wz in-library mcast publisher의 JOIN+Push를 외부 pico z_sub -m peer가 admit+decode(byte-exact, 실 UDP). Layer M opt-in, Layer E 제외.
changes_bullets: crates/wz-integration-tests/tests/wz_publisher_to_pico_multicast_zsub.rs (NEW): wz in-library 멀티캐스트 publisher(ephemeral TX-only `UdpDriver::from_socket` + `drive_multicast_session` + `multicast_put_literal`; mc_params version 0x09 / batch 2048 / sn-req-res 0x02 = vendored pico config 정확히 일치)가 JOIN beacon + framed Push를 실 UDP group(224.0.0.224:7457)에 송신 → 외부 `z_sub -m peer -l udp/...#iface=<default-route-dev>`가 admit + decode → stdout `>> [Subscriber] Received ('demo/mc/interop': '...')` byte-exact. 방향=wz->pico (pico->wz는 wz `bind_multicast_v4`가 SO_REUSEADDR 미설정이라 동일 host 동일 group port co-bind 시 EADDRINUSE; carry). JOIN admission은 transitive 증명: pico rx.c:373-396이 version/seq_num_res/req_id_res/batch_size 불일치 peer의 Frame을 admit 전 drop하므로 z_sub의 Received 발화 자체가 wz JOIN을 pico가 파싱·admit했다는 증거. JOIN-admission 윈도우 레이스는 100ms republish loop로 제거([[feedback-no-flaky-ever]]). default-route iface는 `ip route show default`로 런타임 발견(wz INADDR_ANY mcast egress가 고르는 그 iface) → 양 peer 동일 링크. stdbuf -oL로 z_sub stdout line-buffer.

crates/wz-integration-tests/Cargo.toml: wz-runtime-tokio dev-dep features에 transport-multicast 추가(transport-fragmentation 옆, 멀티캐스트 publisher 컴파일용). resolver=2가 C1 region 누수 격리 — frag pin과 동일 근거(C1 `cargo test --workspace`에서 multicast-gated test 실행 0).

scripts/run-ci.sh: Layer E 기본 스윕에 `--skip multicast` 추가 — env-dependent 멀티캐스트 interop을 필수 게이트에서 제외(wz_e2e_ 컨벤션과 동일 substring 패턴). Layer M(opt-in)에 wz->pico interop을 3번째 sub-step으로 추가(pico-CLI graceful SKIP 가드; 기존 `&&` 체인을 `|| return 1` 시퀀스로 정리해 sub-step별 독립 실행).
verification_bullets: 신규 test 15/15 no-flaky([[feedback-no-flaky-ever]]); cargo test 0.35s, fmt+clippy clean. 주의: raw 테스트 바이너리 직접 실행은 CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR 미설정으로 project_root() panic(0.00s 즉시 실패) — 내 반복 루프의 아티팩트이지 실제 flake 아님; env 세팅 후 15/15 통과로 확정.

falsify-first(R311nl 메타교훈 적용): Rust 작성 전 순수 바이너리로 환경 검증 — (1) wz↔wz multicast_pubsub_loopback이 이 호스트에서 EXIT=0(lo에 MULTICAST 플래그 없으나 wz INADDR_ANY membership이 default-route wlp0s20f3 선택). (2) pico↔pico(z_sub + z_put -m peer -l udp/224..#iface=wlp0s20f3)가 '>> Received' 루프백 성립 — 환경·SO_REUSE co-bind·#iface 전부 확인 후 테스트 설계.

wire-compat 교차검증: vendored pico(pin 3b3ab65c) 빌드값 Z_BATCH_MULTICAST_SIZE=2048 / Z_PROTO_VERSION=0x09 / Z_SN_RESOLUTION=0x02 = wz mc_params 정확히 일치. pico rx.c:381,432가 batch 불일치 JOIN을 reject(대칭 검증)하므로 wz가 2048 광고 필수.
Layer M EXIT=0: scouting_multicast_loopback + multicast_pubsub_loopback + 신규 wz->pico interop 3 sub-step 전부 pass. Layer E EXIT=0 & 신규 멀티캐스트 test 0회 실행(--skip multicast 제외 검증).
full host run-ci EXIT=0 'all required layers pass'(전체 host 레인). atomic ledger entries=721, orphan delta=0, T3 warn 미증가.

R311nl이 정정한 '멀티캐스트 interop reachable, router 불필요(pico -l locator JOIN 경로)'를 실측으로 확정 — JOIN 필드 호환 + Frame decode + 전달까지 검증. codec 바이트패리티 + wz↔wz 루프백 + (R311nk) unicast frag interop에 이어 멀티캐스트 교차구현 송신을 닫음.

pico->wz 멀티캐스트 dial-in 미검증: wz `bind_multicast_v4`가 SO_REUSEADDR/REUSEPORT 미설정이라 pico mcast peer(둘 다 설정)와 동일 host 동일 group port co-bind 시 EADDRINUSE. 당기려면 wz 멀티캐스트 bind에 SO_REUSEADDR 추가 필요(현재 tokio UdpSocket로는 미지원 → socket2 진입; lib.rs 주석이 'multi-listener=socket2 진입점'이라 이미 명시) — 별건 프로덕션 변경. NEXT 후보 1.

양방향 JOIN assertion 미완: 이 test는 pico측 수신만 확증(=pico가 wz JOIN admit, transitive). wz가 pico JOIN을 admit하는 역방향은 pico JOIN interval=Z_JOIN_INTERVAL 2.5s라 빠른 종료(첫 Push 수신 즉시) 전 미수신 → wz active_peers 단언 시 env-flaky 위험으로 생략. 추가하려면 test 윈도우>2.5s 또는 pico join interval 단축 설정.
큰메시지(>256B) 멀티캐스트 interop은 unicast와 동일하게 wz MsgPut payload bound 256(msg_put.scxml:111) 확장 선결(별건; R311nl negative test가 unicast로 이미 pin).

UdpDriver::bind_multicast_v4를 socket2 경유 재작성 — SO_REUSEADDR+SO_REUSEPORT를 bind 전 설정(Socket->std UdpSocket->tokio from_std; tokio는 pre-bind setsockopt 훅 없음). zenoh-pico parity(udp_multicast_posix.c:180/185 무조건 REUSE, INADDR_ANY:port bind line196). lib.rs 주석의 'single-receiver, socket2 회피' 결정을 multi-listener pico-interop 요구로 supersede — 그 주석이 명시적으로 예고한 socket2 진입 지점.

crates/wz-session-core/src/codec_owned.rs(구 codec_bound.rs, R311nq rename): bounded_bytes/bounded_string -> owned_bytes/owned_string, 모듈 codec_bound -> codec_owned(세션리뷰 M1: alloc tier에서 carrier가 unbounded라 'bounded' 이름 misnomer). 본체를 SCE 연관함수 SceBytes::<N>::from_slice / SceString::<N>::from_view에 위임. owned bytes/string이 alloc=Vec/String unbounded(N advisory), no-alloc=heapless<N>. 18 파일 일괄 rename(호출 52곳: bytes 25/string 27 + wz-runtime-tokio scouting_glue + test). newtype N보존이 호출부 N추론 살림(호출부 turbofish 불필요). BoundedString(별개 bounded 모듈, 레지스트리)은 단어경계로 미수정.

M3: msg_put 특수 서사를 '전 sce:max-size scalar codec 일관, 257B는 대표 실증'으로.

changes_bullets: crates/wz-session-core/src/link.rs: pico의 per-link zl->_mtu 모델을 BoxedLinkDriver 트레잇으로 도입. 신규 `pub const DEFAULT_LINK_MTU: usize = 65_535`(pico _z_get_link_mtu_tcp tcp.c:86 = 동일 65535) + 신규 default 트레잇 메서드 `fn link_mtu(&self) -> usize { DEFAULT_LINK_MTU }`. 프레임 크기 제한이 없는 stream link(TCP/UDP/lwIP)는 default 상속, 프레임 바운드 link(serial)만 override.

crates/wz-session-core/src/session_actions.rs: negotiated_batch_mtu()에 link MTU를 세 번째 min 항으로 추가. 종전 min(own, peer)를 min(own, peer, self.link_driver().link_mtu())로. pico가 TX wbuf를 min(zl->_mtu, batch_size)로 sizing하는 것(transport.c:47)과 동일 — advertised batch는 줄이지 않고(pico도 그대로; peer RX 예산=full 광고) TX-side 예산만 link-cap. unbounded link는 항이 65535라 u16 batch 광고에 대해 inert → TCP/UDP 무변경.

changes_bullets: crates/zenoh-pico-sys/wrapper.h + build.rs: pico serial 코덱 5 함수를 FFI 노출(allowlist). wrapper.h에 protocol/codec/serial.h + utils/encoding.h + utils/checksum.h include; build.rs allowlist_function _z_serial_msg_serialize / _z_serial_msg_deserialize / _z_cobs_encode / _z_cobs_decode / _z_crc32. 이 함수들은 Z_FEATURE_LINK_SERIAL 게이트 없는 플랫폼독립 codec/util라 libzenohpico.a에 존재(pico serial LINK 백엔드는 MCU 전용, unix 없음). 5 심볼 모두 bindings 생성 + nm으로 lib 정의(T) 확인.

crates/wz-integration-tests/tests/layer3_serial_framing.rs (신규, ungated): layer3_* byte-parity family에 합류. 4 test — (1) wz encode_frame 프레임 전체가 pico _z_serial_msg_serialize와 byte-identical(EOP 포함), (2) pico 프레임을 wz decode_frame + SerialFrameReader(byte-by-byte)가 수용, (3) wz 프레임을 pico _z_serial_msg_deserialize가 수용(rb=EOP포함, _z_read_serial_internal 미러), (4) cobs encode/decode + crc32 기본기 parity. corpus: empty/single/embedded-zero/0..255/300/254/MTU1500, header 0x00/INIT/INIT|ACK/RESET/0xFF.

crates/wz-integration-tests/Cargo.toml: dev-dep feature 핀 — wz-codecs codec-serial + wz-session-core transport-link-serial(테스트가 serial_link + cobs/crc32 도달) + wz-runtime-tokio transport-link-serial. 마지막은 COUPLING 필수: AnyLocator::Serial variant는 wz-session-core feature 게이트이고 wz-runtime-tokio session_open.rs의 해당 match arm은 wz-runtime-tokio feature 게이트—둘을 따로 켜면 match non-exhaustive(E0004). 세 핀을 함께 두어 의도된 coupling(wz-runtime-tokio feature->wz-session-core forward) 유지. resolver=2가 C1 워크스페이스 빌드로의 누수 차단.

sources/codecs/cobs_encode.scxml (pico parity 버그수정): 최대 254-바이트 그룹(code 0xFF)이 EOF에 정확히 끝날 때 trailing 0x01 empty group을 emit. 종전 q>=n 분기가 즉시 done=true라 trailing 0x01 누락 → 254-non-zero 입력에서 wz=[0xFF,254 data](255B) vs pico=[0xFF,254 data,0x01](256B, encoding.c:33-44). q>=n 분기 후 독립 guard `(done && run>=254) -> append 0x01`로 수정(q>=n의 sce:else 페어링을 건드리지 않는 구조). algorithm 주석 + reference 설명 갱신.
verification_bullets: layer3_serial_framing 4 test 통과(deterministic byte-compare라 flaky 불가). full-frame byte-identity는 corpus 전체(254-payload→261-envelope, 256, 300, MTU1500 포함)에서 wz==pico. cobs+crc32 기본기 parity는 수정 전 254-입력에서 FAIL했다가(발견) 수정 후 PASS.

발견된 COBS 버그의 증거: wz cobs_encode(254×0x01)=255B, pico _z_cobs_encode=256B(trailing 0x01). pico _z_cobs_encode trace(encoding.c:33-44)로 0xFF flush 후 pos 전진 + loop 종료 후 *codep=code(=1) 확인. full-frame이 통과했던 이유: corpus envelope가 254-경계에 안 닿음. 실제 페이로드의 envelope가 254-run으로 끝나면 wz<->pico 프레임 1B 차이=interop 깨짐 → 수정 필요.

회귀 없음: cobs_encode.scxml 수정은 254-at-EOF에만 추가(다른 케이스 불변). wz-codecs serial_framing.rs R311ns 손수-vector 6개 통과. cobs_decode는 이미 trailing 0x01 처리(기본기 decode parity + full-frame decode 통과). no-alloc/MCU도 동일 SCE 재생성(Layer G), 1516 bound이 trailing 0x01 수용(254-multiple 최대 입력 1270→1276<1516).

직접 확인: bindgen 생성 시그니처(*mut u8/*const u8/usize/u8 -> usize/u32), libzenohpico.a nm에 5 심볼 T(정의)로 존재 → 링크 안전. AnyLocator coupling: 1차 build에서 E0004(non-exhaustive) 적발→wz-runtime-tokio에 transport-link-serial 추가로 해소.

DEFAULT_LINK_MTU(65535) 상속 대신 1450 보고 -> SessionLinkActions::negotiated_batch_mtu의 min(own,peer,link) 3번째 항이 65535 default 아래로 binding. send_blocking 주석 갱신: MAX_UDP_PAYLOAD(65507) 드롭가드는 transport가 1450으로 pre-fragment하므로 이제 defensive backstop. crates/wz-runtime-tokio/tests/udp_frag_e2e.rs(신규, cfg all(transport-fragmentation, transport-link-udp)): link-MTU-driven UDP fragmentation e2e. acceptor가 peek_from(MSG_PEEK)로 initiator src 학습 후 DialedLink::Udp{socket,peer}로 accept_and_open_session; 양단 default 65535 batch 광고 -> negotiated_batch_mtu()==1450(by-construction 단언). 4096B Put이 ~3 datagram으로 fragment, peer가 reassemble byte-exact. serial_pty_e2e의 UDP sibling / layer3_reassembly_tx(TCP stream)의 datagram complement -- 각 Fragment=별도 datagram(스트림 프레이밍 없는 reassembly across datagrams)은 두 sibling 미커버 UDP-specific 경로.

값 결정: carry note(R311nx/ny)가 가정한 65507은 OS datagram max(이미 MAX_UDP_PAYLOAD 드롭가드로 존재)이고 link MTU(fragmentation 예산)가 아님. pico 소스 직접 검증으로 unicast/udp.c:97 + multicast/udp.c:106 둘 다 1450 확인 -> pico-faithful 1450 채택(evidence>assumptions, 사용자 confirm). run-ci 수정 불필요: layer_c1l_reassembly가 cargo test -p wz-runtime-tokio --features transport-fragmentation(default의 transport-link-udp 유지)로 e2e 자동 실행(layer3_reassembly_tx와 동일 메커니즘).
verification_bullets: scope: link_mtu()는 unicast 경로 전용(SessionLinkActions::negotiated_batch_mtu에만 피드). multicast는 별도 LinkDriver::send 경로(R311ko 자체 fragmentation)라 UdpWriteDriver override 무관 -- multicast_glue가 BoxedLinkDriver::link_mtu 미사용 확인.

유닛 테스트 4/4 통과(신규 udp_write_driver_reports_udp_link_mtu 포함). e2e udp_frag_e2e 통과 + 20/20 반복 non-flaky(loopback ~3 sub-1450 datagram + 소량 핸드셰이크 datagram << recv buffer = 무손실; 핸드셰이크는 static_scout_open::open_session_at_udp_reaches_established 선례로 안정).
clippy default + transport-fragmentation 2 레인 -D warnings exit 0(doc_lazy_continuation 1건=유닛테스트 doc의 줄-시작 '>' -> 줄바꿈 조정), cargo fmt --check clean.

session.rs: LivelinessOptions struct + impl ungated. session.rs: LivelinessToken struct + impl + Drop ungated. Struct definition unconditional (fields are all unconditional types: Session/u64/String/LivelinessOptions). session.rs: LivelinessAliasError enum ungated and extended with a `FeatureDisabled` variant covering the case where the `liveliness-token` feature is OFF at the crate level. session.rs: Session::declare_token return type unified from Result<_, OutboundKeyexprError> to Result<_, LivelinessAliasError> — InvalidKeyexpr variant absorbs the keyexpr-gate reject so the two declare_token{,_aliased} surfaces now share one error type. The pico-gate reject path translates SendDeclareError::Keyexpr into LivelinessAliasError::InvalidKeyexpr instead of returning OutboundKeyexprError directly.

session.rs: Session::declare_token{_aliased} ungated. session.rs: LivelinessSubscriberOptions / QueryableOptions / QueryOptions structs + impls ungated (Options-only cascade). session.rs: QueryOptions::with_target / with_consolidation / with_timeout_ms signature-stabilized per R311g1 anchor. session.rs: ConsolidationMode / QueryTarget imports ungated (the types are referenced from the now-unconditional QueryOptions struct fields + builder bodies). QueryMetadata import + expected_finals / query_metadata private helpers stay cfg-gated on `query-get` to match their sole caller `Session::query`, which keeps the unconditional `impl QueryOptions` block free of `dead_code` warnings under `--no-default-features`.

session.rs: OutboundKeyexprError import ungated. The type is wrapped by LivelinessAliasError::InvalidKeyexpr which is itself unconditional after the R311o cascade, so the import must follow the unconditional path.

Round 311og.decision_summary: R311og: mTLS + cert-PEM 로딩. 신규 tls_config 모듈(client/server_config_from_pem)이 PEM->rustls config 빌드(zenoh-rust utils.rs + pico session_cfg cert 키 미러); mTLS는 옵션 인자(client_auth/client_ca)로 표현, dial_tls/accept_tls/TlsDialConfig 시그니처 무변경. e2e 3종(mutual-auth Established / mTLS 익명거부 / plain-PEM Established) + C1u 배선. TLS 1.3 client-auth-after-finish 발견으로 서버측 거부를 enforcement 정본 증거로 채택. full run-ci(M+G) EXIT=0.
changes_bullets: crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/tls_config.rs (신규): PEM cert/key 로더. certs_from_pem/private_key_from_pem(rustls_pemfile, PKCS#1/8+SEC1 단일콜)/root_store_from_pem 프리미티브 + client_config_from_pem(root_ca_pem, Option<ClientAuthPem>)/server_config_from_pem(cert,key, Option<client_ca_pem>). mTLS는 옵션 인자(client_auth=with_client_auth_cert / client_ca=WebPkiClientVerifier+with_client_cert_verifier). ring provider builder_with_provider로 핀. zenoh-rust zenoh-link-tls/src/utils.rs + pico TLS session_cfg 키(ROOT_CA/CONNECT/LISTEN/ENABLE_MTLS) 미러.
crates/wz-runtime-tokio/Cargo.toml: rustls-pemfile = { version = "2", optional = true } 프로덕션 dep 추가; transport-link-tls feature가 dep:rustls-pemfile 포워드(tokio-rustls와 동일 gating, cert-free 빌드는 미컴파일).
crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/lib.rs: pub mod tls_config 선언(transport-link-tls 게이트, tls_pipeline 옆). tls_pipeline=핸드셰이크, tls_config=그 config를 PEM에서 빌드.

crates/wz-runtime-tokio-test-support/src/lib.rs: loopback_mtls_pems() fixture(tls-fixtures 게이트). 자가서명 CA 1개가 server leaf(SAN localhost, serverAuth EKU)+client leaf(clientAuth EKU) 서명; CA가 양방향 trust anchor. owned String만 반환(rustls/wz 타입 누출 0). loopback_tls_configs(자가서명 leaf, DER)와 별개의 CA 토폴로지.

crates/wz-runtime-tokio/tests/tls_pem_mtls_e2e.rs (신규): 3 테스트. mtls_mutual_auth_reaches_established(양측 PEM 로더로 mTLS config 빌드->Established), mtls_server_rejects_anonymous_client(mTLS 서버가 익명 클라 accept_tls err로 거부), plain_tls_from_pem_reaches_established(로더 None 경로=one-way PEM->Established). open_both_to_established 헬퍼로 reach-Established 2종 공유.
scripts/run-ci.sh: Layer C1u에 --test tls_pem_mtls_e2e 추가(defaults+tls가 transport-unicast 보유라 모듈 컴파일+실행; 없으면 빈 컴파일=gate-skew). clippy --all-targets --features transport-link-tls가 이미 모듈 lint.
verification_bullets: tls_pem_mtls_e2e 3 passed(mutual-auth/익명거부/plain-PEM) + 10/10 연속 non-flaky([[feedback-no-flaky-ever]]).
clippy 3종 전부 -D warnings exit 0: default+tls --all-targets / no-default-features+tls(tls_config standalone, transport-unicast 불요) / test-support tls-fixtures. fmt --check clean.

mTLS 강제 증거=서버가 익명 클라 거부(acc_res.is_err()). 발견: TLS 1.3에서 client-auth는 client Finished 이후라 dial_tls가 Ok 반환(서버가 그 후 빈 cert 거부->fatal alert는 다음 read에만 표면화). 내 dial_res.is_err() 단언이 TLS 1.3 모델 오해였음->제거(근본원인 수정, 우회 아님). 서버 거부가 정본 enforcement 신호.

Round 311oj.decision_summary: R311oj: TLS verify-name skip 노브 — client_config_from_pem에 ServerNameVerification(Verify/AnyName). AnyName=chain-to-root는 유지+SAN 이름만 skip(zenoh AnyServerName verifier 미러, dep 0). dial_tls 무변경.
changes_bullets: crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/tls_config.rs: ServerNameVerification{Verify,AnyName} pub enum(derive Clone/Copy/Debug/Eq) + AnyServerNameVerifier(private rustls ServerCertVerifier impl, zenoh WebPkiVerifierAnyServerName 미러 — verify_server_cert가 verify_server_cert_signed_by_trust_anchor로 chain-to-root+expiry만 검증하고 _server_name 무시; verify_tls12/13_signature·supported_verify_schemes는 ring provider 위임). client_config_from_pem에 name_verification 파라미터 추가: Verify=with_root_certificates(chain+name), AnyName=dangerous().with_custom_certificate_verifier(AnyServerNameVerifier). 두 arm 모두 WantsClientCert로 수렴해 아래 client-auth match 공유(server_config_from_pem 패턴과 동형).

검증 알고리즘은 ring::default_provider().signature_verification_algorithms(.all / supported_schemes)로 조달 — zenoh의 webpki::ALL_VERIFICATION_ALGS 직접 dep 회피(같은 알고리즘 set, 신규 dep 0개). rustls 0.23.40 client::danger + crypto::verify_tls12/13_signature + server::ParsedCertificate 경로(zenoh-link-commons/tls.rs와 동일).

dial_tls/accept_tls/TlsDialConfig 시그니처 무변경(R311og signature-stability) — 노브가 ClientConfig 내부 verifier 교체라 dial seam 무영향; rustls는 SNI용 ServerName 여전히 요구하고 verifier만 SAN 이름검증 skip. 모듈 doc에 "Server-name verification is a policy parameter" 절 추가, lib.rs tls_config 요약에 verify-name 노브 한 문장.

시나리오 udp_lossy_fragment_chain_aborts_then_channel_recovers: distinct oversize payload 2개(각 4KB>UDP_LINK_MTU) 순차 발행. P1의 2번째 fragment datagram drop→gap→frame게이트 admit_rx_frame_sn(precedes dist 2≤half) 통과→reassembly_dispatch consecutive(dist 2≠1) abort(OutOfOrder)+슬롯 release(고아 없음)→P1 미전달. Round 311on.decision_summary: R311on: dup-fragment finding 조사 결론(repo 무변경 진단). duplicate fragment가 SN-consecutive한 다음 메시지를 오염시키는 wz 버그 확정 — pico divergence(pico rx.c:225 M=0 무조건 finalize, wz Empty transition은 more 무시). 수정 R311oo 계획.
changes_bullets: 조사 결론(repo 무변경 진단 라운드, R311ok Task1/2 선례 동형; R311om OPEN finding 가설을 확정으로 격상): duplicate fragment가 자기 메시지뿐 아니라 SN-consecutive한 다음 메시지를 오염시킴. 3중 확정 — 코드추적 + pico 소스 대조 + Router 단위 재현(재현 테스트는 사용자 규칙대로 생성후 삭제).

메커니즘: 링크가 중간 fragment 중복 전달(F1,F2,F2dup,F3[more=0] 이어서 다음 메시지 P2). F2dup가 frame게이트 precedes(s+1,s+1)=dist0 reject→RxSnRejected→abort_channel이 P1 chain clear(sn.rs:163 admit, drive.rs:410). F3(more=0)가 frame게이트 통과 후 ingest_chain_start로 Begun=stuck orphan(reassembly_dispatch.rs:425-433; first_fragment_more_zero_does_not_complete 테스트가 이 동작 문서화), last_sn=s+2. P2F1(s+3)이 find_active로 orphan 발견→consecutive(s+2,s+3) CONTINUE→P2 payload를 F3꼬리 뒤에 append→Complete deliver [F3꼬리 ++ P2전체].

pico divergence 확정: pico _z_unicast_handle_fragment_inner(~/zenoh-pico rx.c:225) if(!M){decode}=M=0 fragment를 dbuf-first 여부 무관하게 무조건 즉시 finalize/decode. dup-clear 후 lone M=0는 단독 디코드 시도(garbage 실패)→drop→채널 clean→P2 fresh=merge 불가. wz reassembly_slot.scxml:89-92 Empty transition이 more 무시하고 무조건 begin_chain→Receiving("chain의 first fragment는 항상 M=1" 가정에 의존; 주석 86-88). dup/loss가 그 가정을 깨고 pico는 그 가정 없음.
empirical: Router 단위 재현(orphan M=0 + consecutive 다음 메시지) → actual [80,49,84,65,73,76,80,50,97,80,50,98]="P1TAILP2aP2b"(오염) vs expected "P2aP2b". 재현 후 삭제.
심각도: correctness + 메시지 무결성. lossy/reorder 링크 자연발생 또는 악의적 peer가 fragment 의도적 중복으로 피해자의 다음 메시지 오염. best-effort 손실은 허용이나 메시지간 내용 누수(merge)는 손실보다 나쁜 결함.
verification_bullets: 코드추적 검증: sn.rs:163 RxSn::admit(reject시 slot baseline 불변/admit시 Some(sn) advance), drive.rs:140-191 admit_rx_frame_sn(forward-gap admit + RxSnRejected→report_outcome_reassembling abort_channel), reassembly_dispatch.rs:402-477 ingest_chain_start(Empty transition more 무시)+ingest_continuation(consecutive append/complete), sn.rs:51-65 precedes dist∈(0,half] / consecutive dist==1.

pico 소스 직접 read(read-only reference, ~/zenoh-pico/src/transport/unicast/rx.c:145-265 _z_unicast_handle_fragment_inner): rx.c:225 if(!M) 무조건 finalize+decode; rx.c:198 markers-on시 "First fragment received without the start marker" drop(추가 가드); markers-off(wz 레짐)서도 M=0 즉시 decode가 merge 방지.
empirical 재현: ReassemblyDispatcher 단위 테스트(orphan M=0 frag 후 consecutive한 다음 메시지 2-frag) → 병합된 "P1TAILP2aP2b" 출력 확인(temp test 생성후 삭제, 사용자 규칙). 기존 reassembly_dispatch 13 테스트 무영향.
atomic: ledger entries 747->748, T1 orphan new=+0(13 불변), T3 warn 4 / T4 info 4 불변, inventory 무변경(진단 라운드=repo 무변경).
carry_forward_bullets: R311on = dup-fragment 버그 확정 진단(R311om OPEN finding 격상, repo 무변경; R311ok Task1/2 진단 선례 동형). 다음 세션 = 수정 R311oo.

수정 R311oo 계획(pico parity 정렬 = M=0 항상 finalize): ①sources/network/reassembly_slot.scxml Empty transition을 more로 분기 — more!==0→Receiving(begin_chain), more===0→Complete(begin_chain+finalize_message); 주석 86-88 "unconditionally a chain start" 가정 정정; SCE regen. ②reassembly_dispatch.rs ingest_chain_start: step 후 get_current_state()==Complete면 deliver(&buf)+release+IngestOutcome::Reassembled 반환(현재 무조건 Begun); 주석 425-428 정정. ③회귀 테스트: orphan 미merge 단위(reassembly_dispatch tests) + dup-fragment e2e(udp_chaos_e2e; ChaosReadDriver에 duplicate_nth_matching=hold+reemit 추가, drop처럼 채널 복구 검증).

효과 예측: lone M=0 first가 즉시 complete→deliver→상위 reassembled_frame_outcome→parse_frame_payload가 garbage 디코드 실패→drop(pico와 동일)→채널 clean. happy-path(정상 multi-frag, first는 항상 M=1)는 Receiving 경로 유지=무영향. 변경 영향은 M=0-first edge만. **first_fragment_more_zero_does_not_complete 테스트는 새 동작(즉시 complete)으로 갱신 필요**(현재 Begun stuck 단언이 버그 동작을 고정 중).
P3.10 chaos 트랙: drop-recovery(R311ol+om) DONE, dup는 버그 발견→R311oo 수정. 이후 reorder/latency/동시세션 stress(전부 외부의존無). cross-impl은 외부의존 잔존.
PUSHED: R311ol+om+on 전부 origin/main 도달(이 턴 push). NEXT=R311oo 수정. 상세 [[project-pico-parity-status]] P3.10.

changes_bullets: crates/wz-runtime-tokio/tests/multicast_pubsub_loopback.rs: concurrent_peers_fragment_reassemble_in_isolation 추가 — 2 publisher(A,C; distinct 임시소켓→distinct source addr) + 1 subscriber(B). A,C가 distinct oversize Put(~200B, batch_size 64→T_MID_FRAGMENT chain)을 같은 그룹에 동시 전송→B reassembly 풀이 multicast_chain_key(source addr)로 두 chain 격리→둘 다 byte-exact 복구. 단언: delivered set=={payload_a,payload_c}(len 2, 각 byte-exact — cross-contamination이면 merge가 둘 중 어느 것과도 불일치/parse fail), active_peers()==2. JOIN admission settle(400ms) 후 동시 publish, poll-on-condition으로 두 delivery 대기. Layer M(ignored) — 기존 multicast_pubsub_loopback 레인(--features transport-multicast,transport-fragmentation)이 자동 커버=run-ci 배선 변경 불요.
verification_bullets: multicast_pubsub_loopback 3 passed(기존 2 + concurrent) + 12/12 연속 non-flaky([[feedback-no-flaky-ever]]). outcome-deterministic: per-source keying이라 OS가 A/C datagram을 어떻게 interleave하든 두 chain 격리 복구; loopback multicast no-drop, ~8 datagram 저용량=UDP burst overflow 없음.
clippy EXIT=0: wz-runtime-tokio --all-targets --features transport-multicast,transport-fragmentation -D warnings. fmt --all --check clean(delivered 선언 wrap 적용).

full host run-ci(WZ_RUN_LAYER_M=1 WZ_RUN_LAYER_G=1) RUNCI_EXIT=0(로그 직접 캡처, 파이프 없음 [[feedback-runci-verdict-exit-code-only]]) "all required layers pass" 17 레이어; error[E / test result:FAILED / panicked 각 0. Layer M에서 concurrent 테스트 실행.
atomic: ledger entries 750->751, T1 orphan new=+0(13 불변), T3 warn 4 / T4 info 4 불변, inventory 무변경(테스트 라운드=신규 feature atom 아님).
carry_forward_bullets: R311oq = 멀티캐스트 multi-peer 동시 reassembly isolation e2e(P3.10 "pool/quota under load" 동시성 트랙). production 코드 무변경=순수 테스트 라운드. 기존 단일-publisher oversize 멀티캐스트 e2e가 검증 못한 동시 multi-chain 격리(source-addr keying)를 실소켓 실증.

설계 결정: deadline-sweep e2e는 의도적 회피 — reassembly deadline이 drive loop select! wake를 arm하지 않고 keepalive/lease wake(lease/3≈3.3s) 타이밍에 piggyback(session_glue.rs:737-743)이라 wall-clock fragile(2중 타이밍 윈도우: 500ms deadline<keepalive wake<P2 publish). sweep 메커니즘은 sweep_times_out_expired_chains_only 단위로 이미 결정적 검증됨→e2e 한계효용 낮음+flaky 위험. multi-peer는 outcome-deterministic이라 non-flaky.

P3.10 chaos/robustness 트랙 정리: wire-perturbation 3종 drop(ol+om)/dup(on진단→oo)/reorder(op) + concurrent multi-peer isolation(oq) DONE. 남은 로컬은 사실상 소진(latency/jitter=wall-clock fragile+단위 커버, 추가 stress=한계효용 낮음). 다음 frontier는 외부의존(cross-impl pico interop·wz=Client→pico=peer-listen·zenoh-full router=미체크아웃).

changes_bullets: scripts/build-zenohd.sh (신규): zenohd v1.5.0를 CLAUDE.md-참조 cargo git 체크아웃(~/.cargo/git/checkouts/zenoh-*/)에서 빌드(toolchain 1.85.0=zenoh rust-toolchain.toml pin, CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/zenohd-build)→target/zenohd/zenohd 설치. build-zenoh-pico-cli.sh 컨벤션 미러(idempotent, install -m 0755). zenoh는 wz dep 아니므로 체크아웃 부재 시 cargo install zenohd@1.5.0 대안 안내.

crates/wz-integration-tests/src/lib.rs: zenohd_binary() locator(WZ_ZENOHD_BIN env 또는 target/zenohd/zenohd; zenoh_pico_cli_binary 옆 SSOT) + wait_for_tcp_accept(TCP-accept readiness probe). 설계: zenohd는 startup 로그를 non-TTY fd에 block-buffer해 stderr-substring wait가 flush와 레이스(empty capture 실증)→TCP-accept가 listener-ready 신호.

crates/wz-integration-tests/tests/wz_to_zenohd_router.rs (신규): 2 테스트. ①wz_client_reaches_established_against_zenohd: wz-ap-demo --connect zenohd→"session Established"(결정적; wz-ap-demo가 이미 args.rs version 0x09+whatami Client). ②wz_publish_routes_through_zenohd_to_pico_zsub: wz Put→zenohd가 keyexpr로 라우팅→pico z_sub "Received". z_sub는 spawn_subscribed_zsub로 transient open 실패("Unable to open session!") 재시도(pico one-shot은 self-retry 안 함; wz측 결정적이라 외부 바이너리 robustness). 공유 하니스(ChildGuard/wait_for_substring/PortReservation)=pico interop과 동일 SSOT.

scripts/run-ci.sh: Layer Z(layer_z_zenohd_interop, opt-in --layer Z/WZ_RUN_LAYER_Z=1) 신설 — zenohd 또는 z_sub 부재 시 graceful SKIP(Layer M/E prereq 패턴), wz-ap-demo 빌드 후 wz_to_zenohd_router 실행. dispatch에 run_layer Z.

Round 311os.decision_summary: R311os: liveliness-get flake 근본수정. acceptor token을 drive inbound 처리 前 pre-drive 동기 선언(R249 register-before-serve SSOT)→CURRENT interest가 token 미등록 시 빈 reply받던 ordering race를 구조적 제거. teardown 순서 보존. settle/timeout 거부.
changes_bullets: crates/wz-ap-demo/src/runner.rs: liveliness token을 spawn_background_tasks/drive_session 前 run_demo의 pre-drive 단계에서 session.declare_token으로 동기 선언(R249 register-before-serve 선례 일관 적용). token을 teardown 체인에 직접 전달(token_rx oneshot 제거). spawn_background_tasks에서 token_tx/oneshot 제거 + has_declares를 subscriber||queryable로.
crates/wz-ap-demo/src/tasks.rs: declare_task에서 token 분기 + token_tx 파라미터 제거(subscriber/queryable outbound declare만 유지; 이들은 peer remote registry로의 fire-and-forget이라 inbound-snapshot race 없음).

crates/wz-ap-demo/src/teardown.rs: TeardownInitial/TasksJoined의 token_rx: Option<oneshot::Receiver<LivelinessToken>>→token: Option<LivelinessToken>(동기 선언이라 oneshot 불요). drop_liveliness_token을 동기 drop으로(recv 제거); R284 UndeclToken-before-Close 순서 불변식 보존. unused oneshot import 제거.

crates/wz-integration-tests/tests/wz_remote_declare_round_trip.rs: SIGTERM 前 세 REMOTE * DECLARED를 order-independent로 모두 대기(token이 이제 pre-drive 첫째라 "token=마지막" 가정이 깨져 SIGTERM이 queryable과 경쟁하던 것 수정); final_text를 undecl-후 스냅샷으로.
verification_bullets: root cause: acceptor declare_task(Established-gated 백그라운드 태스크)가 drive_session과 동시 실행→initiator의 CURRENT liveliness-get interest가 token 로컬등록 前 drive 루프에서 처리되면 one-shot reply가 비어 timeout(load가 윈도우 확대). 수정=token을 drive inbound 처리 前 pre-drive 동기 등록→어떤 interest든 token 발견=레이스 표현 불가([[feedback-unrepresentable-over-test]]). settle-delay/timeout-bump(load mitigation) 거부=결정적 수정.

wz_liveliness_get_round_trip + wz_liveliness_subscriber_round_trip + wz_remote_declare_round_trip 각 pass. teardown 불변식 보존: token을 teardown 체인에 직접 전달, drop_liveliness_token이 Close 前 drop(UndeclToken)→wz_liveliness_subscriber/wz_remote_declare가 REMOTE TOKEN UNDECLARED 단언 통과. declare 순서가 token-first로 바뀌어 wz_remote_declare를 order-independent 대기로 적응(세 declare 모두 SIGTERM 前 대기).
flake 메모리 정정([[project-layer-e-flake-debt]]): R311or-recurrence 노트가 "load flake"로 framing했으나 실제는 token-declare ordering RACE였고 R311os가 구조적 해결. liveliness 케이스 RESOLVED.
zero-flake 입증: full run-ci M+G+Z 3/3 + zenohd interop standalone 30/30 + 구조적 race 제거(사용자 "단 한 건의 flake도 안돼" 지시).

changes_bullets: crates/wz-ap-demo/src/runner.rs: subscriber/queryable를 token과 함께 run_demo pre-drive 단계에서 동기 선언(actions.send_declare_subscriber/queryable + session.declare_token; R249 register-before-serve를 모든 declared kind에 일관 적용). DECLARE_SUBSCRIBER_ID/QUERYABLE_ID(1001/2001)를 tasks.rs→runner.rs 이동. spawn_background_tasks에서 declare_spec 파라미터 + declare_task spawn + has_declares + declare_handle 제거.

crates/wz-ap-demo/src/tasks.rs: declare_task 함수 + DECLARE_*_ID/HANDSHAKE_POLL/HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT/INTER_EMIT 상수 5종 삭제(전 declare가 pre-drive 동기라 백그라운드 태스크 불요). vestigial Established-poll 루프(세션은 run_demo 진입 시 이미 Established) + DECLARE_INTER_EMIT_MS=100ms 타이밍 smell 제거. DeclareEmitSpec import + 모듈 doc/주석 참조 정리.
crates/wz-ap-demo/src/teardown.rs: declare_handle 필드(TeardownInitial) + 200ms join(abort_sweep_join_tasks) 제거. SpawnedTasks/SpawnedTasks-doc 갱신.
crates/wz-integration-tests/tests/wz_remote_declare_round_trip.rs: 주석 갱신 — declares가 이제 pre-drive 동기로 결정적 순서(sub→queryable→token); order-independent 대기는 robust 관행으로 유지(순서 가정 안 함).
verification_bullets: 세션리뷰(사용자 "hack/smell 없이 교과서적? 비용 무관 장기 구조? SSOT?") concern ① 해소: R311os가 token만 pre-drive로 옮겨 R249를 부분 적용→subscriber/queryable는 여전히 declare_task(post-drive 백그라운드, vestigial Established-poll + 100ms inter-emit sleep, 그로 인한 order-dependence가 wz_remote_declare 우회를 강제)였던 SSOT 불일치 smell을 제거. 이제 전 declare가 pre-drive 동기=R249 일관 적용, declare_task 은퇴.

carry_forward_bullets: R311oy = --declare-subscriber/--declare-queryable CLI 은퇴(저급 raw-emit hook 제거). carry 전제("--key/--queryable가 완전 흡수")가 부분적으로만 맞음을 진단([[feedback-diagnose-before-carry]]): 이 플래그들은 send_declare_*(로컬 등록 없는 raw emit + controllable hard-coded id 1001/2001)로 --key/--queryable(routed, auto entity id, 로컬 등록)과 다른 일=완전 redundant 아님. 하지만 raw-emit-no-register는 production에 없는 인위적 경로(실제 앱은 받으려고 선언하므로 로컬 등록 없는 DeclSubscriber emit은 무의미)라, round-trip 테스트를 실제 routed 경로(--key/--queryable)+cross-log id 파싱으로 마이그레이션=인위적 hook 대신 실제 production declare 경로를 e2e 검증=텍스트북 개선([[feedback-textbook-over-cost]]). --declare-token은 session.declare_token(고급 RAII)이라 같은 boat 아님=유지.

설계 결정: (1) round-trip 테스트 id가 hard-coded(1001/2001)→auto-allocated; extract_id_after로 acceptor 로그 파싱→initiator echo cross-reference(왕복 fidelity를 상수보다 충실히 검증). 토큰은 alloc_next_token_id 별도 counter라 --key/--queryable이 앞서 할당해도 id=0 불변. (2) r300 queryable 케이스는 --reply 필수(--queryable-needs-reply 검증이 R300 eager gate보다 먼저 실행; queryable_spec이 Some이어야 gate가 keyexpr 검사). (3) --declare-token 유지(고급 RAII liveliness token; --key/--queryable 같은 저급 redundancy 아님). (4) session-core send_declare_subscriber/queryable 유지(session_glue 단위 테스트가 byte-stable-wire 검증으로 호출=pub API).

linchpin 검증: --key/--queryable가 pre-Established --listen acceptor에서 buffer+emit 동작 확인(FSM이 Established까지 emit hold, role 무관). round-trip acceptor "DECLARED ROUTED SUBSCRIBER id=1"+"DECLARED ROUTED QUERYABLE id=1"→initiator "REMOTE SUBSCRIBER/QUERYABLE DECLARED id=1" echo, cross-log 파싱(sub_id=1,q_id=1) 동작.

Round 311p.decision_summary: R311p signature-stability sweep — send_undeclare_kexpr/subscriber/queryable converted from entire-fn cfg-gate to body cfg-gate + silent no-op per R311g1 anchor (mirror R311o send_undeclare_token pattern).
changes_bullets: session_glue.rs: send_undeclare_kexpr signature-stabilized. `#[cfg(all(declare-keyexpr, declare-undeclare))]` on the entire fn replaced by inner body cfg-gate + silent no-op (`let _ = mapping_id`) when either feature is off. The outbound_mappings table prune (R234) stays inside the cfg-gated branch since a feature-off build never populated the table to begin with.

session_glue.rs: send_undeclare_subscriber signature-stabilized. Same R311g1 pattern as above (`all(declare-subscriber, declare-undeclare)` body-cfg + silent no-op). Couples with a future-round Subscriber::Drop type-ungating that will call this unconditionally.

session_glue.rs: send_undeclare_queryable signature-stabilized. Same R311g1 pattern as above (`all(declare-queryable, declare-undeclare)` body-cfg + silent no-op). Couples with a future-round Queryable::Drop type-ungating that will call this unconditionally.

Net effect: every send_(un)declare_* fn in session_glue.rs now follows the R311g1 signature-stability anchor uniformly (send_declare_* already signature-stable per prior rounds; send_undeclare_token landed R311o; send_undeclare_kexpr/subscriber/queryable land here). principled-exemption carry in the signature-stability MEMORY anchor narrows further.

changes_bullets: crates/wz-runtime-tokio/tests/session_reconnect_e2e.rs: queryable_declares_replay_after_link_loss_and_reconnect 신설(base TCP 테스트 declares_replay_after_link_loss_and_reconnect의 queryable sibling). 클라이언트가 send_declare_queryable(10, 0, Some("home/qry-reconnect"))로 routed가 아닌 raw-emit queryable을 declare→acceptor가 Declare(DeclQueryable) 관측→link 급단절(Close frame 없는 link-loss shape)→reconnect supervisor가 re-dial+re-handshake→connection #2가 declaration cache에서 replay된 동일 Declare(DeclQueryable) 관측(declares_conn2==declares_conn1 verbatim, reconnects()==1, ReconnectDriveOutcome::Stopped). 기존 accept_and_collect_declares 헬퍼 재사용(NetworkMessage::Declare(_) kind-agnostic 수집이라 queryable 전용 하니스 불필요). 모듈 doc에 queryable sibling 한 줄 보강(subscriber=canonical, queryable sibling=같은 cache-walk가 DeclQueryable kind replay 증명; transport 변종 TLS/WS/GaveUp은 replay loop이 kind-agnostic이라 subscriber-only by design).

프로덕션 코드 변경 없음=순수 테스트 추가. send_declare_queryable wrapper(session_actions.rs:2146)는 prepare_declare_queryable+dispatch_declare+cache_queryable_declaration로 send_declare_subscriber와 구조 동형, replay_one의 CachedDeclaration::Queryable arm(session_actions.rs:3419-3434)이 build_declare_queryable+dispatch_declare로 정상 재emit=queryable reconnect replay 경로는 이미 완전 구현+작동(코드결함 아님). 갭은 순수 e2e 커버리지 비대칭: send_declare_queryable은 session_glue unit test 3건만 호출, send_declare_subscriber는 reconnect e2e 4건(TCP/GaveUp/TLS/WS) 호출.

스코프 결정(YAGNI): TLS/WS/GaveUp queryable 변종 미추가. 이들은 transport(TLS re-handshake/WS RFC6455 upgrade/GaveUp-resume) 차이지 declaration-kind 차이가 아니고, replay cache-walk가 declaration-kind-agnostic(단일 루프+per-variant arm)이라 동일 replay loop 재증명=test bloat. subscriber가 이미 transport reconnect 증명. core TCP queryable replay 1건이 send_declare_queryable e2e 비대칭을 닫고 replay_one Queryable arm을 e2e 가드.

changes_bullets: crates/wz-runtime-tokio/tests/session_reconnect_e2e.rs: 세션리뷰(독립 4-에이전트) R311pc 결함 2종 수정. (1) false-green: queryable/subscriber reconnect-replay 테스트가 Declare가 어떤 kind인지 한 번도 단언 안 함(len==1 + conn2==conn1만)→send_declare_queryable이 DeclSubscriber로 오배선돼도 green. (2) SSOT: 84줄 driver body 거의-바이트동일 복제. 수정=ReplayDeclareKind{Subscriber,Queryable} enum + 단일 driver assert_declare_replays_after_link_loss(keyexpr, kind)로 수렴, kind.marker()("DeclSubscriber"/"DeclQueryable"=DeclareOwnedVariant Debug 부분문자열)로 conn1[0] kind 양방향 positively 단언. 두 #[tokio::test]는 helper 호출 thin fn. subscriber 테스트도 이제 DeclSubscriber 단언(기존엔 미단언=개선). kind marker 상호배타(DeclQueryable !⊂ subscriber Debug)라 mis-wire 시 실패=실제 게이트. 중복 driver 제거(declare-action만 차이)는 파일 자신의 "replay loop kind-agnostic" 논증의 정직한 적용(내 doc가 TLS/WS 불필요라면서 TCP body 복제한 아이러니 해소). TLS/WS/GaveUp queryable 변종 미추가 YAGNI는 유지(transport 재증명=bloat).

Round 311pi.decision_summary: R311pi: 세션리뷰 후속 3/4 — R311pf 구조 결함. spawn_zenohd에 Established-level readiness probe(throwaway wz client) 추가로 TCP-accept vs handshake-ready cold-start 갭 구조적 폐쇄 + R311pf 주석 과신→정직한 가설로 정정(zenohd stall 미배제) + category error(z_get=propagation≠open transient) 정정. retry=client-side starvation 안전망 재서술.
changes_bullets: 세션리뷰(root-cause-analyst 에이전트) R311pf 구조 결함 수정. (구조) spawn_zenohd readiness가 wait_for_tcp_accept(커널 SYN accept만 증명, handshake-ready 미증명)였음→cold-start 갭(listener up vs transport/routing 스케줄됨)을 bare TCP-accept gate가 미커버. 수정=wait_for_zenohd_handshake_ready 추가: throwaway wz-ap-demo --connect --publish wz/zenohd/readiness-probe가 "session Established" 도달 확인 후 spawn_zenohd 반환(wz open=in-process 결정적, foreign one-shot 미해당이라 신뢰적; probe는 전용 keyexpr라 테스트 무간섭, 반환 전 kill=routing state 무잔존). zenohd cold-start 갭=구조적 폐쇄(더 결정적). (주석 정직화) spawn_subscribed_zsub R311pf 주석 과신 정정: 실패 synthetic 재현 못 함→원인은 가설(verified fact 아님), zenohd handshake STALL 미배제(증상이 pico측 z_open()<0이라 clean zenohd log+pico timeout 구별불가). R311pi가 actionable 부분(cold-start) 구조적 폐쇄, retry는 client-side starvation 안전망으로 재서술. (category error 정정) 종전 "same reasoning covers inline z_get retry"는 틀림→z_get/z_get_liveliness/wz--query retry는 route/declaration propagation 창(이해됨)이지 open transient 아님=별개 현상 명시.

changes_bullets: wz-runtime-tokio lib.rs: pub use wz_session_core::locator 재노출(facade 경유 parse_any_locator/AnyLocator 접근). locator leaf는 ungated라 transport-link-* feature 무관 항상 컴파일.

wz-ap-demo runner.rs: establish_link 반환 io::Result<TcpStream>->io::Result<DialedLink>. Initiator arm이 --connect에 스킴 구분자 '/'가 있으면 parse_any_locator->dial_locator(DialConfig::default())로 dial(ws/ 스킴=WebSocket), 없으면 기존 TcpStream::connect->DialedLink::Tcp(하위호환=기존 7 TCP leg 경로 byte-for-byte 불변). 호출처 DialedLink::Tcp(stream) 래핑 제거.
wz-ap-demo Cargo.toml: connect-ws=[wz/transport-link-ws, wz/locator-ws] opt-in feature 신설. default(preset-ap-client) 미포함=footprint baseline+기존 레인 빌드 무영향.

R311pi tcp probe 대칭 누락. 수정=wait_for_zenohd_handshake_ready locator-parameterize(ws/127.0.0.1:{ws_port} real WS handshake probe=upgrade 보내 wedge 안 함).

F는 host-only라 python3 부재 graceful SKIP 추가(일관성). WZ_RUN_LAYER_F/G/Q/Z 참조/usage 전면 제거(M만 유지).

run-ci.sh: M은 opt-in 유지 — multicast route 정적 감지 불가(IGMP join은 socket bind시에만 실패)라 no-flaky(crit) > SSOT 위해. 헤더/SKIP 메시지를 cost 아닌 environment-flaky 경계(R311pt 후 유일 opt-in)로 명시. Z 'never gates default sweep' -> presence-check 경계로 정정.

ci.yml: primary ci job에 Layer F step 추가(host-only, footprint elision CI 자동). cross-mcu job 코멘트의 R311iw 'without slowing pre-push' 근거 정정 — CI-only는 push에만 발화해 미push arc(R311p* ~20라운드)에 취약, pre-push default-on이 1차 게이트 CI는 toolchain 미러.
pre-push: 코드 변경 0(이미 env 없이 run-ci 전체 실행 -> default-on 전환만으로 F/G/Q/Z 자동 게이트). 헤더 코멘트만 default-on lane 목록 + MCU 빌드 비용 반영 갱신.

wz-runtime-tokio/src/reconnect.rs: reconnect_endpoint(connect:&str, params, cfg, clock, policy, max_iters, tick)->Result<ReconnectingSession,OpenError> seam 추가 — dial_endpoint(string→DialedLink)/accept_endpoint 대칭인 string→ReconnectingSession 라이브러리 SSOT(plan_endpoint+ReconnectLocator::try_from+open_session_with_reconnect 오케스트레이션을 라이브러리가 소유; 데모 hand-assembly 제거). into_teardown이 bare tuple 대신 named ReconnectTeardown{actions,writer_handle} 반환; GaveUp-after-handshake-fail시 last-ESTABLISHED writer 반환=degenerate-but-correct drain 계약 문서화(실패한 reopen 반쪽링크는 session 없어 graceful Close 불요).

wz-ap-demo/src/runner.rs: 인라인 plan_endpoint+try_from+open_session_with_reconnect를 reconnect_endpoint 단일 호출로 교체(seam 중복 제거). race_against_shutdown<O>(fut,noun)->Option<O> 헬퍼로 OneShot/Reconnect drive arm의 select!-shutdown shell + None-arm 로그 SSOT화. ReconnectTeardown destructure(_actions discard 자기설명적). plan_endpoint/ReconnectLocator import 제거.

wz-integration-tests/tests/wz_initiator_to_wz_acceptor.rs: 신규 reconnect 라운드트립 테스트의 Child::kill(SIGKILL)→graceful_terminate(SIGTERM, 5s) 전환 + "reconnect session cancelled by graceful-shutdown signal" teardown 로그 pin(into_teardown 경로 유일 자동 커버). 신규 음성 2테스트: wz_reconnect_with_listen_is_rejected(--reconnect+--listen→exit2), wz_reconnect_serial_connect_is_not_reconnectable(serial --connect --reconnect→NotReconnectable exit1, 무소켓).
verification_bullets: 출처=R311px 독립 4-에이전트 적대 자가감사(architect/quality/refactoring/root-cause). 적발: architect [MAJOR] reconnect_endpoint seam 부재(plan_endpoint pub은 증상; 데모가 string→ReconnectingSession 오케스트레이션을 hand-assemble=R311pm/ps seam 규율 역행), quality [MAJOR] 테스트 SIGKILL로 into_teardown(신규 코드) 미커버 + [MAJOR/carry] 바이너리 sever-reconnect 미테스트, root-cause [MINOR] GaveUp-after-handshake-fail시 stale writer handle, refactoring [MINOR] select!-shutdown shell 중복. SOUND(액션0, 교차검증): 2-axes(capability vs lifecycle), Role::Initiator{reconnect} unrepresentable, into_teardown drain 불변(3에이전트가 SwappableLink 2-Arc 토폴로지 직접 추적), &mut dispatch 공유, positive pin 강함, flake-safety. 성급한 self-assessment 9번째 뒤집힘.

#3 stale-handle: code correct-by-construction(into_teardown=last-ESTABLISHED writer; handshake 실패한 reopen 반쪽링크는 Established 미달=session 없음=graceful Close 불요, orphaned writer는 actions drop시 종료)이라 invasive initiator_open 변경 대신 계약 명시로 해소(architect+root-cause 둘 다 degenerate-but-correct 수렴; shape 자체가 correct라 doc-around-hack 아님).

#7 바이너리 sever-reconnect 풀 e2e: NO-DEFERRAL 대상이나 두 구현경로 모두 실 flake-risk(in-process acceptor=fixture vs demo params 호환성 미검; 2-process rebind=bind_tcp SO_REUSEADDR 부재 TIME_WAIT). 성급 구현은 no-flaky(테스트엔 no-deferral보다 엄격) 위반. 기능은 완성+라이브러리 session_reconnect_e2e가 re-dial+replay 메커니즘 verbatim 증명(3에이전트가 바이너리=동일 drive loop 확인)+바이너리는 happy-path/graceful-teardown/arg-validation 커버. coverage-depth carry로 추적(de-risk 후 구현)=quality 에이전트가 'defensible deferral, not false-green'으로 판정한 항목.

Round 311pz.decision_summary: R311pz: bind_tcp/bind_tcp_host에 SO_REUSEADDR(zenoh listener parity, TcpSocket bind_listener_reuseaddr SSOT). 재시작 acceptor 고정포트 TIME_WAIT rebind 가능 — 바이너리 sever-reconnect e2e de-risk 레버. socket2 결정적 pin 2.
changes_bullets: crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/link_pipeline.rs: bind_tcp/bind_tcp_host가 신규 private SSOT bind_listener_reuseaddr(addr)로 위임 — TcpSocket::new_v4/v6 -> set_reuseaddr(true) -> bind -> listen(1024). zenoh upstream(io/zenoh-link-commons/src/tcp.rs:51) listener 패턴 패리티. 종전 TcpListener::bind은 pre-bind setsockopt 훅이 없어 SO_REUSEADDR 설정 불가였음.

bind_tcp_host: TcpListener::bind(host) 단일 호출 -> lookup_host(host) 해석 후 resolved addr를 bind_listener_reuseaddr로 순차 시도(TcpStream::connect의 ToSocketAddrs 워크 미러; 첫 성공 반환, 전부 실패 시 last_err). 시그니처 불변(async fn -> io::Result<TcpListener>)이라 호출부 accept_locator(session_open.rs:450/456) .await 안정.

신규 unit 2종(socket2 옵션 read = 타이밍 무관 결정적 pin): bind_tcp_sets_so_reuseaddr / bind_tcp_host_sets_so_reuseaddr. into_std -> socket2::Socket::from -> reuse_address() assert. 미래에 bare TcpListener::bind으로 회귀하면 flaky rebind가 아니라 이 unit에서 포착.
verification_bullets: 근본: bind_tcp(link_pipeline.rs:93)가 SO_REUSEADDR 미설정 -> 고정포트 acceptor 재시작이 ~60s TIME_WAIT EADDRINUSE = production 재연결 견고성 결함(zenoh는 모든 listener에 set_reuseaddr). carry #1(바이너리 sever-reconnect e2e)의 2-process rebind flake-risk의 근본 원인.

경로 결정 근거(독립 4-에이전트 조사): zenoh 정본은 TcpSocket+set_reuseaddr(true) listener-only(dial측 미설정, SO_REUSEPORT 없음); wz bind_tcp는 TcpListener::bind 직접; 라이브러리 e2e fixture는 테스트파일 private(외부 미노출); 데모 accept_tcp는 one-shot. 경로(a)in-process는 하이브리드+parity결함 방치라 기각, 경로(b)production fix 채택 — 진짜 두 바이너리+진짜 sever로 더 강한 증명이자 standalone parity 청산.

검증: fmt clean(crates workspace), clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean(wz-runtime-tokio), link_pipeline unit 4/4(신규 socket2 pin 2 포함), session_reconnect_e2e 4/4 회귀0(base/queryable/named/gaveup). 시그니처 불변이라 호출부 무변경. full run-ci(F+G+Q+M+Z)는 push시 pre-push 훅(R311pt default-on)이 게이트.
carry_forward_bullets: R311pz = 바이너리 sever-reconnect e2e(carry #1)의 de-risk 레버. bind_tcp/bind_tcp_host에 SO_REUSEADDR(zenoh listener parity, bind_listener_reuseaddr SSOT). 재시작 acceptor가 고정포트를 TIME_WAIT 위로 rebind 가능 -> 2-process e2e의 EADDRINUSE flake 구조적 제거. 테스트 무관 standalone production parity 결함 청산.

다음(carry #1 본체): 2-process 바이너리 sever-reconnect e2e 구현. 설계=포트P 예약 -> A1(--listen P)+sub -> initiator(--connect P --reconnect) -> 초기 라운드트립 -> A1 kill -> A2(--listen P) respawn -> A2 신규프로세스 'SUBSCRIBER FIRED' = 재연결 witness. 데모 max=None 무한재시도라 A2 기동 gap도 backoff 수렴. 해소필요: 데모 reconnect-모드 publish cadence(runner.rs)로 observable 확정. 10x non-flake 확인 필수(no-flaky).

changes_bullets: crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/declare.rs: drop `#[cfg(feature = "liveliness-subscriber")]` on `mod liveliness_subscriber` and on `pub use liveliness_subscriber::{LivelinessSample, LivelinessSampleCallback, LivelinessSampleKind, LivelinessSubscriberRegistry}` so the registry types are unconditional re-exports. Architectural carve-out comment added documenting that wz-codecs hardcodes `codec-declare` in the dep table so `wz_codecs::declare::DeclareVariant` is always available regardless of the wz-runtime-tokio consumer-side `codec-declare` gate.

crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/declare/liveliness_subscriber.rs: `NetworkMessage::Declare(decl)` match arm inside `dispatch_messages` cfg-gated on `feature = "codec-declare"` (the variant itself is gated at session_glue.rs); `dispatch_messages` adds an `#[cfg(not(feature = "codec-declare"))] let _ = peer_keyexpr_table;` lint-silencer so the signature stays stable across builds. `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` gated on `all(test, feature = "liveliness-subscriber", feature = "codec-declare")` so the test fixtures that consume `decl_token` / `undecl_token` / `NetworkMessage::Declare` only build when both features materialize their dependencies.

crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/observer.rs: `pub liveliness_subscribers: LivelinessSubscriberRegistry` field ungated; `ApplicationLayerObserver::new()` initializes the registry unconditionally; `use crate::declare::LivelinessSubscriberRegistry` import ungated. The dispatch fan-out call at `ApplicationLayerObserver::dispatch_event` stays cfg-gated on `feature = "liveliness-subscriber"` so a feature-OFF build still elides the dispatch path (the registry is constructed empty and never receives events).

crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/session.rs: `pub struct LivelinessSubscriber` + `impl LivelinessSubscriber` + `impl Drop for LivelinessSubscriber` all ungated; `pub enum LivelinessSubscriberAliasError` ungated and gains a `FeatureDisabled` variant; `impl std::fmt::Display` + `impl std::error::Error` ungated, Display gains the FeatureDisabled arm; `pub fn declare_liveliness_subscriber` signature switched from `-> LivelinessSubscriber` to `-> Result<LivelinessSubscriber, LivelinessSubscriberAliasError>` (closes the long-standing R283 carry on uniform Result-form across the declare_* surface); both `declare_liveliness_subscriber{_aliased}` bodies wrapped in `#[cfg(feature = "liveliness-subscriber")]` with `#[cfg(not(...))]` arms returning `Err(FeatureDisabled)`; the `use crate::declare::LivelinessSample` import becomes unconditional (callback parameter type on the unconditional signatures) while `use crate::declare::LivelinessSampleCallback` stays gated on `liveliness-subscriber` (only consumed inside the cfg-wrapped body `Box::new(...) as LivelinessSampleCallback` cast); the `LivelinessSubscriberOptions` R311o doc-comment closes the prior "deferred to a future round" carry.

crates/wz-ap-demo/src/runner.rs:342: the single `session.declare_liveliness_subscriber(...)` callsite gains `.expect("liveliness-subscriber feature is ON in wz-ap-demo default build")` for the new Result return. wz-ap-demo always builds with default features so the only possible Err variant on this site is `FeatureDisabled`, which would indicate a build-system misconfiguration rather than a runtime condition — `.expect` is the textbook shape per the R311 signature-stability principle.
