Round 311q1.decision_summary: R311q1: 4-에이전트 적대 리뷰 remediation. R311pz REVERT(tokio bind이 Unix서 이미 SO_REUSEADDR+resolve-loop=NIH no-op, 테스트 vacuous, de-risk 인과 거짓). e2e를 데이터플레인 재개 witness로 재작성(periodic publisher), DRY spawn_listen_acceptor.
changes_bullets: link_pipeline.rs: R311pz REVERT — bind_tcp/bind_tcp_host를 bare TcpListener::bind으로 복원, bind_listener_reuseaddr 헬퍼 + 2 단위 테스트 + TcpSocket/lookup_host import 제거. 근거: tokio TcpListener::bind이 Unix에서 이미 set_reuseaddr(true)를 bind 전 설정(mio-1.2.0 listener.rs:78-82, tokio-1.52.3 listener.rs:78 doc) + 이미 동일한 resolve+try-each+last_err 루프(tokio listener.rs:103-121) 수행. 변경은 그것의 NIH 재구현(Unix서 backlog 1024 vs 128 외 동작 no-op)이었고 단위 테스트는 vacuous(bare bind도 SO_REUSEADDR=true라 구별 불가, root-cause가 reverted 상태로 실증).

wz-ap-demo/src/tasks.rs: publisher_task에 long_lived: bool 인자 + reconnect 모드용 periodic 분기. emit_one_push(literal/aliased 4-arm 디스패치)를 추출(finite burst + periodic이 단일 사이트 공유, DRY) + publish_cycle(재-Established 대기 후 1 emit). long_lived 루프=biased select{shutdown_signal()=>break, publish_cycle=>continue}로 재연결마다 재무장 + graceful-shutdown에 clean exit(session clone drop이 teardown drop_actions 전 = writer last-sender 불변 유지).
wz-ap-demo/src/runner.rs: long_lived=matches!(&role, Role::Initiator{reconnect:true,..})를 spawn_background_tasks→publisher_task로 전달(acceptor long-lived publish는 표현불가).

wz-integration-tests/src/lib.rs: common::spawn_listen_acceptor(demo,addr,key,label,stderr_file)->(ChildGuard,File) 추가 — R305이 graceful_terminate에 적용한 per-test-중복 통합 선례(tempfile은 dev-dep이라 File 인자로 받아 lib 의존성 변경 회피).

wz-integration-tests/tests/wz_initiator_to_wz_acceptor.rs: 신규 e2e를 데이터플레인 재개 witness로 재작성(SO_REUSEADDR/TIME_WAIT 거짓 인과 제거) — initiator --connect --reconnect --publish(periodic), A1/A2 --listen --key; A1 SUBSCRIBER FIRED→A1 kill+reap→A2 동일포트 respawn→A2(신규 프로세스) 재연결 '후' Put로 SUBSCRIBER FIRED(데이터플레인 연속) + reconnects=1. 기존 acceptor spawn 2곳을 spawn_listen_acceptor로 통합(3 callers 1 헬퍼).
verification_bullets: 출처=R311pz+q0 독립 4-에이전트 적대 세션리뷰(architect/quality/refactoring/root-cause). 성급한 self-assessment 10번째 뒤집힘. 적발(전부 교차검증+나 직접 소스 확인): (MAJOR quality 실증) e2e가 SO_REUSEADDR를 게이트 안 함 — 변경 revert 후 10/10 PASS. 메커니즘: initiator가 link death 감지해 자기 half teardown + A1 SIGKILL 후 full reap → listening 포트에 lingering TIME_WAIT 없음 → bare 소켓 rebind OK. (MAJOR root-cause+나 검증) tokio TcpListener::bind이 Unix서 이미 SO_REUSEADDR(mio:82) + resolve-loop(tokio:103) 수행 → 변경=NIH no-op, 단위 테스트 vacuous. ∴ R311pz/q0의 'de-risk 레버/TIME_WAIT EADDRINUSE' 인과는 조작(Professional Honesty + no-document-around-hack 위반). carry #1 원전제(2-process는 SO_REUSEADDR 필요)는 오진.

(MAJOR architect+root-cause) 데이터플레인 재개 미실증 — publisher_task가 유한 burst라 long-lived --reconnect 쇼케이스가 재연결 후 발행 재개를 안 보여줌. NO-DEFERRAL+가장-교과서 기준으로 acknowledge가 아니라 IMPLEMENT 선택: periodic publisher로 데이터플레인 연속을 e2e가 실증(post-reconnect Put→A2 SUBSCRIBER FIRED). (MINOR refactoring) DRY 회귀 — spawn helper를 common으로.

검증: fmt clean, clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean(wz-ap-demo+wz-integration-tests). 전체 e2e 파일 10/10 연속(5테스트 각, 1.57s 안정=periodic publisher 구조적 non-flake, 기존 reconnect round-trip 회귀0). link_pipeline 단위 2/2(revert), session_reconnect_e2e 4/4. reconnects=1 exact-by-construction(reconnect.rs:348 성공 reopen만 카운트). full run-ci는 push시 pre-push 훅 게이트.
SOUND(3에이전트 교차검증, 변경 안 함): reconnect_endpoint seam, GaveUp into_teardown degenerate-but-correct, SIGKILL→loss 감지 보장, reconnects 카운터.
carry_forward_bullets: R311q1 = R311pz+q0 4-에이전트 적대 리뷰 remediation. R311pz REVERT(tokio bind이 Unix서 이미 SO_REUSEADDR+resolve-loop=NIH no-op + vacuous 테스트 + de-risk 인과 거짓). e2e를 데이터플레인 재개 witness로 재작성(periodic publisher가 재연결 후 발행 재개→A2 SUBSCRIBER FIRED). DRY: spawn_listen_acceptor를 common으로. carry #1(바이너리 sever-reconnect e2e)=control(라이브러리)+data(바이너리) 양 평면 + 실 프로세스 sever로 정직하게 종료.
교훈: '성급한 self-assessment'가 또 뒤집힘 — 적대 리뷰어 주장도 맹신 말고 직접 검증(tokio/mio 소스 read로 SO_REUSEADDR 기본동작 확인). 거짓 인과는 코드가 통과해도 교과서 위반. frozen-ledger: R311pz/q0 본문 보존, 이 엔트리가 정정.

남은 carry(별도 정직한 항목, NO-DEFERRAL): (1) zenoh TCP socket-option parity — listener backlog 1024(tokio 기본 128) + 모든 unicast 스트림 set_nodelay(true)+set_linger(zenoh-link-tcp/unicast.rs:55,65; wz 미설정). bind 동작이 아니라 별개 튜닝 축이라 별도 라운드. (2) [[project-north-star]] P4 zenoh-full 카탈로그 + pico optional. 코드 LOCAL-COMMITTED UNPUSHED 예정. push 명시 동의 필요. zenoh 정본=.cargo/git/checkouts/zenoh-*/49c8a53/.

Round 311q2.decision_summary: R311q2: run-ci Layer Q qemu 실행이 >/dev/null 2>&1로 출력 폐기→실패시 진단불가(R311q1 push의 an386 transient 무로그). run_qemu_case 헬퍼로 FAIL시 qemu 출력+exit code(124=timeout) surface, Q.0/Q.2/Q.4 4사이트 SSOT 통합.
changes_bullets: scripts/run-ci.sh: run_qemu_case(label,cpu,machine,kernel) 헬퍼 추가 — qemu stdout+stderr를 임시 로그로 캡처해, PASS시 폐기(출력 무변), FAIL시 캡처 전체 + exit code 의미(124=10s timeout/hang vs 비정상 semihost SYS_EXIT)를 stderr로 surface. 'else rc=$?'로 exit code 정확 캡처(false `if cond;fi` 후 $?=0 되는 bash 함정 회피), 124 분기는 명시 if(set -e 하에서 `[[ ]] &&` 회피).

Q.0(mcu-noheap-probe)/Q.2(mcu-qemu-demo)/Q.4(mcu-session-acceptor + microbit slim) 4개 qemu-run 사이트를 헬퍼로 통합 = SSOT. 종전 동일한 `timeout 10 qemu-system-arm ... -kernel X >/dev/null 2>&1` 패턴이 4중복이었고 모두 출력 폐기. PASS 라인 포맷 불변(label+' PASS')이라 기존 grep 가드(예: 'Layer Q pass') 호환.
verification_bullets: 출처=사용자 요청(같은 문제 1회 발생에 모든 로그가 기록되어 원인 즉시 파악). 동기=R311q1 push에서 Q.2.mps2-an386이 1회 transient FAIL했으나 qemu 실행이 출력을 /dev/null로 폐기해 무로그→30회 수동 재현으로만 transient임을 진단해야 했음. 근본 원인=4개 qemu-run 사이트의 `>/dev/null 2>&1`.

검증: bash -n scripts/run-ci.sh OK. FAIL 경로=함수를 sed로 추출 후 bogus kernel(/nonexistent)로 호출 → '... FAIL (exit=1)' + 캡처된 qemu 출력('Could not load kernel') `|` 프리픽스로 surface + ret=1 확인. PASS 경로=scripts/run-ci.sh --layer Q exit 0, Q.0/Q.2/Q.4 전 서브레인 PASS, 'captured qemu'/'FAIL' 스퓨리어스 라인 0(PASS시 출력 깨끗 + 라인 포맷 불변).

관점: 이 개선은 observability(실패 진단성)이지 determinism 하드닝이 아님 — emulator transient(R311pw an385/R311q1 an386, MCU 바이트동일·코드무관)는 wz 결함이 아니라 qemu-side라 -icount류 결정성 강제는 별개(R311pw가 fragile로 판정). 다음 재발 시 캡처된 qemu 출력이 timeout vs SYS_EXIT 등 원인을 단일 run에서 구분해 줌.
carry_forward_bullets: R311q2 = run-ci Layer Q 실패 진단성 개선. run_qemu_case 헬퍼(Q.0/Q.2/Q.4 SSOT)가 FAIL시 qemu 출력+exit code(124=timeout) surface → emulator transient(R311pw an385/R311q1 an386) 또는 실 회귀 재발 시 단일 run에서 원인 파악(재현 불필요). observability 개선이지 determinism 하드닝 아님.

다음=#1 TCP socket-option parity: zenoh가 모든 unicast 스트림에 set_nodelay(true)+set_linger(Some(10s)) 설정(zenoh-link-tcp/src/unicast.rs:55/65, TCP_LINGER_TIMEOUT=10@lib.rs:81; dial new_link:266 + accept:409 공용 LinkUnicastTcp::new). wz는 dial_tcp/dial_tcp_host/accept_tcp에 configure_tcp_stream 헬퍼 SSOT로 적용(connect/accept 직후 양방향). non-vacuous 단위(tokio 기본 nodelay=off라 set 여부 구별됨 — R311pz vacuous 교훈). listener backlog 1024는 선택(TcpSocket 재도입=정직한 backlog 근거).
코드 PUSHED 예정(scripts/run-ci.sh 1파일). push 명시 동의 필요. R311pz~q1은 PUSHED origin/main=2b1a389. zenoh 정본=.cargo/git/checkouts/zenoh-*/49c8a53/.

SO_LINGER(zenoh unicast.rs:65 set_linger(Some(10s)))는 의도적 미설정 — tokio::net::TcpStream::set_linger가 deprecated('SO_LINGER causes the socket to block the thread on drop'; clippy -D warnings가 같은 라운드의 시범 추가를 빌드 실패로 적발). zenoh sync 소켓계층은 감당 가능하나 wz async-tokio는 close()가 워커스레드 블록=footgun. graceful-close 의도는 wz-ap-demo R292 teardown(writer drain + Close frame)이 app-level로 충족하고, non-linger close도 커널이 큐 바이트 백그라운드 전달이라 무손실. 런타임 컨텍스트가 reference와 달라 맹종 안 함.

Round 311q4.decision_summary: R311q4: listener backlog 1024 파리티(zenoh new_listener; tokio 기본 128). bind_listener SSOT=TcpSocket→set_reuseaddr(true)→bind→listen(1024), bind_tcp/bind_tcp_host 경유. set_reuseaddr는 R311pz de-risk 아니라 TcpSocket 전환시 Unix 기본 보존(non-vacuous 단위=TcpSocket 기본 off). 현재 one-shot accept엔 무의미, parity+future router용.
changes_bullets: crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/link_pipeline.rs: bind_listener(addr) SSOT 재도입 — TcpSocket(v4/v6) -> set_reuseaddr(true) -> bind -> listen(LISTEN_BACKLOG=1024). zenoh new_listener(io/zenoh-link-commons/src/tcp.rs) 파리티. bind_tcp는 bind_listener에 위임, bind_tcp_host는 lookup_host 루프 + per-addr bind_listener(TcpSocket는 단일 SocketAddr만 받아 resolve loop 필요; numeric 경로가 건너뛰는 부분).

backlog 1024: tokio/mio TcpListener::bind이 128을 하드코드(직접 소스 검증 mio-1.2.0 listener.rs:92)하는 반면 zenoh는 1024. TcpSocket::listen(n)이 tokio의 유일한 custom-backlog 경로라 TcpSocket 필요. 정직 한계: wz accept_tcp는 현재 one-shot(단일 peer)이라 backlog 깊이가 동작상 무의미(연결 1개만 accept); zenoh construction 파리티 + future multi-peer router accept loop(north-star P4) 대비로 설정.

set_reuseaddr(true): R311pz의 거짓 'de-risk'가 아님 — TcpListener::bind이 Unix서 자동 설정하던 SO_REUSEADDR를, 이제 TcpSocket(자동 미설정)으로 빌드하므로 보존하기 위함(누락시 reuseaddr 회귀=이 전환이 도입하는 실제 리스크). 신규 단위 bind_tcp_listener_sets_so_reuseaddr: socket2 readback, NON-vacuous(TcpSocket 기본 off라 explicit set 누락 포착; R311pz는 bind_tcp가 TcpListener::bind라 bare-revert를 못 잡는 vacuous였음). backlog 값은 getsockopt 미지원이라 단위 가드 없음(명시 construction + 리뷰).
verification_bullets: 근본: zenoh new_listener는 socket.listen(1024), tokio/mio TcpListener::bind은 backlog 128(직접 소스 검증: mio-1.2.0 src/net/tcp/listener.rs:92). R311q1/q3 carry의 backlog 부분(사용자가 다음 라운드로 선택). 메타: R311pz가 revert했던 TcpSocket 구성을 재도입하나 이번엔 근거가 참 — backlog 파리티가 TcpSocket을 실제로 요구(custom backlog는 TcpSocket::listen만 가능)하고, set_reuseaddr는 preserve-not-derisk(TcpSocket 전환이 잃는 tokio Unix 기본 보존)라 reuseaddr 단위가 non-vacuous. R311pz와의 차이(거짓 인과 vs 참 인과, vacuous vs non-vacuous)를 changes/ledger가 명시.

검증: fmt clean, clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean. link_pipeline 단위 4/4(신규 bind_tcp_listener_sets_so_reuseaddr 포함 — socket2로 reuseaddr readback), session_reconnect_e2e 4/4, 바이너리 e2e 파일 5/5(acceptor가 새 TcpSocket bind 경로로 bind해도 회귀0; data-plane sever-reconnect 포함). full run-ci(F+G+Q+M+Z)는 push시 pre-push 훅 게이트.
정직 한계: one-shot accept 모델엔 backlog 1024가 동작상 무의미(파리티+future router 대비); backlog 값 자체는 getsockopt 미지원이라 unit-가드 불가(explicit construction + 리뷰가 가드).
carry_forward_bullets: R311q4 = listener backlog 1024 파리티(bind_listener SSOT, TcpSocket -> set_reuseaddr(true) -> bind -> listen(1024); zenoh new_listener). set_reuseaddr는 TcpSocket 전환시 tokio Unix 기본 보존(non-vacuous 단위)이지 R311pz de-risk 아님. R311q3(stream nodelay)와 함께 TCP socket-option 파리티 트랙 주요 항목 종료 — listener: reuseaddr+backlog 1024; stream: nodelay; SO_LINGER는 tokio deprecate(async footgun)로 의도적 미설정. 현재 one-shot accept엔 marginal, future multi-peer router(P4)서 backlog 발현.

R311pz와의 차이(거짓 인과 vs 참 인과, vacuous vs non-vacuous)를 changes/ledger가 명시.

검증: fmt clean, clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean. link_pipeline 단위 4/4(신규 bind_tcp_listener_sets_so_reuseaddr 포함 — socket2로 reuseaddr readback), session_reconnect_e2e 4/4, 바이너리 e2e 파일 5/5(acceptor가 새 TcpSocket bind 경로로 bind해도 회귀0; data-plane sever-reconnect 포함). full run-ci(F+G+Q+M+Z)는 push시 pre-push 훅 게이트.
정직 한계: one-shot accept 모델엔 backlog 1024가 동작상 무의미(파리티+future router 대비); backlog 값 자체는 getsockopt 미지원이라 unit-가드 불가(explicit construction + 리뷰가 가드).
publishable_carry_forward_bullets: R311q4 = listener backlog 1024 파리티(bind_listener SSOT, TcpSocket -> set_reuseaddr(true) -> bind -> listen(1024); zenoh new_listener). set_reuseaddr는 TcpSocket 전환시 tokio Unix 기본 보존(non-vacuous 단위)이지 R311pz de-risk 아님. R311q3(stream nodelay)와 함께 TCP socket-option 파리티 트랙 주요 항목 종료 — listener: reuseaddr+backlog 1024; stream: nodelay; SO_LINGER는 tokio deprecate(async footgun)로 의도적 미설정. 현재 one-shot accept엔 marginal, future multi-peer router(P4)서 backlog 발현.

남은 TCP-option(저우선): zenoh dial측 socket tx/rx buffer size·DSCP·iface bind cfg는 wz 미노출(deploy.yaml 토폴로지 스키마 대상). 다음 주요 라운드 후보: [[project-north-star]] P4(router/SHM/plugin/storage/admin/sub-agg/API shim/script/advanced) 또는 pico optional(scouting passive/MULTICAST_DECLARATIONS/serial·WS·TLS).

changes_bullets: crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/accept_loop.rs: 신규 모듈 — accept_loop(listener, params, clock, tick, shutdown, on_event)가 bind-once→accept 루프→면(face)마다 open+drive로 N peer를 동시 보관. FaceId(u64 newtype, zenoh face_counter)/Face/AcceptEvent(FaceUp·FaceDown·FaceFailed·AcceptError 관측 seam)/AcceptLoopSummary(accepted·established·peak_concurrent high-water). session drive future가 !Send(RefCell-backed sink, session_glue.rs:2829)라 tokio::spawn/JoinSet 불가 → 단일 태스크 FuturesUnordered 2개(opening→OpenedSession, driving→DriverOutcome)로 동시성 확보(Send 불필요, inter-task race 없음). select!를 Step enum으로 decode해 .next() borrow와 .push() mutation을 분리(컴파일 가능). zenoh accept_task(io/zenoh-links/zenoh-link-tcp/src/unicast.rs:375, role-agnostic) + tables.faces(zenoh/src/net/routing/dispatcher/face.rs:63) 앵커.

crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/link_pipeline.rs: accept_tcp_on(&TcpListener) 빌림형 primitive 추가(루프가 listener 보관 가능), one-shot accept_tcp(by-value)는 이에 위임(SSOT, by-value=one-shot 마커). 면 teardown 규칙 확립: drive_face가 drop(engine)+drop(actions) 둘 다 한 뒤 writer_handle.await — 출력 sender가 actions와 engine의 SessionActionsBinding 양쪽 Arc<SessionLinkActions>에 있어, engine만 살려두면 채널 미닫힘으로 writer 태스크가 영원히 행(demo R292 .drop_actions().drain_writer() 순서와 동일).

crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/session_open.rs: bind_locator(AnyLocator)->TcpListener를 accept_locator에서 추출(bind-only half SSOT), accept_locator = accept_bound ∘ bind_locator로 슬림화(거동 불변). bind_endpoint(&str)->TcpListener를 accept_endpoint 대칭으로 추가(plan_endpoint 분류 + bind_locator)=multi-peer accept_loop가 listener를 보관하고 local_addr를 peer 접속 전에 관측(race-free bind/accept 분리).

crates/wz-runtime-tokio/Cargo.toml: futures-util를 transport-link-ws-only optional에서 base dep(std+sink)으로 승격 — FuturesUnordered ungated 필요(!Send 동시성의 교과서 도구). transport-link-ws feature는 dep:futures-util 제거(이제 base). lib.rs: pub mod accept_loop(transport-link-tcp+transport-unicast gate, session_open과 동일).

changes_bullets: [A 정확성] crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/accept_loop.rs: AcceptError arm에 throttle 추가 — clock.sleep(ACCEPT_ERROR_THROTTLE_MS=100ms) 후 재-arm. EMFILE/ENFILE 영속 에러 시 pending 연결이 커널 큐에 남아 un-throttled 재-arm이 즉시 같은 에러 반환=full-CPU hot-spin(router는 fd 한계 근처서 동작=실영역). zenoh accept_task(io/zenoh-links/zenoh-link-tcp/src/unicast.rs:424 sleep(TCP_ACCEPT_THROTTLE_TIME=100_000μs)) parity 복원; doc의 "logs-and-continues parity" 거짓주장 정정(log+throttle+continue).

[B SSOT] OpenedSession::drain_to_close(self) + pub const WRITER_DRAIN_MS=50을 session_open.rs에 추가 — self 소비로 drop(inbound)→drop(engine)→drop(actions)→clock.timeout(WRITER_DRAIN_MS, writer_handle) 순서를 correct-by-construction화. drive_face와 단위테스트가 OpenedSession 필드를 borrow해 drive 후 drain_to_close 경유=hand-ordered drop 3중복(prod+test) 제거 + unbounded writer await→50ms bounded(wedged writer 방어, R292 teardown::drain_writer와 동일 계약). teardown.rs도 literal 50→WRITER_DRAIN_MS 참조=50ms 단일 출처. 리뷰 적발: refactoring M1(unbounded await=SSOT 이탈)+m4/architect M2(doc-only drop-order=R292 typestate가 폐기 선언한 anti-pattern 재도입).

[D/E feature] futures-util를 base dep에서 optional로 복원, 신규 routing-accept = [transport-link-tcp, transport-unicast, dep:futures-util] 기능이 pub mod accept_loop(lib.rs cfg를 all(tcp,unicast)→feature=routing-accept)와 futures-util을 게이트. 공유 atom(router 지금/peer 미래가 forward, 인위적 peer↔router 의존 회피). facade wz/Cargo.toml routing-router=[transport-link-tcp, transport-unicast, wz-runtime-tokio?/routing-accept]로 hollow marker 해소(이제 라이브러리 코드 게이트+prereq self-sufficient). 리뷰 적발: architect M1(cargo tree로 multicast-only 프로파일이 futures-util dead 끌어옴=kconfig "선택한 것만 지불" 위반)+refactoring m2/root-cause(no-op 마커).

[정직성+smell] accept_loop.rs !Send doc 정정(RefCell sink→실제는 SCE Engine Box<dyn FnMut> engine.rs:360,368; RefCell은 MCU LocalSwappableLink twin); session_open.rs accept_endpoint=accept_bound(bind_endpoint())로 plan_endpoint+error-map 중복 제거(architect m1); wz-ap-demo args.rs NodeKind enum(Acceptor/Initiator/Router)+Role::node_kind()로 run_router의 Role::Acceptor{listen} 날조 제거(refactoring m3, listen dead); LISTEN_BACKLOG·accept_locator·Step enum doc stale/방어적 프레이밍 정정; Step::Opened를 Box화(large_enum_variant, C1w --no-default-features clippy 적발).

[커버리지] accept_loop.rs 단위 4종: holds_n_concurrent_peers(N=6 join_all parametric, MINOR-2), isolates_a_failed_handshake_and_keeps_accepting(connect+drop bad peer→FaceFailed, 좋은 peer peak 유지+계속 accept, MAJOR-1 DoS 격리), evicts_a_face_that_leaves_while_siblings_hold(early close→FaceDown+faces.remove 라이브 churn, MAJOR-2), shuts_down_cleanly_with_a_handshake_in_flight(silent peer가 opening에 있을 때 shutdown=drop(opening), MINOR-3). 신규 wz_router_reject_without_feature.rs(default 빌드가 --router를 exit2 거부, MAJOR-3 카탈로그 truthfulness). run-ci.sh Layer C1w(routing-accept unit+clippy×2)+E4(default 빌드 reject) lane+dispatch, ci.yml E4 step.
verification_bullets: 출처: R311qa 독립 4-에이전트 적대 세션리뷰(system-architect/quality-engineer/refactoring-expert/root-cause-analyst), 각자 다른 렌즈로 실제 diff를 직접 read하며 "교과서적/SSOT/북극성" 주장을 반증 시도. 사용자 지시="비용 무관 교과서, 라이프타임 포트폴리오". 적발 후 각 finding을 맹종 않고 직접 소스로 재검증(리뷰어 false-positive 전례).

직접 재검증 완료(4건 핵심): (1) futures-util 누수=cargo tree -p wz-runtime-tokio --no-default-features --features transport-multicast,... -i futures-util이 multicast-only 프로파일서 futures-util 끌어옴 확인→수정후 "did not match any packages"; (2) zenoh throttle=unicast.rs:424 sleep(TCP_ACCEPT_THROTTLE_TIME), lib.rs:84=100_000μs 확인; (3) !Send=SCE engine.rs:360,368 Box<dyn FnMut> no Send 확인, session_glue.rs:2828=LocalSwappableLink MCU twin("CANNOT be the tokio actions driver") 확인; (4) teardown.rs:219 clock.timeout(50,...) bounded-drain SSOT 확인.

SOUND 존중(over-fix 회피): 4명이 반증 실패한 항목은 유지 — FuturesUnordered 선택(!Send 전제 참), Step enum decode(borrow 필수, 코멘트만 정정), bind_locator SSOT, accept_tcp split, peak_concurrent high-water witness(quality가 추적: faces.remove는 session-terminal에서만, 3 insert no-remove=동시 3), established no-overcount(FSM is_established 게이트), inventory reserved 정당(forwarding 미구현), shutdown fd 누수 없음(root-cause가 sender clone 그래프 전수: writer_task 채널-close drain). quality 190회 무결정(30 quiescent+40 CPU포화+100 병렬+20 e2e) 재확인.

검증: 단위 4종(holds_n=6/FaceFailed/FaceDown/shutdown-inflight) 20/20 무결정. wz_router_reject(default 빌드 exit2) PASS. routing-accept 게이트 빌드 6프로파일 OK(default no-accept_loop+no-futures-util / --features routing-accept / demo default reject / demo --features routing-router / multicast 누수 0 / ws). Layer C1w(routing-accept unit+clippy --all-targets+--no-default-features)·E3(multi-peer e2e)·E4(reject)·C1(host workspace)·0(fmt+actionlint) PASS. E3→E4 순차 무충돌(각 lane이 주장하는 바이너리 변종 빌드). wz_initiator_to_wz_acceptor 5/5(WRITER_DRAIN_MS teardown 무회귀). fmt clean, clippy -D warnings clean(demo --features routing-router + routing-accept). 전체 run-ci(F+G+Q+M+Z 포함)는 push시 게이트.

설계 재고: 승인하신 "lib accept_loop ungated" 결정을 리뷰가 뒤집음(누수+hollow marker가 그 결정의 산물) → routing-accept 공유 feature로 게이트가 kconfig-faithful. C1w lane이 off-default 단위 커버리지 복원(ws C1v 선례 동형) + --no-default-features clippy가 large_enum_variant 즉시 적발(lane 가치 실증).
carry_forward_bullets: R311qb = R311qa 4-에이전트 적대 세션리뷰 remediation(사용자 "비용 무관 교과서" 지시로 전부 수정). 정확성 1(AcceptError EMFILE hot-spin=zenoh throttle 누락), SSOT 1(drain_to_close=unbounded await+doc-only drop-order 3중복→typed bounded SSOT), feature 2(futures-util 누수+routing-router hollow marker→routing-accept 공유 게이트), 정직성/smell 다수(!Send 오인용·accept_endpoint 반쪽추출·NodeKind·doc stale·large_enum_variant), 커버리지 5(FaceFailed/FaceDown/shutdown-inflight/N=6/reject)+C1w/E4 lane. 독립 적대 자가감사가 또 성급한 self-assessment 뒤집음(11번째+) — 핵심 교훈 재확인.

다음 증분(routing-router 트랙): routing-routes=포워딩 평면(resource tree+route 계산+Push/Declare를 face 간 forward; zenoh net/routing/dispatcher tables.rs/face.rs/hat). 그때 faces 테이블을 BTreeMap<FaceId,SocketAddr>→FaceHandle{peer,actions(Arc clone)}로 확장(forward가 대상 face의 actions sink 필요; drive_face가 consume 대신 clone)=architect m4가 지목한 additive 확장점. routing-router inventory active flip은 forward 착지 시. routing-peer는 동일 routing-accept 재사용+dial-out mesh.

프로즌-레저 정정 플래그(architect N1): R311qa 레저 changes가 tables.faces를 zenoh face.rs:63으로 인용했으나 실제는 dispatcher/tables.rs:78(face.rs:63은 FaceState.finalized), transports 타입은 Arc<dyn TransportUnicastTrait>. R311qa 엔트리 본문은 frozen이라 수정 불가=이 carry가 정정 기록. 코드 코멘트는 R311qb가 tables.rs+Arc<dyn TransportUnicastTrait>로 정정 완료.

changes_bullets: linkstate_network.rs (d): Tree struct{parent/children/directions} + trees/distances 필드 + new() init(자기 tree 1개+distance 0). add_link(peer_zid, peer_whatami) 강화=self를 그래프에 연결(neighbour 노드 ensure + self.graph[self].links+=peer + self.sn+=1 + rebuild_edges(self)로 mutual edge 형성). remove_link=self.links 제거 + sn+1 + rebuild(self↔peer edge prune). zenoh add_link/remove_link network.rs:812-859 미러. 기존 add_link 호출은 whatami 인자 추가.

compute_trees(): 각 tree_root마다 petgraph::algo::bellman_ford(self 기준 predecessors)→trees[root]={parent(=root 방향 next hop), children(predecessor==self인 노드), directions[dest](dest 방향 first hop=predecessor chain 역추적, 없으면 parent)}; self-root tree의 distances 저장. has_path_connecting+DfsSpace로 reachability 확인. zenoh compute_trees network.rs:1015-1095 미러.

accessor: tree_children_of(source)=source의 tree서 self의 children(flooding forward 대상=loop-free), next_hop(source,dest)=dest 방향 first hop(unicast routing), distance_to(dest)=최단거리(unreachable=None=bellman-ford inf 필터). 모듈 doc 갱신.

accessor: tree_children_of(source)=source의 tree서 self의 children(flooding forward 대상=loop-free), next_hop(source,dest)=dest 방향 first hop(unicast routing), distance_to(dest)=최단거리(unreachable=None=bellman-ford inf 필터). 모듈 doc 갱신.

petgraph bellman_ford/has_path_connecting/DfsSpace 0.6 정상(zenoh와 동일 알고리즘). fmt --check + clippy --lib clean(workspace warnings=deny). 기존 13 테스트도 green(add_link signature+whatami). default 빌드(routing-peer off) 무영향. validate_workspace orphan delta 0.

RoutingForwarder(routing_forward.rs) 구조 미러: 전체 loop이 단일 !Send task라 Mutex 아닌 Rc<RefCell>.
crates/wz-runtime-tokio/Cargo.toml: routing-peer가 wz-session-core/codec-linkstate forward(try_parse_linkstate_oam). lib.rs cfg(routing-peer) pub mod linkstate_forward.

CRITICAL jitter 버그 수정(16-byte zero-padded zid 해시=zenoh to_le_bytes 일치, 혼합 wz↔zenohd mesh forwarding loop 방지) + get_idx O(n)→HashMap 인덱스 + linkstate 테스트 CI 게이트 + honesty(remove_detached_nodes 명시 defer·forwarder 미배선·Changes narrowed) + bellman_ford expect + WHATAMI 단일소스 + 테스트 2(jitter 회귀·triangle acyclic). crate-move/Zid-newtype/prune-impl=추적.
changes_bullets: linkstate_network.rs CRITICAL: update_edge jitter가 raw Vec<u8> 대신 16-byte zero-padded zid(zid_to_le_16=zenoh ZenohIdProto::to_le_bytes 일치) 해시→zid<16B서도 jitter byte-identical=wz↔zenohd 등가경로 tie-break 일치(혼합 mesh forwarding loop 방지). docstring 정정. JITTER_FRACTION 명명.

get_idx O(n) linear scan→idx_by_zid HashMap<Zid,NodeIndex> O(1)(insert_node 단일 삽입경로가 graph+index 동기 유지; new/ensure_node/add_link/process_linkstates add-site가 경유). rebuild_edges/ingest/accessor의 누적 O(n²/n³) 제거.
bellman_ford Err(_) continue→expect(positive weight 불변 loud assert, silent 빈 tree 회귀 마스킹 방지). WHATAMI_* pub 단일소스(linkstate_forward가 WHATAMI_PEER 재사용, FACE_WHATAMI_PEER 중복 제거).

Changes doc narrowed-subset(removed_nodes 미포함 명시). scripts/run-ci.sh C1y에 cargo test --lib linkstate 레인 추가(필터 `accept_loop`가 linkstate 제외하던 갭 해소).

ZENOHID_MAX_SIZE pub 상수. build_linkstate_list의 .expect는 이제 genuinely unreachable(모든 graph zid≤16 by construction=ingest drop + 핸드셰이크 valid zid). 테스트 ingest_drops_entry_with_oversized_zid(17B drop).

wire round-trip 테스트 build_encode_decode_ingest_round_trips_through_the_wire: build_linkstate_list→try_as_borrowed().encode_to_vec()→LinkstateList::decode().try_into_owned()→ingest. convergence 테스트가 우회하던 실제 LinkStateList 코덱 왕복을 검증.

changes_bullets: crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/query_event.rs (NEW): `pub struct QueryEvent<'a>` with unconditional plain-type fields (keyexpr: &str, parameters: Option<&[u8]>, attachment: Option<&[u8]>, rid: u64) replaces direct `&wz_codecs::query::Query` exposure in the queryable callback signature. `pub struct ReplyEmitter<'a>` wraps `crate::query::QueryResponder` with a `reply / reply_del / reply_err / rid / keyexpr_literal / with_responder / clear_responder / responder` 1:1 method surface; the inner field is cfg-conditional (`&mut QueryResponder` when `query-queryable` ON, `PhantomData` when OFF) so the struct is always nameable while the OFF arm is compile-time scaffolding never reached at runtime. Architectural intent documented in module doc-comment + rationale-for-PhantomData paragraph.

crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/lib.rs: `pub mod query` ungated (drop `#[cfg(feature = "query-queryable")]`); new `pub mod query_event` (always-on) added alongside. Both modules' doc-comments updated to document the R311r type-ungating shape — the wire-emit terminal step (`QueryReply::into_response`) is the only remaining cfg-gated boundary on the query path.

crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/query.rs: `use wz_codecs::response::Response` + `use ResponseReplyBuilder/ResponseErrBuilder` imports cfg-gated on `codec-response`; `QueryReply::into_response` method gated on `codec-response` (the only wire-emit terminal step in the query module body). `pub type QueryableCallback` signature switched from `FnMut(&Query, &mut QueryResponder<'_>)` to `FnMut(&QueryEvent<'_>, &mut ReplyEmitter<'_>)`; `register` + `register_with_locality` callback parameter types follow. `fire_matching_queryables` extracts `query.parameters.as_deref()` view, builds `QueryEvent`, wraps `QueryResponder` in `ReplyEmitter::from_responder`, and calls the callback with the new signature. `dispatch_messages` body's `NetworkMessage::Request(req)` match arm cfg-gated on `codec-request`; unused parameters silenced via `let _ = (peer_keyexpr_table, pending_replies, pending_final_rids);` in the OFF arm. All 20 internal test callsites' `responder.send_reply(_del/_err)` calls renamed to `responder.reply(_del/_err)` (replace_all) to match the new ReplyEmitter surface.

crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/observer.rs: `pub queryables: QueryableRegistry` field + `pending_replies` + `pending_final_rids` fields all ungated; `ApplicationLayerObserver::new()` initializes all three unconditionally. `use crate::query::{QueryReply, QueryableRegistry}` import ungated. `pending_reply_count` + `pending_final_count` methods ungated. Dispatch fan-out at `dispatch_event` and wire-emit drain at `flush_pending` stay cfg-gated on `query-queryable` (the dispatch + drain paths are no-ops without the feature). One internal observer test's `responder.send_reply` call renamed to `responder.reply`.

crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/session.rs: `pub fn declare_queryable` signature switched from `-> Queryable` to `-> Result<Queryable, QueryableAliasError>`; callback type uses `QueryEvent + ReplyEmitter`; body cfg-wrapped with FeatureDisabled return for `query-queryable`-OFF builds. `declare_queryable_aliased` body cfg-wrapped (signature already Result). `pub struct Queryable` + `impl Queryable` + `impl Drop for Queryable` all ungated. `pub enum QueryableAliasError` ungated + gains `FeatureDisabled` variant + Display arm. Imports updated: drop `#[cfg(feature = "query-queryable")] use crate::query::{QueryResponder, QueryableId};`, replace with unconditional `use crate::query::QueryableId;` + `use crate::query_event::{QueryEvent, ReplyEmitter};`. `QueryableOptions` R311o doc-comment closes the prior "deferred to a future round" carry. All internal test callsites' `responder.send_reply(_del/_err)` calls renamed (replace_all); two `session.declare_queryable(...)` test callsites gain `.expect("query-queryable feature is ON in this test build")`.

publishable_changes_bullets: crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/query_event.rs (NEW): `pub struct QueryEvent<'a>` with unconditional plain-type fields (keyexpr: &str, parameters: Option<&[u8]>, attachment: Option<&[u8]>, rid: u64) replaces direct `&wz_codecs::query::Query` exposure in the queryable callback signature. `pub struct ReplyEmitter<'a>` wraps `crate::query::QueryResponder` with a `reply / reply_del / reply_err / rid / keyexpr_literal / with_responder / clear_responder / responder` 1:1 method surface; the inner field is cfg-conditional (`&mut QueryResponder` when `query-queryable` ON, `PhantomData` when OFF) so the struct is always nameable while the OFF arm is compile-time scaffolding never reached at runtime. Architectural intent documented in module doc-comment + rationale-for-PhantomData paragraph.

crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/lib.rs: `pub mod query` ungated (drop `#[cfg(feature = "query-queryable")]`); new `pub mod query_event` (always-on) added alongside. Both modules' doc-comments updated to document the R311r type-ungating shape — the wire-emit terminal step (`QueryReply::into_response`) is the only remaining cfg-gated boundary on the query path.

crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/query.rs: `use wz_codecs::response::Response` + `use ResponseReplyBuilder/ResponseErrBuilder` imports cfg-gated on `codec-response`; `QueryReply::into_response` method gated on `codec-response` (the only wire-emit terminal step in the query module body). `pub type QueryableCallback` signature switched from `FnMut(&Query, &mut QueryResponder<'_>)` to `FnMut(&QueryEvent<'_>, &mut ReplyEmitter<'_>)`; `register` + `register_with_locality` callback parameter types follow. `fire_matching_queryables` extracts `query.parameters.as_deref()` view, builds `QueryEvent`, wraps `QueryResponder` in `ReplyEmitter::from_responder`, and calls the callback with the new signature. `dispatch_messages` body's `NetworkMessage::Request(req)` match arm cfg-gated on `codec-request`; unused parameters silenced via `let _ = (peer_keyexpr_table, pending_replies, pending_final_rids);` in the OFF arm. All 20 internal test callsites' `responder.send_reply(_del/_err)` calls renamed to `responder.reply(_del/_err)` (replace_all) to match the new ReplyEmitter surface.

crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/observer.rs: `pub queryables: QueryableRegistry` field + `pending_replies` + `pending_final_rids` fields all ungated; `ApplicationLayerObserver::new()` initializes all three unconditionally. `use crate::query::{QueryReply, QueryableRegistry}` import ungated. `pending_reply_count` + `pending_final_count` methods ungated. Dispatch fan-out at `dispatch_event` and wire-emit drain at `flush_pending` stay cfg-gated on `query-queryable` (the dispatch + drain paths are no-ops without the feature). One internal observer test's `responder.send_reply` call renamed to `responder.reply`.

crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/session.rs: `pub fn declare_queryable` signature switched from `-> Queryable` to `-> Result<Queryable, QueryableAliasError>`; callback type uses `QueryEvent + ReplyEmitter`; body cfg-wrapped with FeatureDisabled return for `query-queryable`-OFF builds. `declare_queryable_aliased` body cfg-wrapped (signature already Result). `pub struct Queryable` + `impl Queryable` + `impl Drop for Queryable` all ungated. `pub enum QueryableAliasError` ungated + gains `FeatureDisabled` variant + Display arm. Imports updated: drop `#[cfg(feature = "query-queryable")] use crate::query::{QueryResponder, QueryableId};`, replace with unconditional `use crate::query::QueryableId;` + `use crate::query_event::{QueryEvent, ReplyEmitter};`. `QueryableOptions` R311o doc-comment closes the prior "deferred to a future round" carry. All internal test callsites' `responder.send_reply(_del/_err)` calls renamed (replace_all); two `session.declare_queryable(...)` test callsites gain `.expect("query-queryable feature is ON in this test build")`.

crates/wz-ap-demo/src/runner.rs: callsite updated for the new Result return + new callback signature: `move |_event, responder| { responder.reply(reply_text_for_callback.as_bytes()); ... }` plus `.expect("query-queryable feature is ON in wz-ap-demo default build")` chained after the call. (이전: routing-peer가 codec-push 미pull→`--no-default-features routing-peer` 빌드서 Oam arm cfg-out→flood이 send_network_message _=>FeatureDisabled로 0 송신; run-ci:933 clippy가 이 깨진 빌드를 green으로 통과.) += transport-fragmentation: large mesh full-topology OAM(>MTU/u16 frame cap)을 fragment; 없으면 u16 stream guard서 silent drop. session_actions Oam arm + dispatch_oam doc 정정(transport-fragmentation 의존 명시; "always carries data plane"=routing-peer가 codec-push pull로 구조적 참).

linkstate_forward propagate per-face own-face 제외(zenoh network.rs:663 link.zid!=self.graph[idx].zid 미러): 기존=source face만 제외하고 single OAM을 전 non-source face에 송신→노드 자기 state를 그 노드 face로 echo(≥3-peer서 발산; sn-staleness가 loop는 막지만 자기 state 되받음). 신규=face별 to_send(changes.updated에서 그 face의 peer_zid 노드 제외)→face별 build_linkstate_for+build. 노드는 자기 state echo 안 받음. 테스트 propagate_excludes_a_node_from_its_own_face.

Round 311rm.decision_summary: R311rm: c3c-3 구독필터 atom1(directions 기반 face 선택자). 그래프에 directions_toward(source,dests) 추가=next_hop(unicast)의 multi-peer dedup 일반화=zenoh insert_faces_for_subs(pubsub.rs:909-944) 미러. 각 interested dest의 next_hop 자식을 dedup 수집→broadcast(tree_children_of) 대신 interested 서브트리로만 향하는 최소 outbound 자식 집합. 레지스트리/Declare 전파/forward_push 배선은 후속 atom.
changes_bullets: wz-routing-graph/src/lib.rs: directions_toward(source, dests) -> Vec<Zid> 추가. 각 dest의 next_hop(source,dest) 자식 zid를 first-seen 순서로 dedup 수집. zenoh insert_faces_for_subs(pubsub.rs:909-944) 핵심 루프(trees[source].directions[sub] per interested peer -> unique face set) 미러. unknown/unreachable/None-direction dest는 무기여; dest==source는 directions[source]=parent(상류)라 self 부모 zid 반환(forward_push inbound 제외가 실제 억제).

단위 테스트 2건(graph 24->26): splits_and_dedups_by_subtree(self-A·self-B·B-D서 [A,D]->{A,B} split, [B,D]->{B} dedup, [D]->{B} only-B-subtree, empty->empty, unknown 0xFF->empty) + follows_a_non_self_source_tree(A-self-C-E 라인서 A 트리 기준 [C,E]->{C} dedup, [A]->{A} 상류방향 정직 단언).
directions/next_hop는 qt(spanning-tree)서 이미 구축; 이 atom은 그 소비 primitive(unicast next_hop의 multi-peer dedup 일반화). 라이브 forward 경로 미배선=후속 atom이 소비.
verification_bullets: cargo test -p wz-routing-graph 26 PASS(directions_toward 2 신규 무회귀). clippy -p wz-routing-graph --all-targets -D warnings clean. fmt -p wz-routing-graph --check exit 0.

directions_toward는 next_hop 위 순수 dedup 래퍼라 tree-walking SSOT를 그래프에 유지(forward_push가 재구현 안 함). zenoh는 face-id 키 dedup; wz는 child-zid 키 dedup(face<->zid 1:1이라 동치). 라이브 forward 경로 미배선=후속 atom(레지스트리/전파/배선)이 소비.

c3c-3 남은 atom(의존순): atom2=구독 레지스트리(keyexpr->interested peer zid HashSet; zenoh HatContext.linkstatepeer_subs; 위치=forwarder or 신규 모듈; 정직: exact-match MVP, 와일드카드 keyexpr intersection=zenoh resource-tree=별도 부채). atom3=Declare(Subscriber) wire codec+sourced 전파(트리 따라 flood, 수신시 register; zenoh propagate_sourced_subscription/pubsub_tree_change). atom4=forward_push가 tree_children_of broadcast->directions_toward(source,interested) 전환+publish 동일+3-peer e2e(C subscribe->A publish->C-ward 서브트리만 forward).

changes_bullets: crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/lib.rs: `pub mod reply` ungated (drop `#[cfg(feature = "query-reply")]`). crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/reply.rs: `dispatch_messages` body's `NetworkMessage::Response(resp)` match arm cfg-gated on `codec-response`; `NetworkMessage::ResponseFinal(rf)` arm stays gated on `codec-response-final` as before. Unused `peer_keyexpr_table` silenced via `let _ = peer_keyexpr_table;` in the OFF arm (signature-stability per R311g1). `ReplyHandle::sentinel()` constructor added (cfg-gated on `not(feature = "query-get")`) so `Session::query`'s OFF fall-through has a stable sentinel return.

crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/observer.rs: `pub replies: ReplyRegistry` field + `use crate::reply::ReplyRegistry` import + the `ApplicationLayerObserver::new()` `replies` init all ungated. Dispatch fan-out at `dispatch_event` and the bounded `query-reply` gate path stay in place where wire-emit + register paths are exercised; the field is always allocated empty so callers can hold a stable observer slot across feature subsets.

crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/reply.rs: ReplyHandle::sentinel constructor doc-comment explains the rid=0 out-of-band signal + crate-private rationale + the cfg-gate that prevents dead-code lint when query-get is ON. Round 311sd.decision_summary: R311sd: c3c-3 부채 D1 재설계 — 전이-불일치 loop의 hop-limit by-construction BOUND. zenoh 조사가 (source,sn) seen-set을 뒤집음(zenoh 데이터평면=구조적-only, dedup/sn/TTL 전무; seen-set=런타임 band-aid로 unrepresentable-by-construction 역행)→hop-limit(IP TTL 교과서)으로 재설계. Push 전용 wz-proprietary ext 0x0a(mesh-internal, SCE-free=ENC-driven decode가 unknown id 보존), publish가 node_count 스탬프+forward_push가 hop<=1 drop/decrement. control-plane은 change-gate가 이미 bound.
changes_bullets: zenoh 정본 조사(Explore, file:line)로 D1 재정의: zenoh 데이터 forward는 순수 구조적 spanning-tree loop-freedom — route_data(dispatcher/pubsub.rs:286-390)에 seen-set/sequence/TTL 전무, ext_nodeid는 node_id:u16뿐(network/mod.rs:571-592), sn은 topology staleness 전용(network.rs:580). 즉 로드맵의 (source,sn) seen-set은 zenoh 정본 없음 + 런타임 detect-drop(unrepresentable-by-construction 원칙 역행). hop-limit(IP TTL=데이터평면 교과서)으로 재설계.
wz-session-core/ext_nodeid.rs: chain-edit SSOT에 generic read_z64_ext/set_z64_ext 추출, read_source/set_source를 그 thin projection으로 리팩터(retain-drop/push/Z-normalise 단일홈). C2 골든이 byte-parity 보존 검증.

wz-session-core/push_routing_context.rs: HOPLIMIT_EXT_ID=0x0a(zenoh 4비트 ext공간 자유 id 0x7-0xe 중; non-mandatory M=0=미지원 peer skip), header 0x2a(id|ENC_Z64). read_push_hoplimit/set_push_hoplimit(ext_nodeid generic 재사용). Push 전용=mesh-internal wz<->wz forward에만; 클라이언트 wire 불변. SCE 불필요(ext_entry decode가 ENC-driven=unknown id generic 보존, ext_entry.scxml:44-49).

wz-runtime-tokio/linkstate_forward.rs: publish가 hop=node_count 스탬프(pigeonhole: 비순환 경로 <=node_count-1 edges→outliving=확정 loop), forward_push가 hop<=1 drop(loop bound)+재stamp 시 hop-1 decrement(absent=node_count fresh budget). forward_push doc를 2-layer(structural converged + hop-limit transient bound)로 정정; '(source,sn) seen-set is the tracked defence' 삭제. control-plane은 register change-gate가 이미 bound(zenoh parity)=hop-limit 불필요 명시.

F-2 loop-bound 실제-loop 테스트, F-3 C1 4-node anchor, F-4 doc 정직. D2c defer 4-에이전트 확정. 자가감사 과신 패턴 재확인.
changes_bullets: F-1(CRITICAL/MAJOR, architect+root-cause 2-에이전트 독립 적발=최강 신호): D2 deregister "delta provably always empty" 주장 반증. 비균일 가중치(zenohd transport_weights를 wz가 ingest+적용)서 self-link drop이 cheaper detour 제거→노드 re-home→self가 remote root tree서 새 자식 획득→non-empty delta→re-advertise 누락. zenoh는 link-down delta를 pubsub_tree_change에 무조건 공급(mod.rs:140-149). 수정: linkstate_forward.rs deregister가 compute_trees delta를 capture해 re_advertise_subscriptions에 공급(inbound forward() 경로와 동일; 균일 가중치선 empty=no-op, re-home시만 발화). "provably empty" 단정 doc 삭제.

Round 311sh.decision_summary: R311sh: c3c-3 D2c coalesced spanning-tree recompute. Topology-change handlers (forward inbound link-state / deregister) schedule_recompute (set a dirty flag) instead of recomputing inline; the FaceForwarder tick flushes ONE compute_trees + re_advertise per window, so a burst (join flood / flapping cascade) collapses to one recompute -- zenoh TreesComputationWorker debounce (hat/linkstate_peer/mod.rs:122-157), translated to wz's single-task actor as a coalescing tick on the loop (zenoh needs a separate task only because its tables are Arc<RwLock>-shared). Window = with_trees_delay knob (default 100ms = TREES_COMPUTATION_DELAY_MS); it tunes the SPF-throttle delay, NOT an on/off switch -- the coalescing path is the single recompute SSOT. Topology FLOOD stays inline (no periodic wire traffic; D2b preserved). Reverses the earlier 'defer D2c as YAGNI' stance on the user textbook-over-cost ruling, after a direct zenoh read confirmed zenoh has no inline mode (the worker is the only, always-on recompute path); wz is a faithful port plus a delay-knob superset.
changes_bullets: linkstate_forward.rs: split on_inbound_linkstate -> ingest_inbound_linkstate (ingest only, returns Changes; propagate/flood stay INLINE exactly as zenoh floods link-states inline and debounces only the tree compute). New recompute_and_advertise() = the single recompute SSOT (compute_trees + recomputes-counter + re_advertise_subscriptions) and schedule_recompute() = set the dirty flag. forward() OAM arm and deregister now do ingest / remove_link + flood_self inline then schedule_recompute (no inline compute_trees). tick_period() -> Some(trees_delay); tick() flushes via trees_dirty.replace(false) (read-and-clear = idle no-op poll, one compute per burst).

Fields: trees_dirty: Cell<bool>, trees_delay: Duration (the SPF-throttle window), recomputes: Cell<usize> (coalescing witness). Constructor split new()/with_trees_delay() + pub const DEFAULT_TREES_DELAY = 100ms (zenoh hat/mod.rs:56 TREES_COMPUTATION_DELAY_MS). recomputes() accessor next to ingested()/data_seen().

accept_loop.rs: FaceForwarder tick_period/tick trait docs updated (the linkstate peer now ticks for D2c). NO driver change needed: Step::Tick => forwarder.tick() (accept_loop.rs:511) and the tick-timer arm (:415) were already wired (the D2b-dormant tick seam), so D2c revives that seam with its first real consumer.
Module doc rewritten: D2c moved from "deferred" to done, with the zenoh-task -> wz-actor-tick translation and the "delay knob, not on/off" SSOT note recorded.

Tests: advertise_link_back helper = ingest_inbound_linkstate + net.compute_trees() (delta WITHOUT re_advertise, for the isolation re_advertise tests). on_inbound_linkstate call sites -> ingest_inbound_linkstate. deregister_recomputes / forward_hook / deregister_does_not_re_advertise updated to the deferred model (assert stale-pre-tick, call tick(), assert flushed). +3 D2c units: a_burst_of_scheduled_changes_coalesces_into_one_recompute (2 changes -> 1 recompute), tick_with_no_scheduled_change_does_not_recompute (idle no-op), with_trees_delay_sets_the_tick_cadence (knob wired).

Honest divergence recorded: zenoh hardcodes always-on batching (no runtime/compile toggle to disable; only the delay is compile-time tunable). wz exposes the delay as a construction knob = superset. The earlier "defer D2c as YAGNI / inline is more correct" stance was REVERSED on the user's textbook-over-cost ruling after a direct zenoh read showed there is no inline mode in zenoh (the worker is the only recompute path), so D2c is in-scope for AP-full, not optional.
verification_bullets: wz-runtime-tokio (routing-peer) lib 350 PASS (+3 D2c units; modified deregister/forward deferred tests green incl. deregister_recomputes_trees_dropping_the_dead_link asserting stale-[A]-pre-tick then empty-post-tick). linkstate_forward module 54 PASS. clippy(runtime-tokio --tests, routing-peer) -D clean. fmt --check clean.

E6 e2e PASS: wz_peer_mesh 1 + wz_peer_data_forward 3 (forward 2-hop / withdraw 2-hop / 4-peer subscription-selectivity) via the TIMER-driven tick (100ms flush) over real TCP; data_forward 10/10 with 0 flake = convergence robust under deferred recompute (the tick reliably flushes; topology flood stays inline so topology convergence is unchanged).
full run-ci RUNCI_EXIT=0 (all required layers: Layer Q MCU build+QEMU run across mps2/microbit, footprint within tol, Layer Z zenohd interop 9/9, host lanes). Idle-run, 0 host-lane failures.

zenoh direct-read grounding (no memory-only assertions): TREES_COMPUTATION_DELAY_MS = zconfigurable!(option_env!, COMPILE-time) hat/mod.rs:55-57; TreesComputationWorker constructed UNCONDITIONALLY in HatTables::new (linkstate_peer/mod.rs:174) = no on/off switch; schedule_compute_trees = try_send on a bounded(1) channel (:178-181); worker loop sleep(delay)->recv coalesces a burst (:130-154), parks on recv when idle (no periodic wakeup). Confirms wz is a faithful port + delay-knob superset, not a divergent invention.

Borrow discipline: tick()/recompute_and_advertise hold the net borrow only for compute_trees (temporary), released before re_advertise_subscriptions re-borrows; single-task actor so tick cannot interleave with forward() (both on the one task). No Arc/Mutex added (unlike zenoh's shared-table worker).
carry_forward_bullets: R311sh = c3c-3 D2c coalesced spanning-tree recompute DONE. Topology FLOOD stays inline (zenoh-faithful; the mesh has NO periodic wire traffic, so D2b's achievement is preserved), the tree RECOMPUTE each change triggers is debounced onto the FaceForwarder tick (the single SSOT recompute path: forward/deregister schedule_recompute -> tick flushes one compute_trees + re_advertise per window). Knob = with_trees_delay (default 100ms = zenoh TREES_COMPUTATION_DELAY_MS); it tunes the SPF-throttle delay, it is NOT an on/off switch.

Reverses the earlier "defer D2c as YAGNI (inline is more correct)" stance. Direct zenoh read proved zenoh has no inline mode (TreesComputationWorker is the only, always-on recompute path; only the delay is compile-time tunable), so D2c is in-scope for AP-full. wz is a faithful port PLUS a delay-knob superset (zenoh denies even that toggle). Lesson reinforced: a "more correct by construction" self-assessment (here inline-vs-batched) is exactly the F-1 trap — verify against the upstream, do not assert.

Tracked debt (honest): the wz tick is a periodic poll + dirty-check (a cheap local Cell read, a no-op when idle) rather than zenoh's park-on-recv. Forced by the architecture: forward() runs INSIDE the per-face drive future, so the loop's only regular re-entry point is the timer. A one-shot debounce (Notify-driven re-arm) would zero the idle polls but add cross-task signaling into the forwarder seam; judged KISS/YAGNI over the negligible 100ms no-op (the wire still carries zero periodic traffic). Revisit only if idle-poll cost is ever measured to matter.

Next debt (project_c3c3_debt_paydown order): B1 alias keyexpr (DeclareKeyexpr, literal_keyexpr id!=0 -> resolve_wireexpr) -> D3 remove_detached_nodes -> D4 Details split (per-link delta flood; eases register flood_self O(N^2)) -> B2 wildcard -> E/F.

Tracked debt (honest): the wz tick is a periodic poll + dirty-check (a cheap local Cell read, a no-op when idle) rather than zenoh's park-on-recv. Forced by the architecture: forward() runs INSIDE the per-face drive future, so the loop's only regular re-entry point is the timer. A one-shot debounce (Notify-driven re-arm) would zero the idle polls but add cross-task signaling into the forwarder seam; judged KISS/YAGNI over the negligible 100ms no-op (the wire still carries zero periodic traffic). Revisit only if idle-poll cost is ever measured to matter.

changes_bullets: session-core push_build.rs: extract literal_wireexpr (the SSOT literal-Wireexpr constructor; build_push_literal now delegates to it) + add set_push_keyexpr_literal (sets a Push's keyexpr to a literal AND the header N/0x20 suffix-present bit a literal keyexpr requires -- a pure-aliased inbound Push has N clear, so re-expressing only the keyexpr without the header desyncs the wire and the peer decoder reads an offset-shifted MsgPut header).

linkstate_forward.rs: FaceState gains keyexpr_table: hashbrown::HashMap<u64,String> -- a per-face, LINK-LOCAL keyexpr-alias table (hashbrown to match resolve_wireexpr's table type). register() inits it empty.

absorb_keyexpr_declaration(face, declare): a sourced Declare(DeclKexpr) resolves the declared base via resolve_wireexpr then inserts id->literal into the INBOUND face's table; an UndeclKexpr removes it. forward() Declare dispatch: a DeclKexpr/UndeclKexpr arm (before the subscriber arms) routes to absorb_keyexpr_declaration instead of mis-handling it as a subscription via the _ => forward_subscription fallthrough.

forward_push: resolves push.keyexpr against the inbound face's alias table (resolve_wireexpr) inside the existing scoped faces borrow -- id==0 is the suffix verbatim, id!=0 is table[id]+suffix, an unresolvable alias drops the Push (same drop a missing literal got). The outbound carrier is NORMALIZED to a literal (set_push_keyexpr_literal) so a downstream child (no shared alias table) can resolve it. Removed the now-dead literal-only push_keyexpr helper.

Round 311sj.decision_summary: R311sj: c3c-3 B1b control-plane keyexpr alias resolution. forward_subscription / forward_unsubscription now resolve an aliased DeclareSubscriber keyexpr / UndeclareSubscriber ext_keyexpr against the inbound face's link-local table and re-flood NORMALIZED to a literal -- the symmetric control-plane twin of B1a's data-plane push resolution, so an aliased subscribe can be cleanly undone by an aliased unsubscribe (no interest leak). Extends declare_ext_keyexpr with resolve_ext_keyexpr (a VLE-inner-id resolver, the read_ext_keyexpr alias-capable superset). Completes B1: the linkstate-peer HAT resolves keyexpr aliases on both planes. wz still originates literals; the value is interop.
changes_bullets: session-core declare_ext_keyexpr.rs: add resolve_ext_keyexpr(exts, table) -- the resolve_wireexpr analogue for the UndeclareSubscriber ext_keyexpr form (id==0 = literal suffix verbatim, id!=0 = table[id]+suffix). Decodes the inner mapping-id VLE via a small decode_vle (no length cap; read_ext_keyexpr only handled the single-byte literal id 0x00). +3 units: literal-with-empty-table, aliased-composed-via-table, unknown-alias-is-None.

linkstate_forward.rs forward_subscription: resolves the DeclareSubscriber keyexpr against the inbound face's link-local table (resolve_wireexpr) inside the scoped faces borrow, registers the RESOLVED literal interest, and re-floods a carrier that is a clean literal sourced DeclareSubscriber when the inbound was aliased (build_declare_subscriber(0,0,literal)) or the cloned original when already literal (the literal path stays byte-unchanged). An unresolvable alias drops the declaration.

linkstate_forward.rs forward_unsubscription: the symmetric withdrawal -- resolves the ext_keyexpr via resolve_ext_keyexpr against the face table, withdraws the resolved literal interest, and re-floods a literal undeclare rebuilt (build_undeclare_subscriber_with_keyexpr) when aliased / cloned when literal. This is what lets an aliased subscribe be cleanly undone by an aliased unsubscribe -- a subscribe-only B1b would have leaked the interest (aliased sub registers, aliased unsub could not resolve to withdraw).

linkstate_forward.rs helpers: removed the now-dead literal-only declare_subscriber_keyexpr / undeclare_subscriber_keyexpr / literal_keyexpr; added keyexpr_is_aliased (id != 0 detector, decides whether a carrier must be normalized) + declare_subscriber_wireexpr (returns the raw Wireexpr for resolution). forwarded_keyexpr inlines the literal extraction (literal_keyexpr removed).

Tests: forwarded_declare_keyexpr + aliased_undeclare helpers + 2 integration units (an aliased subscription resolves and re-floods a literal; an aliased unsubscription resolves the ext alias and withdraws the interest -- the symmetry).

Completes B1: the linkstate-peer HAT resolves keyexpr aliases on BOTH the data plane (B1a push) and the control plane (B1b declare/undeclare), reusing the resolve_wireexpr / resolve_ext_keyexpr SSOTs and the per-face table. wz still originates only literals; the value is interop with external zenoh/pico peers that alias keyexprs.

Round 311sk.decision_summary: R311sk: 4-agent adversarial session-review (sh D2c / si B1a / sj B1b) remediation. The review found NO correctness bug -- root-cause-analyst broke every by-construction claim and ALL held (positive calibration, the opposite of the prior F-1 'provably empty delta' session). Convergent SSOT/smell findings remediated: SSOT-1 decode_vle was a 3rd VLE decoder -> shared crate::vle::read_vle_u64 (sample.rs + declare_ext_keyexpr both use it); SSOT-2 read_ext_keyexpr/resolve_ext_keyexpr duplicated parser -> shared parse_ext_keyexpr_entry; SMELL-3 asymmetric normalize -> control plane ALWAYS rebuilds a clean sourced literal (uniform, removed was_aliased/was_literal/keyexpr_is_aliased, more faithful: sourced id 0). Plus register schedule_recompute on link-up (zenoh mod.rs:275 parity, pre-existing gap), F-4 doc honesty (normalize = deliberate divergence from zenoh per-face re-aliasing), and M1/M2/m1/m2 coverage. M3 (deregister re-home) composition-covered post-D2c.
changes_bullets: SSOT-1 (refactoring+architect convergent MAJOR): new wz-session-core/src/vle.rs read_vle_u64 -- the slice-based SSOT (the SceCursor::read_vle_u64 borrowed-slice twin, with the stricter over-shift guard). The sj-introduced decode_vle (a 3rd VLE decoder) AND sample.rs's private read_vle_u64 are both removed -> both now use crate::vle::read_vle_u64. lib.rs declares the alloc-gated pub(crate) module.

SSOT-2 (refactoring+architect convergent MAJOR): read_ext_keyexpr + resolve_ext_keyexpr share one parse_ext_keyexpr_entry (the ZBuf-body parse + VLE decode in ONE place); the divergent single-byte-vs-VLE id-width rule is eliminated (read_ext_keyexpr now decodes the id via the shared VLE reader too). Round 311sl.decision_summary: R311sl: c3c-3 D3 remove_detached_nodes. The linkstate-peer graph GC-prunes nodes no longer reachable from self over the advertisement graph (DFS over node.links), run at the ingest tail (process_linkstates) and inside remove_link (zenoh network.rs:786,948,990); the driver purges each pruned node's subscription interest (zenoh pubsub_remove_node). Corrects deregister to purge only the genuinely-detached set so a neighbour still reachable via another face keeps its interest, and the demo reports the PEAK node count (teardown's prune collapses the live graph). Tree accessors tolerate a node pruned in the coalesced-recompute window.
changes_bullets: wz-routing-graph: remove_detached_nodes(&mut self) -> Vec<Zid> -- a DFS from self over each visited node's ADVERTISED links (node.links.keys(), not the petgraph edges: reachability is over what nodes claim to link to), removing every unvisited node. Keeps idx_by_zid (wz's zid->NodeIndex secondary index, which zenoh lacks) in lockstep -- every node dropped from the graph is dropped from the index too. Mirrors zenoh remove_detached_nodes (network.rs:990-1013), narrowed to return zids (zenoh returns (NodeIndex, Node) for gossip; wz needs only the zid to purge interest).

process_linkstates now runs the prune at its tail and retains `updated` to drop any pruned zid (zenoh network.rs:786-788 new_nodes/updated_nodes.retain); Changes gains `removed: Vec<Zid>` (zenoh Changes.removed_nodes parity, narrowed to zids). remove_link returns Vec<Zid> (the detached set) instead of Option<Link>, calling remove_detached_nodes after the self-edge drop -- zenoh remove_link (network.rs:936-988): self-side bookkeeping then the prune.

tree_children_of / next_hop now use graph.node_weight (not the panicking index op) so a child/hop pruned since the last compute_trees -- possible because the recompute is COALESCED onto a later tick (D2c) -- resolves to None and is skipped rather than panicking on a removed StableGraph index. The pruned node is unreachable, so it was never a valid forward target; the next recompute drops it for good.

linkstate_forward: the forward() OAM arm purges subs.remove_peer for every changes.removed node (zenoh pubsub_remove_node over handle_oam's changes.removed_nodes, hat/linkstate_peer/mod.rs:418-422). deregister REPLACES the former unconditional state.actions.peer_zid() purge with the detached-set purge from remove_link's return (zenoh undeclare_face mod.rs:378-387, pubsub_remove_node per removed node) -- a correctness fix: a neighbour still reachable via ANOTHER face is no longer in the detached set, so it KEEPS its interest (the old unconditional purge wrongly dropped a still-reachable subscriber); the departed neighbour is itself returned only when it had no other path.

wz-ap-demo runner: a peak_nodes high-water mark sampled each app-tick; the shutdown summary now reports `peak N node(s) in topology graph` (and the learned-topology witness `peak N node(s) in graph`) because teardown deregisters EVERY face and the D3 prune collapses the live graph toward self during shutdown -- the peak is the meaningful convergence witness ("this peer's graph held N peers once converged"), which the 4-peer selectivity e2e asserts on.

Tests: the 7 incrementally-built graph mechanics tests (mapping/sn-gate/edge-formation) now use consistent single-snapshot ingests via a `relay` helper (the link peer 0x07 relay-advertises the test nodes so they are reachable; a real flood is one consistent list, and a transiently-detached node is now correctly pruned). +3 graph prune tests (ingest-detach, remove_link transitive prune, stale-tree accessor tolerance) + 1 driver test (a multi-path peer KEEPS its interest on the direct face's deregister). deregister_recomputes_trees re-anchored on the recomputes() counter (the prune is inline; only the tree recompute is deferred). re-home test now asserts the multi-path node is NOT pruned.
verification_bullets: wz-routing-graph 31 PASS (incl 3 new prune tests + the relay-fixed mechanics tests). wz-runtime-tokio (routing-peer) lib 357 PASS (linkstate_forward module 61: +1 multi-path-keeps-interest, deregister_recomputes re-anchored on recomputes()). clippy(wz-routing-graph + wz-runtime-tokio + wz-ap-demo, --tests) clean. fmt --check clean. default (non-routing-peer) wz-ap-demo build clean (the shared runner.rs still compiles without the routing-peer forwarder path).

E6 e2e 8/8 across 3 consecutive runs, NO flake (wz_peer_mesh 1 + wz_peer_data_forward 3: forward 2-hop / withdraw 2-hop / 4-peer selectivity). The 4-peer test confirms peer-D converges to PEAK 4 nodes -- it is a fully-converged member, so its non-receipt is the subscription filter pruning it, not topological isolation.

Root cause caught + fixed: the 4-peer e2e first FAILED with D reporting "1 node(s) in topology graph" at shutdown. Diagnosed as a TEARDOWN ARTIFACT, not isolation: teardown deregisters D's accepted face to B, which now prunes B (and transitively A, C), collapsing the live graph to self. Proof it was steady-state-converged: C still received the forwarded data (the mesh ran), and D is structurally identical to C (a pure acceptor of B, whose accept-side add_link is proven by the two-hop forward). Fixed by reporting the peak node count, not the mid-teardown live count.

Grounding (direct read): zenoh remove_detached_nodes (network.rs:990-1013, DFS over self.graph[node].links.keys()); its two call sites -- link_states tail (:786, returns Changes.removed_nodes) and remove_link (:948). The existing-node update branch (:711-722) updates sn/links/locators but NOT whatami, so a node first seen as a placeholder keeps whatami None even after its own link-state arrives -- wz matches this (one mechanics test lists the node before the relay to insert it fresh). HAT consumers: pubsub_remove_node (pubsub.rs:622, purges any sub whose interested set contains the removed node) called per removed node in handle_oam (mod.rs:418-422) and undeclare_face (mod.rs:378-387).

Full run-ci deferred to the pre-push gate (the change is routing-peer-feature scoped + the shared demo runner string; the per-atom gates -- graph + routing-peer lib + clippy + fmt + default build + E6 x3 -- all pass).

Round 311sn.decision_summary: R311sn: c3c-3 B2 wildcard keyexpr intersection. LinkstatepeerSubs lookups (interested / interested_remote) now match a published key against every registered subscription keyexpr by keyexpr INTERSECTION (keyexpr_intersect_patterns -- the SSOT the local SubscriberRegistry already uses, zenoh's Resource::get_matches route matching) instead of exact string equality, so a demo/** or demo/* subscription attracts a concrete demo/data Push. An EXTENSION of the flat by_key map's read path (a private matching_peers scan), NOT the resource-tree rewrite the roadmap feared; the prefix-tree fold for sublinear matching stays a tracked performance deferral. Contained in the lookup -- register/flood/data-route/codec unchanged.
changes_bullets: linkstate_subs.rs: new private matching_peers(target, exclude) -- splits the target (published key) and each registered subscription keyexpr on '/' and tests keyexpr INTERSECTION via keyexpr_intersect_patterns (the same SSOT + chunk-split idiom as declare.rs:110-113), deduping peers across all matching keys. interested(keyexpr) = matching_peers(keyexpr, None); interested_remote(keyexpr, self_zid) = matching_peers(keyexpr, Some(self_zid)). So a demo/** or demo/* subscription now attracts a concrete demo/data Push, while a literal subscription stays byte-exact (intersection of two literals = equality).

register / withdraw / remove_peer / subscriptions UNCHANGED: the keyexpr stored is the pattern as-declared; only the read-path lookup widened from exact get to intersection scan. The data route (forward_push / publish -> interested_remote -> directions_toward) and the control plane (forward_subscription register, re_advertise_subscriptions) are also UNCHANGED -- B2 is contained entirely in the lookup, so a wildcard subscription flows through register/flood as a literal pattern string and is matched at read time. 0 forwarder changes, 0 codec changes.

SCOPE: an EXTENSION of the existing flat by_key: HashMap<String, HashSet<Zid>> read path -- NOT the resource-tree rewrite the roadmap feared. The wildcard MATCHING is the feature (delivered here); zenoh additionally folds subscriptions into a prefix RESOURCE TREE for sublinear matching, which stays a tracked PERFORMANCE deferral (the O(subscriptions) scan is correct but linear; the tree is only needed for large subscription sets, not modelled).

Module + field docs rewritten: the exact-match MVP note is replaced with the intersection-matching contract (keyexpr_intersect_patterns SSOT, zenoh Resource::get_matches), the resource-tree fold named as the honest remaining deferral (performance, not correctness).

Round 311sp.decision_summary: R311sp: c3c-3 E1 Zid 16-byte no-alloc newtype. Zid = Vec<u8> becomes a Copy struct Zid { bytes: [u8;16], len: u8 } (the zenoh ZenohIdProto mirror): no-alloc, type-safe. The canonical zero-padding (bytes[len..]==0) makes the derived Ord byte-identical to the trimmed-Vec<u8> ordering, so the deterministic zenohd-interop edge-jitter tie-break is unchanged. Confined to the 3 routing-peer files (graph + the 2 linkstate driver files) + the demo's one constructor -- NOT wz-WIDE as the roadmap feared. From<&[u8]>/From<Vec<u8>> + LinkstateForwarder::new(impl Into<Zid>) keep the session(Vec<u8>) boundary and the tests/demo unchanged.
changes_bullets: wz-routing-graph: `pub type Zid = Vec<u8>` becomes a Copy `struct Zid { bytes: [u8;16], len: u8 }` (the zenoh ZenohIdProto fixed-buffer-plus-size mirror) with from_slice (truncate to 16 + canonical zero-pad), as_slice (the trimmed wire bytes), len/is_empty, le16 (the 16-byte buffer the edge-jitter hashes), MAX_SIZE, a hex Debug, and From<&[u8]> / From<Vec<u8>>. zid_to_le_16 is now a one-line wrapper over le16 so the update_edge hash sites read unchanged.

The derived Ord/Eq/Hash are correct BECAUSE of the canonical invariant (bytes[len..]==0): a shorter zid that is a zero-extended prefix of a longer one compares equal on bytes then orders BEFORE it on len -- exactly as Vec<u8> orders a prefix before its extension (proved case-by-case: a differing real byte decides identically; an all-zero tail falls through to the len tie-break). So the deterministic cross-implementation edge-jitter tie-break with a zenohd peer (update_edge orders the pair by Ord, then hashes le16) is byte-for-byte unchanged by the representation switch.

Call-site conversions: convert_to_local_link_states builds Zid::from_slice(wire bytes); make_link_state uses SceBytes::from_slice(zid.as_slice()); the 23 now-redundant .clone() on the Copy Zid are removed (clippy clone_on_copy --fix). Driver: resolve_source takes Option<&[u8]> (the peer_zid Vec<u8> boundary -> .as_deref() at the 3 call sites); register converts via Zid::from_slice(&peer_zid) for add_link; 9 more redundant .clone() removed. LinkstateForwarder::new / with_trees_delay take `impl Into<Zid>` so the demo (Vec<u8> params.zid) and the tests (Zid) both compile unchanged.

Tests: the 3 zid(b) helpers -> Zid::from_slice(&[b;4]); entry / entry_weighted take Option<&Zid> (so the many Some(&zid(..)) call sites are unchanged); the oversized-zid test builds its >16-byte LinkstateOwned directly (Zid itself truncates to 16, so the helper can no longer carry the raw oversized form).

Scope: confined to the 3 routing-peer files (wz-routing-graph + the 2 linkstate driver files) + the demo's one constructor call -- NOT wz-WIDE as the roadmap feared. The no-alloc payoff is AP-only (Zid is absent from the MCU footprint); the durable win is type safety + a Copy 17-byte value. From<Vec<u8>> keeps the session(Vec<u8>)->routing(Zid) boundary ergonomic.

A wrong Ord would desync the trees across peers and break the multi-hop forward / cause loops. Convergence + 2-hop forward + WILDCARD + withdraw + 4-peer selectivity all hold, confirming the newtype Ord matches the prior Vec<u8> ordering byte-for-byte.

All remediated: remove_detached_nodes scrubs freed indices from the cached trees; the Zid Ord equivalence is now tested; placeholders re-flood via changes.new; vestigial zid_to_le_16 deleted; purge_detached_interest + into_list extracted; matching_peers HashSet dedup; the demo drops a needless zid clone; + the D4 unmapped-psid drop test and doc-honesty fixes.
changes_bullets: F1 (CORRECTNESS, root-cause MAJOR): remove_detached_nodes now scrubs every freed NodeIndex from the cached spanning trees + distances (new scrub_trees). StableUnGraph REUSES a freed index on the next add_node, and the recompute is COALESCED (D2c), so a stale `trees` entry holding a freed index would, after a reuse, resolve via node_weight to a DIFFERENT live node and MISFORWARD a Push during the window (the node_weight guard only catches a still-absent index, not a reused one). Scrubbing keeps the invariant "the trees never reference a freed index": affected routes resolve to None (drop) until the tick rebuild, never an aliased misroute. +unit a_reused_node_index_does_not_alias_a_stale_tree_entry (prune frees C's idx, D reuses it, next_hop(self,D) must be None not C's old hop A).

F2 (CRITICAL coverage, quality): the load-bearing Zid Ord == Vec<u8> equivalence (the cross-impl jitter tie-break) was prose-only. +unit zid_ord_matches_vec_u8_ord_including_zero_extended_prefixes (a full table incl [1]/[1,0]/[1,5] prefix cases) + zid_eq_hash_truncation_and_from_are_canonical (HashSet dedup, >16 truncation, From<&[u8]>/From<Vec<u8>>).

F4 (SSOT, architect+refactoring convergent): deleted the vestigial zid_to_le_16 free fn (body was `zid.le16()`); the 6 update_edge / test hash sites call .le16() directly.
F5 (SSOT, refactoring): the byte-identical "purge each removed node's interest" loop at the two prune sites (deregister + the ingest OAM arm) is extracted to one purge_detached_interest(&[Zid]).

F6 (SSOT, refactoring): build_linkstate_list / build_linkstate_split shared their LinkStateList assembly tail (triplicated num_link_states=len); a free `into_list(Vec<LinkstateOwned>)` derives the count once.

F7 (smell/perf, refactoring): matching_peers dedup was O(matches^2) via out.contains on the DATA path (interested_remote per Push); now a HashSet<Zid> accumulator (Zid is Copy+Hash). Doc names the per-message keyexpr-intersection cost.
F8 (smell, refactoring): the demo dropped an unnecessary params.zid.clone() -- LinkstateForwarder::new takes impl Into<Zid>, so it now passes &params.zid[..] (From<&[u8]>, no Vec clone).

Round 311st.decision_summary: R311st: c3c-3 tracked (b) -- migrate the driver's peer-zid plumbing from Option<&[u8]>/&[u8] to the routing Option<Zid>/Zid. The session-layer peer_zid (Vec<u8>) is converted to Zid ONCE at the fan_out read boundary (and the 3 forward read sites), so resolve_source / is_tree_forward_target / is_child / the propagate keep all work in Zid terms (Copy, Eq) instead of re-deriving from raw bytes. Pure behavior-preserving refactor enabled by the sr Zid type; cleans the peer-zid seam F builds on.
changes_bullets: fan_out: the per-face builder callback is now FnMut(FaceId, Option<Zid>) (was Option<&[u8]>); fan_out converts state.actions.peer_zid() (Vec<u8>) -> Option<Zid> via Zid::from_slice at the SINGLE read boundary, so each builder gets a Copy Zid instead of a borrowed byte slice it must re-derive from.

resolve_source(inbound_zid: Option<Zid>, ..) (was Option<&[u8]>): node_id 0 returns inbound_zid? directly (no per-call Zid::from_slice). The 3 forward read sites (forward_push / forward_subscription declare + undeclare) convert peer_zid() -> Option<Zid> at the destructure and pass it (Copy) to BOTH resolve_source and is_tree_forward_target -- the inbound_zid.as_deref() calls are gone.

is_tree_forward_target(zid: Option<Zid>, inbound_zid: Option<Zid>, ..) and is_child(children: &[Zid], zid: Zid) -> children.contains(&zid) (was &[u8] + iter().any(|c| c.as_slice() == zid)). The propagate `keep` closure compares Option<Zid> directly (zid != Some(**z)) instead of via as_slice. is_child is by-value (Zid is Copy), so its three call sites (is_tree_forward_target + the two flood closures) need no textual change.

The session boundary is UNCHANGED: SessionLinkActions::peer_zid() still returns Option<Vec<u8>> (session-core is no_std and routing-agnostic; Zid lives in wz-routing-graph, so the Vec<u8> -> Zid conversion stays in the driver, the correct layer). The only bytes->Zid conversions left are the trusted-handshake boundary reads (fan_out + the 3 forward destructures + register), each via the infallible from_slice; an UNTRUSTED wire zid still validates via try_from at the ingest (sr).

Net effect: the data + control forward paths (source resolution + tree-child selection + re-flood exclusion) work in the routing Zid type end to end -- no more scattered Zid::from_slice / as_slice / as_deref on those paths -- the seam the F discovery subsystem builds on is now Zid-typed. Enabled by sr's Zid (Copy / Eq / Hash / AsRef).

New driver SSOT peer_zid_routing(actions)->Option<Zid> via Zid::try_from (rejects empty/all-zero) replaces all 6 peer_zid().map(from_slice) sites (fan_out + 3 forward reads + register). R3 (UNREPRESENTABLE): Details struct{zid,links} -> enum {Full, LinksOnly, ZidOnly}; make_link_state matches via Details::fields(). The meaningless {false,false} combo is now unconstructible.

R7 (COVERAGE): build_link_added_delta_resolves_at_the_receiver feeds the 2-entry delta into a RECEIVER's ingest -- asserts it learns the neighbour AND resolves self's links-only A->C link (the cross-entry psid resolution that is the delta's whole point, previously only byte-shape-tested) + link_added_delta_resolves_regardless_of_entry_order (the docstring's two-pass tolerance claim).

Round 311sw.decision_summary: R311sw: BUILD FIX for sr -- zid_hex (the router/peer face-log hex helper, cfg(any(routing-router, routing-peer))) imported the routing-peer-only linkstate_forward::Zid (sr's SSOT-via-Zid::Display), so the routing-ROUTER-only demo build (run-ci Layer E3/E5) failed with error[E0432] unresolved import (Zid is gated behind routing-peer). Reverted zid_hex to direct per-byte hex formatting -- byte-identical output, no coupling to the peer-only type. The per-atom demo gate built only routing-peer + default, never routing-router alone, so the break reached the pre-push full run-ci. Build errors are absolute priority.
changes_bullets: runner.rs zid_hex (the face-log hex helper, cfg(any(routing-router, routing-peer))): removed the `use wz::runtime_tokio::linkstate_forward::Zid` import + the Zid::Display delegation that sr added as an SSOT, and restored the direct per-byte `bytes.iter().map(|b| format!("{b:02x}")).collect()` formatting. The bug: linkstate_forward (which re-exports Zid) is gated behind `routing-peer`, but zid_hex compiles under routing-router OR routing-peer -- so the routing-ROUTER-only demo build (run-ci Layer E3 / E5) could not resolve the import and failed to compile. zid_hex is a router/peer face-log display helper; it must not couple to the routing-peer-only Zid type. Output is byte-identical (the same wire-order lowercase hex Zid::Display produces), just formatted in place.

Gate gap that let it through: the sr per-atom demo gate built only `--features routing-peer` (where linkstate_forward exists) + default (where zid_hex is cfg'd out entirely), never routing-router ALONE -- so sr's break reached the pre-push full run-ci undetected.
verification_bullets: wz-ap-demo builds clean on ALL 4 routing feature axes now: routing-router (the axis that broke -- E3/E5), routing-routes, routing-peer (E6), and default. Previously only routing-peer + default were gated per-atom, which is exactly how sr's zid_hex break slipped past to the pre-push gate.

Root-cause provenance: the pre-push full run-ci reported Layer E3 FAIL + E5 FAIL, both `error[E0432]: unresolved import wz::runtime_tokio::linkstate_forward` at runner.rs:1108 (zid_hex), with the compiler note `the item is gated behind the routing-peer feature`. Deterministic build error, NOT a flake.

The fix is demo-only (zid_hex formatting); the routing/keyexpr crates are unchanged, so the graph 45 / session-core 151 / routing-peer lib 361 / clippy / fmt / E6 gates from sv still hold. Full run-ci re-run via the pre-push gate.

Round 311t.decision_summary: R311t Session::query Result-form transition. ReplyHandle::sentinel retired; query/query_aliased/Querier::get return Result with FeatureDisabled honest signal.
changes_bullets: crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/session.rs: Session::query + Session::query_aliased signature flipped to `Result<ReplyHandle, QueryAliasError>`. The `#[cfg(not(feature = "query-get"))]` arm returns `Err(QueryAliasError::FeatureDisabled)` (was R311s stub-form `return ReplyHandle::sentinel();`); the `#[cfg(feature = "query-get")]` arm tail wraps the registered handle in `Ok(handle)`. The R311s doc-comment claims about "stub-form fall-through to a sentinel ReplyHandle(0) to avoid ~22-callsite churn" + "future round may promote to Result-form" rewritten to record the R311t realisation of that promotion and the honest-signal rationale (silent rid=0 fall-through was an anti-pattern matching the doc-around-hack memory anchor — callers that did not check the rid would silently misfile replies into a non-registration).

crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/session.rs: Session::query_aliased_auto inner delegate cleaned — the `#[cfg(feature = "query-get")]` arm previously wrapped `Ok(self.query_aliased(...))` because query_aliased returned ReplyHandle; with query_aliased now returning `Result<ReplyHandle, QueryAliasError>` the inner call propagates directly as the function-tail expression (no double-wrap). doc-comment updated to record the R311t propagation contract.

crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/session.rs: Querier::get signature flipped to `Result<ReplyHandle, QueryAliasError>`; body unchanged (still delegates to `self.session.query(...)` which now propagates the Result directly). QuerierAliased::get unchanged (already returned `Result<_, QueryAliasError>` for the R242 UnknownMapping signal). Both impl doc-comments updated to record the R311t FeatureDisabled-OFF-arm propagation contract.

crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/session.rs: QueryAliasError struct doc-comment rewritten — the R311s claims "Currently unused by the type-ungated declare/query paths" + "those use the stub-form fall-through to a sentinel ReplyHandle(0)" + "variant exists for the future round that may switch Session::query and Querier::get to Result-form" all retracted. New text records the R311t realisation: FeatureDisabled is active across all five entry points (Session::query, query_aliased, query_aliased_auto, Querier::get, QuerierAliased::get) and callers branch uniformly on the same enum across consumer-feature subsets.

crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/session.rs: declare_querier + declare_querier_aliased doc-comments updated — the R311s notes describing the ".get path hits the stub-form fall-through to a sentinel ReplyHandle(0)" rewritten to record the R311t Result-form transition ("returns Err(QueryAliasError::FeatureDisabled) via Session::query/query_aliased_auto's OFF arm — no wire frame, no callback registration").

crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/session.rs: Querier struct doc-comment + the line-75 wz_runtime_core::TimeSource import comment + the line-113 crate::reply imports doc-block all reworded to describe ReplyHandle as the "inner success value" of Session::query's Result return rather than the previous "direct return value flowing through the stub-form sentinel" framing.

crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/reply.rs: ReplyHandle::sentinel() crate-private constructor removed (the cfg-gated `pub(crate) fn sentinel() -> Self { ReplyHandle(0) }` block + its multi-line doc-comment about the rid=0 out-of-band signal). With R311t Session::query's OFF arm returning `Err(FeatureDisabled)` the constructor has no caller and dead-code lint would have flagged it; removing it eliminates the rid=0 sentinel pattern entirely.

crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/session.rs: 22 internal test callsites of Session::query (17) + Session::query_aliased (5) now suffixed with `.expect("query-get feature is ON in this test build")`. The 1 querier.get(&clock, |_| {}, |_| {}); single-line call inside querier_get_threads_target_option_into_wire was split to multi-line + `.expect()`. The 5 `let h0 = ... query(...)` / `let h1 = ... query(...)` / `let h0 = querier.get(...)` / `let h1 = querier.get(...)` / `let q1 = querier.clone().get(...)` / `let q2 = clone.get(...)` bindings were split to multi-line method-chain form `.expect(...)` so the subsequent `.rid()` calls stay typed as ReplyHandle. The expectation message is uniform across all sites — the test target builds with default features which forces `query-get` ON, so the OFF arm is unreachable from those test bodies.
verification_bullets: cargo check 7-lane clean: default-features build OK; --no-default-features OK; --no-default-features --features=query-get OK; --no-default-features --features=query-queryable OK; --no-default-features --features=liveliness-token OK; --no-default-features --features=liveliness-subscriber OK; --no-default-features --features=declare-queryable OK; --no-default-features --features=declare-subscriber OK. Round 311ta.decision_summary: R311ta: 4-agent session review REFUTED self-assessment: sy ends_with('/') was incomplete (1/4 forms), duplicated, missed local delivery. Replaced by one matcher-SSOT invariant covering all forms+consumers; fixed sz Proof 2.
changes_bullets: Review (4/4 convergent): sy ported only zenoh's ends_with('/') fast-path, not OwnedKeyExpr::try_from (pubsub.rs:957) -- home//temp, /home, "" still spuriously matched `**` subs and forwarded.

And it was duplicated across 2 crates while declared_intersects (the LOCAL subscriber-delivery scan) had none -- a local `home/**` sub still fired on home/temp/ (sy's "reaches NO subscriber" was false).

Fix: removed both ends_with('/') guards; one invariant target_chunks_well_formed (empty chunk => no match) now lives inside BOTH matcher entries (keyexpr_pattern_matches + keyexpr_intersects_target), so all consumers inherit it by construction.

Coverage: forward (route_targets/matching_peers), local delivery (has_matching), switchboard all go through the matcher -> all 4 empty-chunk forms reach NO subscriber on ANY path, not just the trailing slash.

sz fix: next_hop's "Proof 2" (freed hop => dest detached) was FALSE (a diamond keeps dest alive via an alternate subtree while its first-hop is freed); the arm is unreachable SOLELY via scrub's by-value null (Proof 1). Corrected.
verification_bullets: New tests, both mutation-verified (guard off => both fail): a_malformed_target_with_an_empty_chunk_matches_nothing (4 forms x 2 matcher entries) + subscriber_has_matching_false_on_a_malformed_published_key (local delivery). Each + a well-formed control.

No regression: session-core lib 152 (+1); no-alloc lib 69 (the matcher test runs no-alloc too); routing-peer 362; routing-routes routing_forward 21 (sy's e2e tests still pass via the matcher); graph 45. clippy -D warnings + fmt clean.

Grounding (direct read): zenoh compute_data_route = ends_with('/') (pubsub.rs:948) then OwnedKeyExpr::try_from (:957). Empty-chunk is the structural subset a concrete target violates; keyexpr_canon stays the full-grammar SSOT (cross-ref'd in the helper doc).
