Round 311xy.decision_summary: R311xy -- liveliness-history active flip (R2 follow-up to R311xx). With the R311xx correctness fix in place (history_complete now fires on the responder's Declare(DeclFinal); the responder replays current tokens only on the CURRENT bit), liveliness-history is promoted from reserved to active by adding the REAL per-call cfg gate R311cl prescribed ("careful per-call cfg-gate, not field gate"): Session::declare_liveliness_subscriber{_aliased} computes `#[cfg(feature = "liveliness-history")] let history = options.history;` / `#[cfg(not(...))] let history = false;` once per declare path and uses that local at the three consumers (register / build_interest / cache_subscriber_interest). OFF -> the subscriber is future-only and LivelinessSubscriberOptions.history / with_history() / history_complete() stay callable no-ops (signature-stable). The feature forwards wz (was a no-op `= []` facade) -> wz-runtime-tokio (new `= ["liveliness-subscriber"]`, in the crate default for behavior preservation); preset-ap-client gained it so wz-ap-demo + the leg-7 wz<->zenohd history interop keep history ON. liveliness-historical-samples stays reserved but reclassified FOUNDATIONAL -- the current-token replay is the responder side (LocalTokenRegistry::respond_to_interest), SHARED with the already-active liveliness-get path, so it is not separately cfg-gateable on history. CI Layer C1ai drives the gate ON + OFF (clippy). zenoh/zenoh-pico expose history as a runtime option only, so this compile-time elision is a wz superset for slim presence-only builds (superset-not-mirror). Also corrected the inventory source-field misnomer: history rides zenoh InterestMode::CurrentFuture, NOT a Z_EXT_HISTORY extension. §5.10 liveliness now 4 active (token/subscriber/get/history) + 1 FOUNDATIONAL (historical-samples). full run-ci RUNCI_EXIT=0; validate_workspace orphan new=+0; Layer A3 consistent (active <=> >=1 cfg site).

changes_bullets: advanced_subscriber.rs: HistoryConfig gains `detect_late_publishers: bool` + builder (the full zenoh HistoryConfig surface). NEW State::handle_late_publisher(zid,eid)->bool — opens ONE recovery slot per source (pending_queries gate, no concurrent piling-up of GETs); independent of `retransmission` (a HISTORY trigger, not a recovery one). NEW issue_late_publisher_query — a PER-PUBLISHER history GET (recovery_get_ke(base,zid_hex,eid) + the shared history_selector `_max`/`_time`), feeding the per-source ordering + finish_recovery on the terminal Final (vs issue_history_query's `<base>/@adv/**` whole-fan). NEW on_late_publisher_detected — the liveliness-callback-body SSOT (kind==Put -> parse_heartbeat_source -> handle_late_publisher -> issue the GET); the real liveliness closure is THIN GLUE over it. declare_with_options: when history.detect_late_publishers, declare a LIVELINESS subscriber on `<ke>/@adv/pub/**` (LivelinessSubscriberOptions::new() = history=false, future-only — the startup history GET already recovered publishers present at declare). The handle is type-erased to `Box<dyn Send>` because LivelinessSubscriber is <R,T> but AdvancedSubscriber is R-only. AdvancedSubscribeError gains a gated `Liveliness(LivelinessSubscriberAliasError)` variant + From (safe on the `#[non_exhaustive]` enum, the H1 signature-stability invariant).
Cargo.toml: ext-pubsub-advanced-history += `liveliness-subscriber` (the new dep for declare_liveliness_subscriber).

Round 311y103.decision_summary: R311y103 -- bincode-1.3 wire width-helper SSOT (the 22nd-review HIGH structural refactor): the aligner and group codecs each hand-rolled identical push_u32/push_string/push_option_string/read_u8/read_u32 widths, and their read_string length guards had drifted (aligner inlined a try_into+len>remaining check; group routed through the shared check_len). Hoisted the six multi-consumer structural widths into crate::wire_bincode as gated pub(crate) free fns; the aligner's inherent reads became thin delegations and its inline stripped_key Option push became push_option_string. Kept WireError minimal (no enrich-WireError) so the frozen digest codec stays untouched; each codec keeps its domain validity at a thin wrapper. Hardened check_len to reject a len exceeding usize, restoring the aligner read_string's over-usize reject and uniformly hardening every length-prefixed read. 3-agent adversarial review + direct-read arbitration: no 64-bit byte change; 7 stale doc comments swept.
changes_bullets: crates/wz-session-core/src/wire_bincode.rs: +6 gated pub(crate) free fns (push_u32 / push_string / push_option_string / read_u8 / read_u32 / read_len_prefixed_bytes), gate any(storage-aligner, ext-pubsub-group-membership); hardened check_len to reject a len exceeding usize via try_from (the over-usize guard the aligner read_string used to inline); module / Reader / section docs corrected to the 3-consumer + correct-gate reality.

crates/wz-session-core/src/group_membership.rs: removed local push_u32 / push_string / push_option_string / read_u32 (import the shared widths); push_option_string call -> Option<&str> (m.info.as_deref()); read_string -> read_len_prefixed_bytes; read_option_string -> read_u8; module + encode/decode comments updated.

Round 311y106.decision_summary: R311y106 -- routing-namespace (§5.21) ACTIVE FLIP: the y105 per-participant keyexpr namespace decorator wired into the unicast session data plane. Egress at the unicast Tp::send_network_message arm + the send_response reply seam + the reconnect declaration-replay seam (the three local-origin emit paths; the forwarder floor is bypassed so relays are never re-namespaced). Ingress = the stateful NamespaceIngress strip at both drive-loop owned-outcome mint points, before the observer fan-out. Config via the SessionLinkActions::set_namespace AP setter + the {connect,accept,initiate}_and_open_session_with_namespace helpers -- SessionInitParams and all MCU files untouched, no cargo feature-unification footgun. A 3-agent design panel (pre-code) plus a 3-agent implementation panel (post-build) drove the structure; the carry's matching_status namespace-qualify was DROPPED as a double-namespace bug (the ingress strips inbound declares to relative form, so the remote table is already relative), and multicast namespace is deferred unrepresentable-by-construction to R311y107. Inventory routing-namespace reserved->active.

Round 311y106b.decision_summary: R311y106b -- SESSION-REVIEW correction of R311y106 (found committed-but-unpushed, the user's textbook/SSOT/north-star trigger). A 3-agent adversarial session review caught one MUST-FIX that 6 prior panels + the author missed: the LIVE DeclareKeyExpr alias DEFINITION (send_declare_keyexpr) shipped BARE past the egress arm, while its reconnect-replay twin shipped namespaced -- the same operation handled two ways (an SSOT violation, the un-namespaced branch being the live one), reachable from the high-level aliased API (publish_aliased/query_aliased require a prior send_declare_keyexpr) and leaking a namespaced session's aliased publish to the bare keyexpr. Fix: the live alias definition now namespaces on the wire via the generalized namespace_egress_declare helper (now the single SSOT shared by the live alias path AND the reconnect replay), keeping outbound_mappings bare for loopback (transparent namespace, the zenoh model). Plus a doc-precision fix: the namespace.rs forwarder-safety claim is corrected to the real invariant (a namespaced face is never a forwarder face) instead of the egress-only-precise structural argument. Added the load-bearing namespace_alias_e2e test + the declare-keyexpr CI combo; deferral (b) narrowed to the three helpers with no high-level dependency. 18 kernel + 10 e2e green, fmt/clippy clean.
changes_bullets: session_actions.rs send_declare_keyexpr: the LIVE DeclareKeyExpr alias DEFINITION now passes through the egress decorator (namespace_egress_declare) before its direct dispatch_declare, so the wire alias is baked WITH the namespace (peer registers id -> <ns>/<suffix>); the local outbound_mappings keeps the BARE suffix for loopback resolution (transparent namespace, the zenoh model). Closes the isolation hole where a namespaced session's aliased publish/query (publish_aliased / query_aliased / *_auto, which require a prior send_declare_keyexpr) leaked to the bare keyexpr.

session_actions.rs: generalized replay_namespace_declare -> namespace_egress_declare (the egress-decorate-a-direct-dispatched-Declare SSOT now shared by BOTH the live alias definition AND the reconnect replay), re-gated to the exact caller union all(routing-namespace, any(declare-keyexpr, all(session-reconnect, any(declare-subscriber, declare-queryable, declare-token)))) so it is neither dead-code nor missing-method in any combo; replay_namespace_interest -> namespace_egress_interest (reconnect-only, name parity).

namespace.rs module doc: corrected the forwarder-coexistence safety claim. The old "boundaries distinct -> relays untouched, correct by construction" was egress-precise but ingress-imprecise (the ingress strip runs BEFORE on_event, which feeds the forwarder, so a namespaced FORWARDING face would relay the stripped relative keyexpr). Now states the real invariant: a namespaced face is NEVER a forwarder face (set_namespace reachable only from the client-open helpers; the router/peer face path never installs one), and flags that the future multihat router must re-examine strip-vs-forward ordering.

Round 311y108.decision_summary: R311y108 -- §5.21 router-hat slice 1a (dual-net topology STATE). Built RouterForwarder, the 4th impl FaceForwarder (crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/router_forward.rs), the wz port of zenoh hat/router's DUAL link-state mesh (routers_net + linkstatepeers_net) distinct from the single-net LinkstateForwarder. Slice 1a is the control-plane TOPOLOGY half: register/deregister classify a face into a tier by handshake whatami (Router->routers_net, Peer->linkstatepeers_net, Client/zidless->held no net); forward ingests OAM_LINKSTATE into the inbound tier's net + propagates within that tier + coalesces the per-net spanning-tree recompute onto the tick; the flood is TIER-SCOPED (a routers_net change reaches only Router faces -- the two psid spaces never cross-inject, the one router-specific seam since the gossip_target matcher cannot separate the nets). Push is counted (witness) but routed nowhere; Declare/Request/Response left alone. Decided via a pre-code 3-lens DESIGN panel (faithfulness/SSOT-reuse/scope) + a post-build 3-lens IMPL panel (faithfulness found NO logic bug / coverage / SSOT-honesty). Reuse strategy B: own 2 nets + 4 tier tables, reuse the shared LinkstateNetwork + LinkstatepeerInterest crates, pub(crate) peer_zid_routing/peer_whatami_routing, thin per-net wrappers, LinkstateForwarder untouched -- the y107b 'DOUBLED ~6000 LOC' fear was falsified (most of linkstate_forward.rs is tests; the algorithm SSOT is in the shared crates; the slice's fresh surface is ~250 lines of thin glue). The new routing-router-hat cargo feature is a FOUNDATION feature (the routing-accept precedent: a partial capability that gates code WITHOUT being an inventory atom), NOT the router-hat-router atom -- slice 1a routes nothing, the exact analogue of routing-accept (accept-and-hold without forwarding), so router-hat-router stays RESERVED and flips active only when the HAT routes (the COMPUTE slice), mirroring routing-routes/routing-router flipping active on the routing-accept foundation. CORRECTS the router-hat-multihat inventory mis-spec: its reason frames the multi-hat seam as zenoh's Box<dyn Any> type-erasure, but wz realizes the SAME seam via the typed FaceForwarder trait (accept_loop.rs:194) -- no Box<dyn Any>, no new_hat factory; RouterForwarder is the 4th typed impl. The seam is DONE + class=foundational, so router-hat-multihat correctly stays reserved+FOUNDATIONAL; only the Box<dyn Any> reason framing is the mis-spec (no inventory mutation -- the correction lives in this ledger entry per the build plan). 14 unit tests, CI Layer C1ay, Layer A3 green (the foundation feature is not an atom id, so reserved router atoms keep 0 cfg sites).

Round 311y11.decision_summary: R311y11 -- track 2 (macOS/Windows CI): added a `portability` job to .github/workflows/ci.yml -- a matrix [macos-latest, windows-latest] that NATIVELY cargo-checks the wz AP stack (GitHub provides real mac/win runners, not cross-compile). Catches the target_os-routed AP regressions the Linux `ci` job cannot reach -- chiefly the quic-datagram per-OS max_datagram MTU consts (linux/macos/windows arms). Scope = the portable feature surface (default tcp/udp set + transport-link-quic-datagram); deliberately does NOT enable transport-link-{unixpipe,vsock} off-Linux (those pull dep:libc / dep:tokio-vsock from the [target.linux] table, so enabling them on a non-Linux target is an invalid dep: reference by construction -- they are Linux-only backends by the R311y10/vsock design). cargo CHECK (not test), a build-sce.sh prefix (shell: bash for the Windows git-bash runner), the Linux-only Layer A-F deps (mnemosyne-cli/protoc/zenoh-pico) skipped. Round 311y110.decision_summary: R311y110 -- §5.21 router-hat slice 1c (queryable dual-tier INGEST). Added the queryable twin of 1b to RouterForwarder: forward's DeclareQueryable registers the resolve_source_in-resolved SOURCE into the INBOUND tier's qabls table (Router face -> router_qabls, Peer face -> linkstatepeer_qabls) with VALUE = the declared QueryableInfo read off the DeclQueryable ext chain, gated by the VALUE-DIFF gate (a NEW peer OR a CHANGED info re-floods -- so a queryable flipping complete:false->true re-propagates), and re-floods a clean declaration CARRYING that info within the tier (build_declare_queryable_with_info) so a multi-hop relay learns the completeness. UndeclareQueryable stays deferred (the wz-codecs body carries no keyexpr ext -> per-keyexpr retraction needs a codec atom; the face-down purge is the safety net, the same gap the sibling documents). Like the sub bubble (1b), the cross-tier queryable bubble -- a MERGED info in zenoh (local_router_qabl_info/local_peer_qabl_info, queries.rs:67/102, complete=OR/distance=min) -- is DERIVED at compute from the NATIVE qabls, NOT stored (1b DERIVE-vs-STORE panel F6: storing a computed aggregate already means recompute-on-change, so deriving-at-read is strictly simpler + drops the teardown). declare_queryable_wireexpr + build_declare_queryable_with_info widened to pub(crate) (reuse, not fork). ingest_queryable is the query twin of ingest_subscription, sharing reflood_declaration + resolve_source_in + fan_out_tier. The §5.21 router INGEST plane for the MESH tiers is now COMPLETE (subs 1b + qabls 1c). DEFERRED (named): client/simple store = 1d; the bubble DERIVATION + route compute + master-election + tree-change re_advertise = the COMPUTE slice. router-hat-router atom STAYS reserved (1c's re-flood is control-plane interest spread, NOT data/query route -- routing-router-hat remains the FOUNDATION feature). 34 unit tests, CI Layer C1ay (1a-1c), A3 green, 127 linkstate unregressed. Decided via a focused 2-lens post-build IMPL panel (faithfulness: SHIP no logic bug byte-faithful mirror; coverage/SSOT: clean, drove +2 content/inert tests) reusing the 1b DERIVE-vs-STORE design.

Reuses reflood_declaration / resolve_source_in / fan_out_tier (no new shared machinery). NO cross-tier bubble stored -- the merged local_*_qabl_info bubble is DERIVED at compute (1b DERIVE-vs-STORE F6).

Round 311y112.decision_summary: R311y112 = C0 reuse-A extraction (pre-COMPUTE foundation, OBLIGATION 3). Extracted the LinkstateForwarder data-route + tree-change re-advertise algorithmic cores into two pub(crate) free helpers (compute_push_forward + re_advertise_interest_into<V>) so the forthcoming RouterForwarder per-tier COMPUTE consumes them per tier-net instead of copy-pasting the battle-tested single-net bodies (the share-per-net-logic-via-helpers-NOT-copy-paste constraint). re_advertise_interest_into parameterizes the NET (the one thing the single-net version hard-bound) so the router stamps out_node_id in the correct tier psid space. LinkstateForwarder::forward_push + re_advertise_interest re-wired to thin callers. Behavior-neutral; a 3-agent pre-code design panel chose free-helper extraction over a RoutingPlane struct and mandated splitting this pure extraction (C0) from the router-consumption slice (C1) so a green run isolates any regression source.
changes_bullets: crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/linkstate_forward.rs: extracted two pub(crate) free helpers beside resolve_source_in. compute_push_forward(net, subs, inbound_zid, inbound_link, push, keyexpr) -> Option<(carrier, children)> = the forward_push route CORE (source-resolve -> self-excluded interested_remote -> directions_toward -> hop-limit -> literal-normalize), reading ONLY net + subs so the caller owns the faces-borrow + fan-out. re_advertise_interest_into<V>(net, table, new_children, build, flood) = the re_advertise_interest core with the NET parameterized (the single-net version hard-bound self.net; parameterizing it lets the router stamp out_node_id in the CORRECT tier psid space -- routers_net for router_subs, linkstatepeers_net for linkstatepeer_subs) and the flood as a closure.

LinkstateForwarder::forward_push re-wired to a compute_push_forward call (its gossip-gated + egress-ACL fan_out over the returned (carrier, children) unchanged); re_advertise_interest body re-wired to a re_advertise_interest_into call passing flood_to_children as the flood closure.

carry_forward_bullets: R311y112 = C0 reuse-A extraction DONE (LOCAL, atop origin/main=c47cd1a). reuse-A = free-helper extraction (b), NOT a RoutingPlane struct (a, rejected by the design panel: forward_push needs self.faces + the egress-ACL fan_out, not plane-owned state; the router keeps ONE tier-tagged faces map, not per-plane). This is OBLIGATION-3's "Plane-extraction pre-COMPUTE".

COMPUTE plan (atom-per-round): C0(extraction, this) -> C1(router within-tier data route via compute_push_forward per tier + tick per-net re_advertise_interest_into for subs+qabls + self-zid parity guard in BOTH register paths) -> C2(cross_tier_self_source derive, single-router fail-fast fenced) -> C3(client leaf store + deregister purge BEFORE the linkless early-return) -> C4(master-election elect_router HRW; shared_nodes for route-master vs get_router_links per-peer for ingress/egress -- a real asymmetry to preserve) -> C5(query route + source-dimensioned route cache).

3-agent pre-code design panel verdicts (folded in): (1) derive-not-store faithful, 3 PRECISION reqs -- derive folds EXACTLY zenoh's contributor set (other-tier natives excl-self UNION client) on the EXACT keyexpr; the qabl derive returns a MERGED info (complete=OR / distance=min) carried into the re-advertise ext_info; UNION{self} drives the re-advertise/advertisement path ONLY, never the self-excluded data forward (wz directions_toward resolves dest==source to self's PARENT, so splicing self would add a spurious upstream target). (2) C1 within-tier = FAITHFUL SUBSET, not broken -- zenoh's peer-mesh block for a peer-sourced Push is master-gate-free ((master || source_type!=Router)&&full), so a non-master routing peer-sourced traffic within the peer mesh IS a real zenoh path; C1 only UNDER-routes (omits client [C3] + cross-tier [C2/C4]), never mis-routes. (3) C2-without-C4 is byte-equal to zenoh in single-router (shared_nodes=={self} -> elect returns self -> master=true) but DOUBLE-DELIVERS the instant a 2nd router appears -- C2 MUST fail-fast fence shared_nodes<=1 and land C4 before any multi-router e2e. (4) self-zid register guard is behavior-IMPROVING not neutral (unguarded, make_link_state emits a self-loop link psid 0 onto the wire + a spurious sn bump; rebuild_edges only suppresses the local petgraph self-edge) -> belongs in C1, not the neutral C0. (5) OBLIGATION 1 defers correctly to C3/C5 (C1/C2 add no FaceId-keyed leaf state; keyexpr_table already drops before the early-return); no lifecycle-asymmetry twin (FaceIds monotonic non-reused, reconnect=deregister+register, dedup drops the NEW face; reset_for_reopen is the forwarder-less single-session client driver). Document "router driven only by accept_loop/peer_loop" as the loop invariant.
NEXT = C1 (own commit, same push batch as C2; NOT pushed without explicit consent).

carry_forward_bullets: R311y113 = C1 router within-tier data route + tick re-advertise + self-zid parity DONE (LOCAL, atop C0 4e13caa atop origin/main=c47cd1a). The router now ROUTES a Push WITHIN its inbound tier (peer-sourced -> peer-mesh subs, router-sourced -> router-mesh subs, both proven), RE-ADVERTISES each tier's native subs+qabls to late-joining tree children on the tick, and GUARDS a self-zid self-connect on both forwarders. Within-tier = a faithful SUBSET of zenoh's master-gate-free route blocks (compute_data_route peer-mesh block is (master||source_type!=Router)&&full); it only UNDER-routes (no cross-tier bridge, no local-client delivery), never mis-routes.

NEXT = C2 (cross_tier_self_source DERIVE). The 3 PRECISION reqs the design panel pinned: (1) derive folds EXACTLY zenoh's contributor set -- other-tier natives (excl self) UNION the client store -- on the EXACT keyexpr, synthesized as a virtual (K->self) per exact-ke that flows through the same wildcard match as real natives; (2) the qabl derive returns a MERGED QueryableInfo (complete=OR / distance=min via merge_qabl_infos) carried into the re-advertise ext_info; (3) the UNION{self} drives the re-advertise/advertisement path ONLY, NEVER the self-excluded data forward-target set (wz directions_toward resolves dest==source to self's PARENT, so splicing self would add a spurious upstream target -- a loop/dup zenoh never produces). C2 MUST fail-fast fence shared_nodes<=1 (single-router) until C4, else a 2nd router double-delivers.

THEN C3 (client leaf sub/qabl store -- FaceId-keyed, so its deregister purge MUST sit BEFORE the linkless early-return, mirror linkstate pending.remove_face-first), C4 (master-election elect_router HRW = argmax DefaultHasher(key_expr ++ zid); TWO candidate sets -- shared_nodes [zids in BOTH graphs, needs a new node-zid iterator on LinkstateNetwork] for the route master vs get_router_links(face.zid) [buildable from Node.links/whatami pub API] for ingress/egress per-peer -- a real asymmetry to preserve), C5 (compute_query_route Request/Response + pending-query table + source-dimensioned route cache invalidated on BOTH tiers' interest mutations).

OPEN OBLIGATION (impl-panel A, R311y113): the router's fan_out_tier egress-ACL PARITY -- it lacks the single-net fan_out's admit_outbound gate + interceptor_dropped witness, so a within-tier Push/re-advertise reaches a child a §5.16 egress-deny would drop. Silent (no router interceptor plane yet). Add both when the router interceptor plane lands. Also carried: self-zid guard is behavior-IMPROVING (proven), NOT in the behavior-neutral C0.

Round 311y114.decision_summary: R311y114 = C2 client cross-tier subscription advertisement (cross_tier_self_source in its single-router client form). A CLIENT-face DeclareSubscriber lands in a per-face client_subs leaf store (was dropped) and the router advertises self's derived cross-tier interest into BOTH meshes (a self-sourced DeclareSubscriber node_id 0 flooded to self's tree children, re-derived on the tick for late joiners), so a mesh publisher routes the keyexpr toward this router. DISCOVERY: the router-router MESH federation bridge is MULTI-ROUTER (router_subs empty in single-router) so it couples with election C4, not a standalone slice; the single-router value is CLIENT interconnect and C2 is its advertisement half. DERIVE-not-STORE (client_subs SSOT, self never in the tier tables, the derived self-source drives the advertisement/re-advertise path ONLY). Advertisement NOT master-gated (faithful). Client face-down purges client_subs BEFORE deregister's linkless early-return (OBLIGATION 1). A 3-agent post-build impl panel (faithfulness+derive / borrow+composition / OBLIGATION-1+lifecycle) ALL PASS with no bug; folded its coverage findings (3 tests) + a sharper advertise-then-blackhole doc note.

changes_bullets: crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/router_forward.rs:

deliver_to_client_subscribers re-routed through fan_out_tier(FaceTier::Client) -- the tier-scoped egress SSOT every other router send uses (forward_push_tier, flood_delta_tier, reflood_declaration, flood_link_added_tier, propagate_tier). Round 311y121.decision_summary: R311y121 -- §5.21 router daemon COMPUTE C5b: router query-route FORWARD (Request) half. RouterForwarder::route_request ports zenoh compute_query_route (hat/router/queries.rs:1426) + compute_final_route (dispatcher/queries.rs:205) -- the SAME 3-block master-gated structure as the data plane's route_push (routers_net qabls / linkstatepeers_net qabls / client queryables), reusing C4's is_master, with the within-tier + master-gated cross-mesh (self-origination node_id 0) + client-delivery + client-source self-inject legs split exactly as forward_push_tier / bridge_push_cross_mesh / deliver_to_client_subscribers / publish_client_push_into_meshes. The one query-specific twist is the GLOBAL BestMatching: zenoh compute_final_route picks the FIRST complete in the union route sorted by SELF-relative distance, so the C5a per-net compute_query_directions does NOT compose -- best_query_winner picks the min over each net's per-net nearest-complete (select_best_matching, min-of-mins == global-min, truncated `as u16` like zenoh net.distances[..] as u16) and the client candidates at distance 1, so a local client (distance 1) beats a 1-hop mesh queryable (link weight 100, matching zenoh DEFAULT_LINK_WEIGHT); All/AllComplete compose per-tier. A CLIENT DeclareQueryable lands in a per-face client_qabls store (ingest_client_queryable). Each forwarded Request ALLOCATES a PendingQueries return entry (the reverse Response route is C5c); deregister purges client_qabls + pending BEFORE the linkless early-return (OBLIGATION 1). An EMPTY route -- and an unresolvable keyexpr alias -- PROMPT a ResponseFinal so the querier terminates (zenoh unknown-scope/empty-route); an unresolvable mesh source drops ONLY the within-tier leg (route_push parity), NOT the cross/client legs. SSOT: select_best_matching refactored to return (f64 distance, hop) [the peer discards it, behavior-neutral] + 3 helpers exposed pub(crate). STRUCTURE/routing-only; inventory UNCHANGED (router stays unit-tested-only; the router-hat-router active flip is ACTIVATION). A 3-agent post-build IMPL panel (zenoh-fidelity / correctness+borrow / SSOT+coverage) ran: NO blocker or correctness bug -- routing verified faithful by direct source read; folded 1 fidelity fix (the unresolvable-source/keyexpr query-termination gap), 1 false-doc fix (the BestMatching truncation comment had described an impossible mesh-vs-client tie), and 6 coverage tests. 84 router + 12 peer-query oracle green; full lib 507; clippy 2-combo + fmt clean; validate orphan new=+0.

New fields: client_qabls (per-face hosted-queryable store) / pending (crate::linkstate_pending::PendingQueries, reused verbatim) / queries_seen / query_timeout / clock. new() funnels through with_clock(Instant::now); + set_query_timeout + now(). Pre-code DESIGN panel (BLOCKER: the unlisted Oam-detach remove path + the client re-gate) + post-build IMPL panel (both PASS; folded a direct Oam-detach withdraw test + a stale-deferral-doc rewrite). Behavior-neutral for a single router; the E2E black-hole proof lands with the 2-router ACTIVATION-4 harness. Inventory UNCHANGED (router-hat-router stays reserved).

crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/router_forward.rs: the FEDERATION cross-tier-native SUBSCRIPTION bubble. The cross-tier self-advertisement now derives from the OTHER tier's NATIVES, not client_subs ONLY (C2): a ROUTER-native sub advertises self's interest into the PEER mesh, a PEER-native into the ROUTER mesh (zenoh register_router_subscription cross-registers self into the peer tier on face.whatami!=Peer, pubsub.rs:248-250; declare_linkstatepeer_subscription into the router tier, :296-297). NOT master-gated (every router advertises; only the DELIVERY bridge is master-gated). ONE per-target derive SSOT: self_advertises_sub_into(target,ke)=any_client_subscribes||contributor_subs_source_count>0 (the bool), derived_cross_tier_subs_into(target)=client keys ∪ opposite-mesh native entries (the set) feed the immediate advertise (flip false->true edge), the tick re-advertise, and — as the EXACT NEGATION — the withdraw. opposite_mesh(Routers)=LinkstatePeers involution. advertise_native_cross_tier_sub (sole native source_count==1 + no client) / withdraw_native_cross_tier_sub (!self_advertises_sub_into). ingest_interest now returns Option<String> (Some(ke) on a real change) so ingest_subscription fires the advertise only on a genuine flip.

crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/router_forward.rs: WITHDRAW centralized in purge_detached_interest_tier (the SHARED choke point) via remove_peer_keys → withdraw per affected keyexpr AFTER dropping the table borrows, so BOTH its callers — deregister (local face-down) AND the forward Oam-ingest changes.removed (REMOTE topology detach) — retract a departed native's stale advertisement (the R311y107b lifecycle-asymmetry class). The native undeclare path (withdraw_subscription) also withdraws. The 2-ROUTER federation query is smoke-proven (issuer behind R1 -> router mesh -> queryable behind R2) but deferred as a CI test (one-shot-query vs 2-hop advertise flake risk, no-flaky-ever). Reuses Layer E7. STRUCTURE + test only; inventory unchanged.

Round 311y134.decision_summary: R311y134 -- 5.22 plugin family honest reclassification (follow-up #6). Direct-read of zenoh 49c8a53 commons/zenoh-plugin-trait + arbitration: the entire zenoh RUNTIME plugin system (dlopen .so + PluginsManager registry + Plugin host-trait + lifecycle FSM + ABI-compat gate + static-registration) exists solely to compose OPTIONAL out-of-tree subsystems (the plugins/ dir IS storage-manager + REST) at runtime, and is NOT load-bearing for core routing. wz OBVIATES it via compile-time cargo-feature composition -- zero libloading/PluginsManager in wz, and the subsystems zenoh loads as plugins are already wz feature families (5.24 storage, 5.26 rest); the in-tree decision is explicit (storage_config.rs:19: wz composes at build time, not via dlopen). So the family is obviated as a whole (superset-not-mirror). Corrected 5 reasons: host-trait/lifecycle foundational -> out-of-scope, manager cfg -> out-of-scope, static-registration cfg -> foundational/already-realized (cargo [features]+cfg IS the static registration), abi-compat foundational-inert -> out-of-scope (inseparable from dynamic-loading); dynamic-loading stays out-of-scope. Inventory reasons ONLY -- no code/Cargo/CI, no status change (all 6 stay reserved with 0 cfg sites); A3 unaffected; re-openable AP-only. NOT a buildable gap.

plugin-host-trait: foundational -> OUT-OF-SCOPE (the Plugin start()/StartArgs/Instance contract, plugin.rs:182, exists only to give the runtime manager a uniform start seam; wz wires each subsystem via cfg with no always-on host-trait analog).

plugin-lifecycle: foundational -> OUT-OF-SCOPE (Declared->Loaded->Started, plugin.rs:36, models a runtime-load pipeline whose Declared->Loaded gap exists only because dlopen can fail; a cfg subsystem is compiled-in-or-absent).
plugin-manager: cfg -> OUT-OF-SCOPE (PluginsManager runtime registry, manager.rs:104; wz composes statically + introspects via 5.23 adminspace, no plugin registry).

plugin-static-registration: cfg -> FOUNDATIONAL/already-realized (declare_static_plugin manager.rs:131 IS compile-time selection; wz realizes the SAME static registration at the build-system layer -- cargo [features]+cfg(feature) audited by audit-catalog-status.sh -- not a runtime call).

plugin-abi-compat: foundational-inert -> OUT-OF-SCOPE (Compatibility/StructVersion, compatibility.rs:57; sole caller is the dynamic loader dynamic_plugin.rs:71; a compile-time build has one ABI by construction, inseparable from dynamic-loading).
plugin-dynamic-loading: unchanged (already OUT-OF-SCOPE: dlopen .so + repr(C) vtable, dynamic_plugin.rs:30 / vtable.rs:61; no_std-impossible; re-openable AP-only).

The 6 concepts map to that machine; abi-compat + dynamic-loading are dlopen-bound; host-trait/lifecycle/manager earn value only inside the manager+dlopen loop.

wz obviates it by COMPILE-TIME cargo-feature composition: grep for libloading/PluginsManager/declare_static_plugin across crates = ZERO wz hits; the very subsystems zenoh needs plugins for are already first-class wz feature families (5.24 storage-backend, 5.26 rest). The in-tree decision is explicit: wz-session-core/src/storage_config.rs:19 "wz composes volumes at build time, not via dlopen -- storage-mgr-dynamic-volume-loading is out-of-scope-AP". Both spot-checked and confirmed.

Superset-not-mirror: wz's build-time composition is a type-safe/no-ABI-risk/no-dlopen superset that makes the runtime plugin system out-of-scope (re-openable for the AP/std tier only; MCU/no_std cannot dlopen). No genuine buildable gap in the family; static-registration is already realized as the feature system itself.

Round 311y141.decision_summary: R311y141 -- wz-side inbound Interest handling (Tier 1 CURRENT mode, SUBSCRIBERS + QUERYABLES) closes the reverse-data black-hole (pub@wz -> sub@zenohd) + the cross-impl query twin. ROOT CAUSE (spike + zenohd RUST_LOG=trace + pico direct-read): a zenoh(-pico) publisher/querier write-filter drops its own put/get LOCALLY until the router answers its declare-Interest with a matching DeclareSubscriber/DeclareQueryable, and wz dropped the Interest (_ => {}) so the filter never deactivated and the pico publisher behind wz never put data on the wire. The prior carry (wz never learns zenohd declarations / wz-receives-but-drops) was REFUTED -- ingest+delivery are correct. FIX = respond_to_interest + dump_interest_{subs,qabls} replying per matching REMOTE decl + a DeclareFinal; aggregate keyed on the interest ke (pico equals-match), reply carries interest_id + FLAG_N_DECLARE_I, DeclareFinal carries interest_id (pico hard-errors without), queryable folds the merged complete bit. New reply builders in declare_build.rs (not the liveliness-gated local_token). Tier 1 only; FUTURE + Interest(Final) + peer forwarder + match-all + KEYEXPRS = round B. 3-agent DESIGN + 3-agent IMPL adversarial review, all arbitrated by direct-read; product code faithful+robust, 2 test-quality MAJORs fixed; one intentional divergence logged (aggregate qabl-info fold scope).

The queryable reply folds the matched QueryableInfo via set_declare_queryable_info. + 3 wire-byte unit tests pinning the [0x3E, VLE(id), ...] I-flag+id lead. Placed here (NOT local_token.rs) because build_{token,final}_reply are liveliness-token-gated, absent in the routing-router-hat -> routing-peer lane (the CI clippy lane) -> reusing them was a compile-fail BLOCKER caught at design review.

Forwarder E2E prove the PUSH MECHANISM, direct-read verified against pico: a C+F interest with no matching sub -> only a DeclareFinal (stored, not answered); a LATER sub -> an UNSOLICITED DeclareSubscriber with interest_id None + a NON-ZERO id + keyed on the AGGREGATE interest ke (demo/key, not the concrete demo/**), NOT echoed to the origin. The aggregate-ke discriminator is the anti-false-proof: a same-tier relay would forward demo/**, so demo/key can only come from the future-push logic (C-round false-proof lesson honored). Round 311y15.decision_summary: R311y15 -- fix the 3 red CI jobs to green. (1) Layer A: the CI-pinned mnemosyne-cli (R415, schema <=9) could not read the current atomic store (schema_version 23), hard-failing 'schema version mismatch' on every push; bumped the pin to R584 (bb01cc6b, on mnemosyne origin/main), matching the locally-installed --path binary. (2) Layer Q: the mps2-an386/an500 qemu hang root-caused to a non-monotonic SystickClock::now_us() in mcu-qemu-demo -- on Cortex-M4F/M7 the SysTick exception is delayed past a wrap boundary so wraps lags and now_us steps backward, violating the ClockSource monotonic contract; the backward step makes a SleepFuture see now<deadline AFTER pop_expired consumed its timer entry, losing the wake and livelocking the cooperative loop (m3 softfloat never delays the ISR far enough). Fixed with a monotonic floor on the demo clock; corrected R311y14's wrong load-slowdown timeout justification. (3) portability/windows: sce-codegen's libxml crate needs native libxml2, absent on the windows runner -> vcpkg install libxml2:x64-windows-static-md + VCPKG_ROOT/VCPKGRS_TRIPLET. full run-ci RUNCI_EXIT=0; validate_workspace orphan new=+0.
changes_bullets: scripts/install-mnemosyne-cli.sh: MNEMOSYNE_REV 48117d24 (R415) -> bb01cc6b (R584). The R415 pin's CLI only read atomic-store schema <=9 while the store is now schema_version 23, so Layer A hard-failed "schema version mismatch: store=23 expected <= 9" on every push. The new pin matches the locally-installed --path binary (mnemosyne-cli 0.1.0 bb01cc6b, on mnemosyne origin/main); ci.yml + release.yml share this script so the one bump covers both.

deploy/mcu-qemu-demo/src/main.rs: SystickClock gains a last_us AtomicU64 monotonic floor; now_us() clamps its raw wraps-based reading up to the max previously returned. The raw reading steps BACKWARD when the SysTick exception is delayed past a wrap boundary on Cortex-M4F/M7 (lazy FP-context stacking + the cooperative executor's interrupt-disabling critical sections lengthen ISR latency), so `wraps` lags the hardware. The ClockSource trait REQUIRES monotonic now_us; the backward step is the root cause of the Layer Q hang.

scripts/run-ci.sh: corrected the run_qemu_case timeout comment. R311y14 misattributed the an386/an500 hang to CI load-slowdown and bumped the bound 10s->30s (a timeout never fixes a hang); the real cause was the non-monotonic clock above. 30s stays purely as a runaway/livelock backstop.

.github/workflows/ci.yml: the portability(windows) leg gains a vcpkg `libxml2:x64-windows-static-md` install + VCPKG_ROOT/VCPKGRS_TRIPLET export before build-sce.sh, so sce-codegen's libxml crate resolves its native libxml2 C dep on the windows-msvc runner (macOS + the Linux ci job find it via pkg-config). static-md = static libxml2 against the dynamic CRT, matching rustc-msvc /MD.

Layer A: mnemosyne-cli validate-workspace RC=0 with the bumped pin's CLI (T1 orphan new=+0, ledger=13 unchanged, T3 warn=4 / T4 info=4).

Layer Q: the previously-hanging Q.2.mps2-an386 + Q.2.mps2-an500 now PASS in the full `--layer Q` run; deterministic `-icount` stress = 60/60 PASS across microbit/an385/an386/an500 (pre-fix an386/an500 hung ~1/3 under icount). footprint within tol (thumbv7em text=24852 (+216), tol +-256).

Root-cause method (Layer Q): reproduced the hang with `-icount`, sampled the hung guest over the QEMU monitor (PC pinned in __primask_r / critical_section, IPSR=0 = thread-mode busy loop, not a halted wfi), confirmed guest time advanced (wraps 0x929 -> 0x163a over 1.5s) while the demo's 100ms sleep budget never elapsed -> a SleepFuture that never resolved = a lost wake from a non-monotonic clock.

Round 311y150.decision_summary: R311y150 -- qabl FUTURE-push (part A of the "y146 push-family completion"): a STRUCTURE/correctness forwarder mechanism (inventory-neutral, NO cfg gate) that closes the QUERY-plane analog of the y146 pub-before-sub hole. (1) PRESENCE: a querier-BEFORE-queryable querier's write-filter now deactivates when a matching queryable is learned later (mesh / client / self-local). (2) VALUE: a Z_QUERY_TARGET_ALL_COMPLETE querier's filter deactivates only on a complete=true reply (pico filtering.c:206), so when the FOLDED completeness flips false->true wz RE-pushes the SAME interned decl id carrying the new merged info (zenoh propagate_simple_queryable, linkstate_peer/queries.rs:180-198) -- else the ALL_COMPLETE querier black-holes. The subscriber store was GENERALIZED to FutureInterestStore<V> (subs V=() presence-only, qabls V=QueryableInfo value-aware) -- the y144 emit_current_interest_replies<V> precedent; V=() -> the value-change arm is unreachable, so sub behavior is provably unchanged (the 13 sub tests re-run with (), 588 lib tests green). Three DESIGN-panel-caught holes fixed before code: HOLE 1 (the push carries the RE-FOLDED merged info via merged_qabl_info, NOT a single source's raw -- else a downgrade re-arms the filter = black-hole); HOLE 2 (a new UNSTAMPED non-zero-id builder for the unsolicited push); HOLE 3 (the CURRENT-dump FUTURE branch emits the interned non-zero id so wire==seed). Both forwarders wired symmetrically; the peer is counterless + has no client-qabl plane (client declares dropped in resolve_source -- confirmed by direct-read arbitration when two IMPL agents disagreed), so its self-local + mesh fires are complete. IMPL(3)+DESIGN(3) panels direct-read-arbitrated: the IMPL pass caught one router fold divergence (merged folded the querier's own co-hosted queryable while the current dump excludes it -> a benign monotone-up spurious re-push), fixed by threading the destination face into pushes_for_new's value_of so merged EXCLUDES it (seed==push by construction). full run-ci RUNCI_EXIT=0.

Round 311y160.decision_summary: R311y160 -- §5.26 rest-http-bridge BUILT (the one genuine net-new atom the R311y159 A3-audit found in the P4 LAYER-3 breadth track; user chose #1 rest build first). New AP-only crate wz-rest: a HAND-ROLLED HTTP/1.1 server (ZERO external HTTP dep -- user chose hand-rolled over hyper/axum, an even-lighter superset) bridging HTTP to a wz TokioSession -- GET/POST->Session::query (JSON reply array or ?_raw), PUT/PATCH->publish Put, DELETE->publish Del, URL path->keyexpr (canonize + @/local->@/<zid> via SSOT zid_to_zenoh_hex). Compile-time-composed superset of zenoh's dlopen .so tide plugin (no plugin host-trait/ABI/lifecycle FSM); in its own crate so no_std/MCU builds never pull it. Trusted-localhost scope (127.0.0.1 bind = exposure-boundary NOT auth, documented). rest-http-bridge reserved->active (A3 cfg site = the wz facade `pub use wz_rest as rest`); the feature forwards the EXACT wz-runtime-tokio set the DESIGN panel found load-bearing (codec-push so PUT/DELETE emit -- else silent Ok(0); codec-response-final so a GET completes; query-timeout; query-get; pubsub-encoding; query-consolidation; query-selector-parameters). 3-agent DESIGN panel (concurrency/security/API-fidelity) caught the wire-broken feature set (pubsub-put/delete were the WRONG gates) + 5 blockers pre-code; 3-agent IMPL panel caught + fixed a real pending-query LEAK (ReplyHandle is inert Copy-u64, no sweep wired -> added Session::sweep_expired_queries + serve's sweep task) + 2 SSOT reinventions (zid hex, JSON escaper) + fidelity gaps. WIRE E2E proven over two TCP-linked sessions (diagnose-first neuter FAILs). full run-ci deferred to push; A3 PASS (active 115->116); validate orphan new=+0.
changes_bullets: NEW crate crates/wz-rest/ (AP-only, SPDX LGPL/Commercial): src/lib.rs (serve/serve_on + the AbortOnDrop sweep task + handle_connection with a per-connection read/write timeout + the SECURITY doc-note), src/http.rs (hand-rolled HTTP/1.1 request reader + Response writer: bounded 8KiB head/8MiB body, the must-handle malformed set -> clean 400/413/431/501/505, the 411-fix [absent Content-Length = empty body], 204 omits Content-Length, CORS), src/json.rs (hand-rolled JSON output + base64, routing string-escape through the SSOT wz_session_core::json::escape_into), src/bridge.rs (dispatch GET/PUT/DELETE/OPTIONS, path_to_keyexpr, the query reply-collection via oneshot).
crates/wz-rest/Cargo.toml: deps wz-runtime-tokio (the load-bearing feature set) + wz-session-core (encoding + keyexpr_canon + zid_hex + json SSOTs) + tokio; dev-dep wz-runtime-tokio-test-support.

crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/session/mod.rs: NEW `#[cfg(feature=query-get)] Session::sweep_expired_queries(&self) -> usize` (reply-registry deadline sweep + deferred-fire drain via the session's own clock; a line-for-line mirror of the wz-ap-demo sweep task) -- serve spawns a 1s-cadence caller so a GET whose wire ResponseFinal never arrives cannot leak its pending entry.

verification_bullets: wz-rest tests: 6 unit (base64 vectors, value_string null/utf8/binary, sample_object shape, split_target, path_to_keyexpr strip+canonicalise + @/local SSOT hex) + 1 WIRE E2E (rest_bridge_put_get_delete_traverse_the_wire) all pass. The wire test drives PUT/GET/DELETE over a real TCP socket against a SEPARATE session (subscriber receives PUT+DELETE, queryable answers GET as JSON) -- proving codec-push emit + query + codec-response-final completion over the wire (a loopback-only test would pass with those features OFF).

Round 311y161.decision_summary:
R311y161 -- §5.26 rest-sse-subscribe BUILT (the SSE half of the wz-rest REST bridge; finishes the #1 rest track). A GET with Accept: text/event-stream becomes Session::declare_subscriber, each received sample streamed to the HTTP client as `event: <PUT|DELETE>
data: <json-sample>

` until the client disconnects (the Subscriber handle drops -> UndeclareSubscriber). The subscriber callback (drive-loop task) hands samples to the socket-writing task via a BOUNDED channel (drop-newest on overflow); a 15s SSE-comment keepalive doubles as the disconnect probe. Gated behind wz-rest's rest-sse-subscribe feature (independently toggleable from the request/response bridge -- feature off => a text/event-stream GET returns 501). dispatch now returns an Outcome { Response | Sse } so handle_connection can hand the SSE case the write half. reserved->active (A3 cfg site = `#[cfg(feature=rest-sse-subscribe)] mod sse` + the Outcome::Sse arm); the wz facade `rest-sse-subscribe = [rest-http-bridge, wz-rest?/rest-sse-subscribe]`, and wz-rest's feature pulls declare-subscriber + pubsub-put/delete. New CI Layer C1az drives the SSE feature (the sse unit + rest_sse_wire_e2e tests are feature-gated, invisible to the default Layer C1 workspace test). 2-agent IMPL panel (concurrency/lifecycle + SSE-protocol/fidelity), direct-read arbitrated: framing/headers/event-name(PUT/DELETE)/data-shape FAITHFUL + teardown-on-all-paths clean; FIXED an unbounded-channel memory risk (slow-but-progressing consumer -> bounded channel) + corrected an honest timestamp-null disclosure. §5.26 rest now 2/2 active; A3 PASS (active 116->117); validate orphan new=+0. full run-ci deferred to push.

Round 311y170.decision_summary: R311y170 -- §5.21 routing-token-tables SLICE-1: the router liveliness-TOKEN dual-tier INGEST plane, the TOKEN TWIN of the router_subs/router_qabls declaration tables (zenoh hat/router/token.rs). A sourced DeclareToken on a MESH face registers the source in the inbound tier's token table (Router->router_tokens, Peer->linkstatepeer_tokens; both LinkstatepeerInterest<()> -- tokens carry NO value) + within-tier re-flood, reusing the shared ingest_interest<()> core DIRECTLY (NOT the ingest_subscription wrapper, whose cross-tier-bubble + future-push tail is a later slice). REGISTER-ONLY: the sourced UndeclareToken withdraw is deferred (wz UndeclToken codec = header+id only, no ext_wire_expr -- the qabl-plane-before-the-ext-codec pattern); an inbound sourced UndeclareToken from a peer router is dropped at forward()'s catch-all, and the face-down purge_detached_interest_tier (EXTENDED here to drain the token tables) is the departed-source safety net. routing-token-tables reserved->ACTIVE (real cfg site: #[cfg(feature=routing-token-tables)] fields+ingest+arm+purge). cfg composes routing-router-hat only (NOT liveliness-token: the DeclToken codec already rides routing-peer->codec-declare). Cross-tier bubble + client propagation + token-interest + topology-reconcile = later slices. 2-agent DESIGN (mirror-verifies-template caught the purge-leak + wrapper-tail traps pre-code) + 2-agent IMPL (both SHIP, no blocker). 648 lib + 6 token tests green; clippy ON/OFF/standalone; A3 active 117->118; fmt; orphan new=+0. full run-ci at push.

crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/router_forward.rs: +ingest_token(inbound,tier,reliable,declare) calling the shared ingest_interest::<()>() core DIRECTLY with build_declare_token(0,0,Some(ke)) (id 0 = sourced, keyexpr inline -- the same convention as build_declare_subscriber(0,0,Some(ke))); it does NOT invoke the ingest_subscription WRAPPER, whose advertise_native_cross_tier_sub + push_future_subscription tail is a later slice (DESIGN ADJUST 1). crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/router_forward.rs: purge_detached_interest_tier EXTENDED to drain router_tokens/linkstatepeer_tokens for the removed zids (DESIGN ADJUST 2 -- the face-down safety net; without it a departed native token source LEAKS in the register-only slice). DESIGN panel (3 independent adversarial agents + direct-read arbitration): Q1 wire-feasibility = BUILDABLE-AS-DESIGNED. zenohd register_router_token -> propagate_sourced_token(WhatAmI::Router) -> send_sourced_token_to_net_clildren floods a DeclareToken to every routers_net spanning-tree child with NO interest check (only a self-face exclusion), token.rs:213/177/46 -- structurally identical to the sub twin propagate_sourced_subscription (pubsub.rs:191). Round 311y177.decision_summary: R311y177 -- peer client-QUERYABLE hosting plane (the D4 query-plane completion, the genuine remaining peer-client-plane gap): give the wz PEER LinkstateForwarder a client_qabls plane, the query-plane twin of D4a's client-sub plane. A co-attached client's DeclareQueryable is now hosted in client_qabls, self-sourced into the mesh under self_zid carrying the MERGED QueryableInfo (derived_self_qabl_info fold, UPGRADE on a 2nd complete co-host), and DELIVERED a matching routed Query -- the forward_request RESTRUCTURE makes the client a distance-1 branch of the shared QueryFan (a complete client wins BestMatching; All/AllComplete fan mesh+clients), fixing the black-hole where a co-hosted client + a coexisting mesh queryable would route only to the mesh. Withdraw DOWNGRADES-or-undeclares via withdraw_mesh_qabl_if_unbacked (undeclare_queryable REWIRED through it so a self-native retract with a surviving client downgrades, not nukes). UNCONDITIONAL (single-net peer, no master gate), zenoh-linkstate_peer-faithful, NOT feature-gated (A3 active UNCHANGED at 118, a fidelity build like D4). 3-agent DESIGN (caught the finish_unrouted_request black-hole pre-code) + 3-agent IMPL (SHIP/SHIP-with-doc-fixes/SHIP, no logic bug) panels + direct-read arbitration. 7 unit tests + diagnose-first (delivery neutered -> U2/U2b FAIL); 649 router-hat + 160 prior peer tests green. run_peer witness + pico cross-impl leg + id-map fix (both planes) = named follow-ups. NOT pushed without consent.
changes_bullets: crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/linkstate_forward.rs: new `client_qabls: RefCell<HashMap<FaceId, HashMap<String, QueryableInfo>>>` field (the query-plane twin of D4a's client_subs) + `ingest_client_queryable` (self-source a client DeclareQueryable under self_zid carrying the MERGED info, value-diff-gated flood + push_future_queryable(Some(inbound)) self-echo exclude) + `derived_self_qabl_info` (ADVERTISE-side fold over self-native local_queryables + client_qabls; deliberately NOT the global `merged_qabl_info`, which would pollute the advert with a remote's completeness) + `withdraw_mesh_qabl_if_unbacked` (Some=DOWNGRADE re-advertise the surviving merged info / None=withdraw self from qabls + UndeclareQueryable + undeclare_push_qabls) + `withdraw_client_queryable`.

forward_request RESTRUCTURED (the crux): computes `client_candidates` (co-attached client queryables matching the query, distance-1) then selects `(children /*mesh*/, client_targets)` per QueryTarget -- a COMPLETE client wins BestMatching (suppresses the mesh best), else the mesh complete-best, else the All-fallback fans mesh + all clients; All/AllComplete fan mesh directions + all matching clients. The new `forward_request_to_client_queryables` fans the Request to each client face allocating a pending qid sharing the ONE QueryFan, so the reply routes back via the UNCHANGED forward_response + the closing final aggregates last-out across mesh AND client branches. UNCONDITIONAL (single-net peer, no master gate). The sync dispatch_local_queryables (self-hosted admin GETs) runs only when there is zero async branch.

declare_queryable REWIRED to register the DERIVED merge (not raw `local(complete)`) so a coexisting client queryable is not CLOBBERED (the single (ke,self_zid) qabls slot OVERWRITES); undeclare_queryable REWIRED through `withdraw_mesh_qabl_if_unbacked` (a self-native retract with a surviving client DOWNGRADES, not nukes; the None arm preserves the old full-undeclare + idempotent forget for the self-native-only case, byte-for-byte).

forward() Declare/Undecl(Queryable) arms gained `is_client_face` forks (pure-add: client -> ingest/withdraw_client_queryable, mesh -> forward_queryable{,_undeclare}); `deregister` drains client_qabls (per-ke withdraw_mesh_qabl_if_unbacked, same hoist as the client-sub drain); `client_qabls_seen` accessor (the client_subs_seen twin, consumed by the unit tests); the stale "no client-qabl plane / peer drops client declares" docstrings on merged_qabl_info / push_future_queryable / undeclare_push_qabls corrected (a client qabl now folds in via the self_zid aggregate slot).
verification_bullets: 7 unit tests, all pass (167 peer-lib tests total): U1 ingest->advert (client DeclareQueryable lands in client_qabls + advertised under self_zid carrying its completeness) / U2 composed delivery (a routed Query is forwarded to the co-attached client queryable + its Reply routes back to the querier with the querier's rid) / U2b a COMPLETE client wins BestMatching over a COEXISTING mesh queryable on the same ke -- the black-hole the restructure fixes / U3 upgrade-merge (a 2nd complete co-host UPGRADES the advert to complete) / U4 downgrade withdraw (the complete contributor leaves -> a DOWNGRADED DeclareQueryable re-flood, NOT an UndeclareQueryable) / U5+U7 deregister purge (client face down -> client_qabls drained + the last backer's mesh advert withdrawn via a sourced UndeclareQueryable) / U6 shared-slot rewire (a self-native undeclare_queryable with a surviving client queryable DOWNGRADES-not-nukes the shared self_zid advert).

Diagnose-first: an env-gated neuter of forward_request_to_client_queryables (return 0, no send) makes U2 + U2b FAIL (the client never receives the Query = the black-hole) while U1/U3/U4/U5/U6/U7 (advert/withdraw, not delivery) still PASS -- proving the delivery restructure is load-bearing, not a tautology. Neuter removed after.

Round 311y18.decision_summary: R311y18 -- bump vendor/sce pin ba65f7a1b -> a51b5e7e1 to pick up the SCE fix 'Make sce:template content model UPA-deterministic for libxml2 2.15', the FINAL Windows-portability blocker. vcpkg's libxml2 2.15.3 enforces XSD UPA strictly and rejected SCE's sce-forge-ext.xsd <sce:template> content model (an sce:param particle ahead of an xs:any ##any wildcard = non-deterministic), failing sce-codegen at schema-compile (exit 2) on every generate; Linux/macOS lenient libxml2 (<=2.11) tolerated it. Root-caused by direct SCE read + reported (not worked-around in wz per the SCE-readonly rule); SCE collapsed <sce:template> to a lone ##any wildcard (param ordering stays enforced by the template.rs expander SSOT) + added a determinism guard test. Bump-only, no wz code change. No other SCE delta; no wz-side text change (the two ba65f7a1b mentions are a HISTORICAL footprint comment in check-footprint.sh:134 and a `pin >= ba65f7a1b` lower-bound in wz-session-core/src/vle.rs:14 -- both still correct since a51b5e7e1 > ba65f7a1b).

SCE fix provenance (direct read, SCE pin a51b5e7e1): schemas/sce-forge-ext.xsd <sce:template> dropped the `<xs:element ref="sce:param" minOccurs=0 maxOccurs=unbounded>` particle, leaving the lone `<xs:any namespace="##any" lax>` wildcard. A named particle ahead of an ##any wildcard is a non-deterministic content model (XSD 1.0 UPA violation) that libxml2 >= 2.15 rejects at schema-compile; the param-ordering grammar stays enforced by the sce-build/src/template.rs expander (the structural SSOT), and SCE added sce-build/tests/xsd_content_model_determinism.rs as a regression guard. The other 8 ##any in the schema are lone wildcards (no preceding named particle) = already deterministic, untouched.

Two named divergences from zenoh: (1) `saturating_sub` for the `now < lifespan` underflow (zenoh's plain NTP64 Sub debug-panics / release-wraps → would wipe both registries on an unset-RTC boot; wz collects nothing); (2) `latest` (the tombstone map) is NEVER swept — it is the authoritative newer-wins record, so GCing it would resurrect deleted keys; GC bounds ONLY the registry memory (the documented "tombstones retained unbounded" divergence). zenoh's `latest_updates` GC is an INVERTED-predicate bug (retain(ts < limit) keeps OLD) wz sidesteps by not GCing latest.

crates/wz-session-core/src/ntp64.rs: + `Ntp64::from_duration(span: Duration) -> Self` — the span constructor (byte-identical to uhlc `From<Duration>` on any representable span; reuses `from_unix`, the NTP64 SSOT, NOT a hand-rolled `(secs<<32)|frac`). Round 311y189.decision_summary: R311y189 -- router-multicast-faces reliteralization fix (IMPL-review CONFIRMED bug). broadcast_to_mcast_groups egressed the RAW inbound push, skipping the keyexpr reliteralization every sibling router egress leg performs (deliver_to_client_subscribers, compute_self_publish_forward). Surfaced by the 3-agent IMPL review test-adequacy lens; the literal-only slice-1/3 tests structurally could not catch it. Regression test asserts the egressed keyexpr resolves against an EMPTY table (the group leaf no-alias view) to the literal, not the aliased id 7; the slice-3 unit was also strengthened to assert the resolved keyexpr.

Round 311y19.decision_summary: R311y19 -- link bcrypt.lib on windows-msvc (new repo-root .cargo/config.toml) to close the next Windows-portability blocker. With the R311y18 SCE UPA fix, sce-codegen runs clean on Windows and the crates compile, but the build-script links (sce-forge-runtime, wz-codecs, which pull libxml via SCE's sce-build) fail LNK2019 'unresolved external symbol BCryptGenRandom referenced in xmlInitRandom': vcpkg's libxml2 >= 2.13 uses BCryptGenRandom but the libxml crate's vcpkg link metadata omits bcrypt. Fix = a windows-msvc-scoped rustflags link-arg bcrypt.lib (inert on every other target). Verified locally: cargo accepts the config + the bcrypt section is inert on Linux (wz-codecs/wz-runtime-tokio build clean, no bcrypt in the Linux link). The windows acceptance verifies on the portability CI leg. 4th distinct Windows-libxml2 fix (missing -> .exe -> UPA -> bcrypt); bcrypt is the known-last libxml2 LINK gap. validate_workspace orphan new=+0.
changes_bullets: .cargo/config.toml (NEW, repo root): `[target.x86_64-pc-windows-msvc] rustflags = ["-C", "link-arg=bcrypt.lib"]`. Closes LNK2019 `unresolved external symbol BCryptGenRandom referenced in xmlInitRandom`: with the R311y18 SCE UPA fix, sce-codegen runs clean and the crates compile on Windows, but the build-script links (sce-forge-runtime, wz-codecs -- both pull libxml via SCE's sce-build) fail because vcpkg's libxml2 >= 2.13 calls BCryptGenRandom while the libxml crate's vcpkg link metadata omits bcrypt. bcrypt is a Windows system lib; the section only applies when building FOR windows-msvc (the portability leg builds natively, host==target, so it reaches the build scripts too) and is inert on Linux/macOS/MCU.
verification_bullets: Local: cargo accepts the new config; `cargo build -p wz-codecs` + `-p wz-runtime-tokio` clean on Linux with NO bcrypt in the link (the windows-msvc section is target-scoped, inert off-Windows) -> the Linux ci / cross-mcu jobs + the pre-push full run-ci are unaffected.
windows-msvc: the BCryptGenRandom link resolves only on the portability CI leg (no local Windows host) -- verifies on the push run.
This is a libxml-crate/vcpkg link-metadata gap (external, not SCE/wz); bcrypt is standard for libxml2 >= 2.13 on windows-msvc, harmless when unreferenced.
carry_forward_bullets: R311y19 = link bcrypt.lib on windows-msvc (.cargo/config.toml) -- the 4th distinct Windows-libxml2 toolchain fix. Arc: R311y15 (libxml2 vcpkg install) -> R311y17 (sce-codegen.exe EXE_SUFFIX) -> R311y18 (SCE sce:template UPA fix) -> R311y19 (bcrypt link). Each fix uncovered the next; bcrypt is the known-LAST libxml2 LINK gap (libxml2 >= 2.13 xmlInitRandom -> BCryptGenRandom, omitted by the libxml crate's vcpkg metadata).

Round 311y190.decision_summary: R311y190 -- MCU multicast now RUNS on-target via config; the "MCU multicast is host-only, on-target evidence deferred" debt is CLOSED. A general MCU node built through the wz facade with transport-multicast + the new loopback-multicast/loopif-multicast toggle + a testmode lwIP port completes a REAL IGMP-join + multicast-loopback roundtrip on QEMU (Cortex-M3/M4/M7), not just build+footprint. Mechanism: (1) a new lwIP port cross-test-mcast (cross-test + LWIP_LOOPIF_MULTICAST + LWIP_TESTMODE + runtime pool sizing, via #include of the shared cross-test so it stays byte-identical); (2) a no_std deploy-callable seam LwipLink::route_multicast_over_loopback (the promotion of test-support ip4_set_default_multicast_netif(netif_get_loopif()) routing), feature-gated on loopif-multicast so the LWIP_TESTMODE-only FFI couples the feature to a testmode port BY CONSTRUCTION (mismatch = compile fail); (3) the facade forward chain link->session-lwip->wz->wz-mcu-multicast-e2e->deploy (mirrors buffer-pool-session-rx-slim); (4) deploy/mcu-multicast-e2e loopback-multicast: main() routes multicast over loopif + REQUIRES full_success -> semihost PASS, dropping the loopback-only SKIP concession; (5) run-ci Layer Q.6 boots it on mps2-an385/an386/an500 asserting PASS. 3-agent DESIGN panel arbitrated the home (mcu-multicast-e2e, NOT the link-tier mcu-qemu-demo), the new-port-not-shared-edit, and the seam-not-just-port-defines trap; verified empirically (M3/M4/M7 QEMU boot PASS). Default build byte-identical; shared cross-test port + 7 other lanes untouched. DEFERRED (named): slim pool for nrf51/M0 <=16KB SRAM; real ethernet-netif multicast (no NIC in CI). Honest scope: a loopback transport-plumbing on-target proof, not real-network multicast.
changes_bullets: NEW lwIP port crates/lwip-sys/port/cross-test-mcast/ — lwipopts.h #includes ../cross-test + LWIP_LOOPIF_MULTICAST=1 + LWIP_TESTMODE=1 + runtime pool sizing (MEM_SIZE 16384 / MEMP_NUM_PBUF 16 / PBUF_POOL_SIZE 8); arch/cc.h #includes ../../cross-test/arch/cc.h. SSOT: the shared cross-test options are single-sourced (delta-only override), and the shared cross-test port stays BYTE-IDENTICAL (Open/Closed — extend via a new port, never edit the shared one that feeds 7 lanes + zephyr).

crates/wz-link-lwip: LinkError::FeatureDisabled + pub fn route_multicast_over_loopback (no_std; #[cfg(feature="loopif-multicast")] emits ip4_set_default_multicast_netif(netif_get_loopif()), else Err(FeatureDisabled)) + the loopif-multicast feature. Signature-stable; the FFI is LWIP_TESTMODE-only, so the feature<->testmode-port coupling is compile-enforced (a loopif-multicast build against a non-testmode port fails to compile — self-guarding, unrepresentable illegal state).

Facade forward chain (mirrors buffer-pool-session-rx-slim): wz-session-lwip loopif-multicast=[wz-link-lwip/loopif-multicast]; wz loopif-multicast=[wz-link-lwip?/.., wz-session-lwip?/..]; wz-mcu-multicast-e2e loopif-multicast=[wz/loopif-multicast].

deploy/mcu-multicast-e2e: loopback-multicast=[wz-mcu-multicast-e2e/loopif-multicast]; main() #[cfg]-gates link.route_multicast_over_loopback() before run_multicast_e2e AND requires full_success (join_ok+peer_admitted+tx_fragmented+saw_push -> PASS); the loopback-only SKIP concession is #[cfg(not(loopback-multicast))] so a failed join in the RUN build is a real FAIL, not a skip.

scripts/run-ci.sh Layer Q.6: builds mcu-multicast-e2e --features loopback-multicast + WZ_LWIP_PORT=cross-test-mcast for thumbv7m/thumbv7em, boots mps2-an385/an386/an500 via run_qemu_case asserting semihost PASS (exit 0 == PASS since the RUN build has no SKIP arm). Round 311y194.decision_summary: R311y194 -- router-multicast-faces INGRESS plane, slice I1 (the deferred, harder half of the atom; the EGRESS half + its cross-impl proof were y187-y193). The wz --router-hat now also JOINs the data-plane multicast group (RX) and routes a received multicast peer Push to its LOCAL unicast subscribers, echo-guarded off the groups. Arbitrated single group-ingress face (per-peer mcast_faces + mcast-peer declarations deferred to I3), LITERAL-ONLY (an aliased id-only ingress push has no per-peer alias table on the router and is dropped), AP-only (no change to the shared no_std session-core RX SSOT), and a SEPARATE ingress drive loop (the egress path is byte-untouched). A new spawn_router_mcast_ingress binds via UdpDriver::bind_multicast_v4 (JOIN/RX) on its own task and folds each received Push -- over a Send channel -- into a new 7th accept-loop select! arm, which calls a new pub FaceForwarder::route_mcast_ingress on the !Send RouterForwarder (sentinel FaceId u64::MAX, FaceTier::Client, inbound_is_mcast=true). SELF-ECHO is a non-issue by construction (verified: the RX-dispatch self-zid gate multicast_rx.rs:97 drops this node own looped-back JOIN, so its egress source addr is never admitted and its egress data frames are dropped as unknown-peer -- egress+ingress share the router single zid). 3-agent DESIGN panel (arbitrated the single-face/literal-only/AP-only/separate-loop scope + resolved A-vs-B/C self-delivery dispute by direct read) + 3-agent IMPL panel, both direct-read arbitrated. The IMPL panel caught TWO real must-fixes now resolved: (1) a codec-push gate gap -- accept_loop referenced PushOwned unconditionally but codec-push is not implied by routing-accept, breaking the --no-default-features routing-accept lane (run-ci C1w); fixed by gating the PushOwned import + the McastIngressItem.push field + the route call + spawn_router_mcast_ingress on codec-push while keeping the select! arm ungated (tokio select! rejects #[cfg] on a branch); (2) a multi-router echo-loop hazard -- re-injecting mcast-ingress into the linkstate mesh could amplify a Put between two group-sharing router-hats (the echo guard keys on the immediate inbound face, not the ultimate mcast origin); fixed by gating the client->mesh re-injection on !inbound_is_mcast so a mcast-ingress Push delivers to LOCAL subscribers only (faithful mesh-federation is the deferred I3 per-peer plane with spanning-tree loop prevention). Inventory UNCHANGED (router-multicast-faces stays active; ingress rides the SAME feature cfg site as egress, no new atom). full run-ci at the pre-push hook.

Inventory-neutral (grows the existing router-multicast-faces atom). Full 3-agent DESIGN + 3-agent IMPL review, direct-read arbitrated: DESIGN chose dispatch-SSOT resolution (PeerSlot IS wz's mcast_faces; zenoh's mcast peer face is WhatAmI::Client/'Quick hack', federation deferred to I3b as a superset); IMPL caught a stale header-N-bit desync (fixed) + the table DoS (capped), refuted all other classes.
changes_bullets: crates/wz-session-core/src/multicast_dispatch.rs: PeerSlot gains a per-peer id->literal keyexpr_table (cfg multicast-declarations), cleared on evict(); new apply_declared_aliases(src, &mut outcome) absorbs the peer's DeclKexpr + rewrites its aliased Pushes to literal via the set_push_keyexpr_literal SSOT (keyexpr + header N-bit in sync) BEFORE the observer fan; const MAX_ALIASES_PER_PEER=256 caps the table (unauthenticated-multicast DoS guard, growth-only reject so removals/re-declares still flow).

crates/wz-session-core/src/multicast_rx.rs: apply_declared_aliases called in dispatch_multicast_inbound (whole-frame) + the fragment-completion path (ingest_multicast_fragment), both BEFORE apply_namespace_ingress (id->literal first, then prefix-strip).

crates/wz-session-core/src/wireexpr_resolve.rs: absorb_keyexpr_into MOVED here as the keyexpr-absorb SSOT (cfg codec-declare) from wz-runtime-tokio; crates/wz-runtime-tokio/src/linkstate_forward.rs re-exports it (pub(crate) use) so both unicast forwarders + the new multicast plane share ONE definition.

Cargo: new wz-session-core feature multicast-declarations=[session-multicast,alloc,codec-declare,codec-push]; wz-runtime-tokio router-multicast-faces implies wz-session-core/multicast-declarations. Inventory-NEUTRAL: grows the existing router-multicast-faces atom's realized capability (literal->aliased ingress), no new 5.21 catalog atom (a composition feature like codec-declare/keyexpr-prefix; A3 audit is inventory->cargo only, so a non-inventoried feature does not trip it).

4 new session-core unit tests: declared_alias_resolves_inbound_push_to_literal (+ push.header & 0x20 assertion), undeclared_alias_stays_unresolved, evict_clears_peer_aliases, per_peer_alias_table_is_capped.
verification_bullets: 384 session-core lib tests pass (4 new); clippy clean (session-core multicast-declarations + runtime router-multicast-faces,codec-push); feature-off + narrow-combo builds compile (router-multicast-faces alone = host-elided, session-multicast alone = MCU-like, no-default-features session-multicast/reassembly/alloc = MCU no_std lane); wz-ap-demo --features router-multicast-faces + the S4/I1/I2 interop tests compile.

MCU RX SSOT byte-identical: the only multicast_rx.rs delta is the cfg(multicast-declarations)-gated apply_declared_aliases call; the MCU crates (wz-session-lwip, wz-mcu-multicast-e2e) never enable the feature, so the field/method/const/call are all elided.

3-agent DESIGN panel, direct-read arbitrated: per-peer aliasing resolves IN the dispatch SSOT on PeerSlot (mirroring apply_namespace_ingress) - no src threaded to the !Send forwarder, no per-peer FaceIds; direct read confirmed PeerSlot IS wz's mcast_faces + zenoh's mcast peer face = WhatAmI::Client/DummyPrimitives/"Quick hack" and mcast_faces is never in a linkstate net, so faithful federation is I3b (a superset over zenoh's rough two-router-shared-group loop, which egress_filter does NOT prevent).

3-agent IMPL panel: CONFIRMED must-fix caught + fixed pre-commit - stale header N-bit (apply_declared_aliases rewrote the keyexpr but not the header N (suffix-present) bit; reliteralize_push's already-literal shortcut forwards it verbatim + desyncs the subscriber decoder on the no-namespace router-hat, exactly the I3a deployment) via set_push_keyexpr_literal + a header assertion; + the per-peer table memory-exhaustion DoS via MAX_ALIASES_PER_PEER; all other adversarial classes REFUTED (self-echo via the self-zid gate, wrong-peer via one-slot-per-src all-or-nothing, recycle via evict, cyclic-alias via single-lookup resolve).
carry_forward_bullets: I3a DONE (per-peer aliased multicast ingress, LOCAL delivery): the router-hat resolves a mcast peer's DeclKexpr-aliased Pushes to literal per peer + delivers to LOCAL unicast subs; lifts I1 literal-only; inventory-neutral; DoS-capped (256/peer). NEXT = I3b (loop-safe mesh-federation, the deferred HARD half): forwarder-side origin attribution (SP#1 carrier decided there) + origin-tagged loop-prevention SUPERSET over zenoh's Quick-hack (two-federated-routers-sharing-a-group is UNSAFE today, documented in route_push); its own 3-agent DESIGN pass. Then I3c cross-impl proofs.

DEFERRED (named): I3c cross-impl ALIASED proof needs an aliasing publisher - stock pico is Z_FEATURE_MULTICAST_DECLARATIONS=0 (literal only), so it needs a pico rebuilt with declarations, zenohd-on-multicast, or a wz aliasing mcast publisher; the I2 literal pico lane stays as the literal regression.

DEFERRED (named): the namespace_ingress twin carries the SAME unbounded per-peer pattern (routing-namespace feature) - a follow-up unifies the per-peer-decorator bound across BOTH decorators (needs care for namespace undeclare-correlation semantics, so it was NOT bundled into I3a).
